plot: 自由的黑人小提琴手所罗门·诺瑟普被两个男人诱到华盛顿，醒来时已经被卖掉。从这一天起，他以奴隶的身份在路易斯安那的种植园之间被转手。
hook: 史蒂夫·麦奎因这部电影打破了每条规矩：一个很美国的故事，导演和主演（切瓦特·埃加福特）是英国人；一部黑人为主的年代戏，全球票房超过 1.3 亿美元；一次把奴隶制看清楚的清算，拿了最佳影片。剧本根据所罗门·诺瑟普惊人的自传。他本是自由的黑人，19 世纪中叶被绑架卖为奴隶。麦奎因把它做成一版野心极大、不像能有诗意却有诗意的《奥德赛》。关于人性、权力、偏见和仁慈，它说出来的比此前一百年里很多美国政治电影加起来还多。
plot_en: Solomon Northup, a free Black violinist, is lured to Washington by two men and wakes to find he has been sold. From that day he is passed from plantation to plantation in Louisiana as a slave.
hook_en: Steve McQueen’s film broke every rule — a profoundly American story from a British director and star (Chiwetel Ejiofor); a Black-led period drama that grossed more than $130 million internationally; a clear-eyed reckoning with slavery that won best picture. Working from the astonishing autobiography of Solomon Northup, a free Black man kidnapped into slavery in the mid-19th century, McQueen crafted a blazingly ambitious, improbably poetic version of the “Odyssey” that reveals more about humanity, power, bigotry and grace than much of the previous 100 years of American political cinema combined.

plot: 利兹·莱蒙负责一档周六晚间喜剧，上司杰克·多纳吉把管理和约会都当成并购。演员、编剧和电视网每周都在把节目从崩溃里拽回来。
hook: 蒂娜·菲根据自己当《周六夜现场》首席编剧的经历改编，讲一档喜剧节目的幕后乱象。笑话密度极高，背景里也塞满了梗。亚历克·鲍德温演的电视台高管杰克是全剧最大的亮点。
plot_en: Liz Lemon runs a Saturday-night comedy show. Her boss, Jack Donaghy, treats management and dating as acquisitions. Every week the actors, the writers, and the network drag the show back from collapse.
hook_en: Tina Fey based it on her years as head writer of Saturday Night Live, and it is about the chaos behind a comedy show. The jokes are packed tight, and the background is full of them too. Alec Baldwin’s network executive, Jack, is the best thing in it.

plot: 十九岁的马利克进了法国监狱，哪一伙都不算。科西嘉黑帮让他去杀人，他照做，同时把监狱内外的关系一点点攒到自己手上。
hook: 这个故事的轮廓并不让人意外：一个少年进了监狱，出来时成了硬起来的罪犯。可惜的是，这种轮廓太平常。雅克·欧迪亚尔在乎的是具体的事，甚至用虹膜式的圈镜头把我们的注意力指过去。马利克是个不识字的法国少年，阿拉伯裔。他用脑子不只是混过去，而是往上走。塔哈尔·拉希姆把他演得很收。马利克也代表法国郊区那些面对偏见、缺少机会的年轻穆斯林。这部戏上映之后的这些年，只是更贴现在了。
plot_en: Malik enters a French prison at nineteen, belonging to no crew. The Corsican gang tells him to kill someone. He does it, and at the same time gathers the relationships inside and outside the prison into his own hands.
hook_en: Sadly, the outlines of this story — a teenager is sent to prison and emerges a hardened criminal — aren’t surprising. But Jacques Audiard is all about specifics, even deploying iris shots to direct our attention as Malik, an illiterate French teenager of Arab descent, uses his smarts not just to get by but to get ahead. Malik (a terrifically subtle Tahar Rahim) is also a stand-in for young Muslims dealing with prejudice and a lack of opportunity in France’s banlieues. In the years since this drama’s release, it has only grown more relevant.

plot: 纳德和西敏要离婚。西敏想带女儿出国，纳德放不下患有老年痴呆的父亲。一次护工的事故之后，两家人被卷进同一场官司。
hook: 阿斯哈·法哈蒂这部戏发生在德黑兰。一对夫妻正在分手，却走不开：法官没批准离婚。妻子西敏躲到母亲那里。丈夫纳德尔雇了一个女人照顾生病的父亲，一连串转折之后，他被控谋杀，站上法庭。悬念和道德上的含糊都在。这部法律惊悚片后来成了第一部拿到奥斯卡最佳外语片的伊朗电影。
plot_en: Nader and Simin are divorcing. Simin wants to take their daughter abroad; Nader will not leave his father, who has dementia. After an accident involving the carer, both families are pulled into the same court case.
hook_en: In Asghar Farhadi’s drama, set in Tehran, a couple is mid-breakup but stuck: A judge has denied the divorce application. While the wife, Simin, takes refuge with her mother, a series of twists and turns lands the husband, Nader, in court facing a murder charge after he hires a woman to care for his ailing father. Full of suspense and moral ambiguity, this legal thriller went on to become the first Iranian movie to win the Oscar for best foreign language film.

plot: 大学物理教师拉里觉得每件事都在松：妻子要跟别人走，学生拿钱来换及格，一封匿名信正在毁掉他的终身教职。他去找拉比，想知道自己做错了什么。
hook: 科恩兄弟把他们 1960 年代末在明尼苏达的童年，拧成一部像塔木德段落一样打结的黑色喜剧。迈克尔·斯图尔巴格演物理教授拉里·戈普尼克。不高兴的学生、不成器的弟弟、终身教职委员会、儿子的成人礼，以及一个叫赛·埃布尔曼的男人引起的分居，同时压过来。是上帝在试他吗？拉比那个关于“外邦人的牙”的故事里有答案吗？这是科恩兄弟最犹太的电影。除了《谋杀绿脚趾》，它也最适合被拿来引用。
plot_en: Larry, a university physics teacher, feels everything coming loose: his wife is leaving him for someone else, a student offers money for a passing grade, and an anonymous letter is ruining his tenure. He goes to the rabbis to find out what he did wrong.
hook_en: The Coen brothers spin memories of their childhood in late-1960s Minnesota into a dark comedy as knotty as a Talmudic passage. Michael Stuhlbarg plays Larry Gopnik, a physics professor simultaneously beset by a disgruntled student, a wayward brother, a tenure committee, a son’s bar mitzvah and a separation spurred by a guy named Sy Ableman. Is God testing him? Does a rabbi’s story about a “goy’s teeth” hold the answer? It’s the Coens’ most Jewish film — and, “The Big Lebowski” aside, a good candidate for their most quotable.

plot: 编剧查理接下一本关于兰花窃贼的书，却怎么也改编不出来。他写着写着，把自己和双胞胎弟弟唐纳德都写进了剧本。
hook: 《改编剧本》像一座镜子大厅。斯派克·琼斯导演，署名编剧是查理·考夫曼和他的双胞胎弟弟唐纳德，而唐纳德其实不存在。它改编的那本书，讲的就是一本书有多不可能被改编；它也在看神经质、勇气和执着的热情。最重要的是，它非常好笑。尼古拉斯·凯奇一个人演两个考夫曼，表演很有滋味。
plot_en: The screenwriter Charlie takes on a book about an orchid thief and cannot adapt it. As he writes, he writes himself, and his twin brother Donald, into the script.
hook_en: There’s a virtuosic hall-of-mirrors quality to “Adaptation,” directed by Spike Jonze and ostensibly written by Charlie Kaufman and his twin brother, Donald, who does not in fact exist. It’s an adaptation of a book that’s actually about how impossible it is to adapt a book; it’s a study of neuroses and courage and obsessive passion; and above all it is an incredibly funny movie, with a delicious, dual Nicolas Cage performance as both Kaufmans.

plot: 十三岁的杰米在家中被逮捕，罪名是杀害一名同学。四集分别跟着拘捕、学校、心理评估和这个家庭的余波，每一集都是一个不中断的长镜头。
hook: 每集一镜到底，四集讲一个 13 岁男孩被控谋杀后的四个时刻。它关注网络厌女文化怎样影响青少年，以及父母和学校为什么没有察觉。第一次演戏的欧文·库珀在第三集与心理医生的对手戏尤其惊人。
plot_en: Thirteen-year-old Jamie is arrested at home, accused of killing a classmate. The four episodes follow the arrest, the school, a psychological evaluation, and the aftermath for the family. Each episode is one uninterrupted shot.
hook_en: Each episode is a single take. Four episodes cover four moments after a 13-year-old boy is charged with murder. It is about how online misogyny reaches teenagers, and why the parents and the school did not see it. Owen Cooper, acting for the first time, is especially startling in the third episode, opposite the psychologist.

plot: 十一岁的索菲和父亲卡勒姆在土耳其的度假村里游泳、打牌、看别人唱歌。多年以后，成年的索菲翻看这次旅行留下的录像带。
hook: 看夏洛特·威尔斯这部安静、摧毁人的长片处女作，会觉得自己在看别人的家庭录像，哪怕有些场面并不是父女在土耳其度假时的摄像机画面。新人弗兰基·科里奥和因此突破的保罗·麦斯卡（获得奥斯卡最佳男主角提名）把表演调得很准，亲密的真实感更强。黑暗的暗示渗进这趟晒着太阳的旅行，而且能看出他们在一起的时间已经是过去式，这就让人心碎。
plot_en: Eleven-year-old Sophie and her father Calum swim, play cards, and watch other people sing at a holiday village in Turkey. Years later, the adult Sophie goes back through the videotapes from that trip.
hook_en: Watching this quietly devastating feature debut from Charlotte Wells, it feels as if you’re seeing someone’s home movies — even in the scenes that aren’t shot to look like camcorder footage of a father and daughter’s Turkish vacation. The perfectly tuned performances by the young newcomer Frankie Corio and a breakout Paul Mescal (who was nominated for a best actor Oscar) add to the intimate realism. When hints of darkness seep into their sun-dappled trip, and it becomes clear their time together is in the past tense, it’s heartbreaking.

plot: 高中生威廉被一家摇滚杂志派去跟随一支还没红的乐队巡演。吉他手、追随乐队的佩妮，和这一路上的采访，都比他准备好的要乱。
hook: 卡梅隆·克罗这部半自传的喜剧，讲一个迷恋摇滚的高中生记者，跟着一支正在起来的乐队上路。它几乎成了一种图腾，“你没法跟摇滚明星做朋友”这类句子被反复说。在卡特·史蒂文斯、Yes 和埃尔顿·约翰的歌里，克罗把 1970 年代摇滚那种让人醉的环境做活了：一个捉摸不透的吉他手（比利·克鲁德普），一个有吸引力、别叫她骨肉皮的人（凯特·哈德森）。片子对追逐名声的危险也很清醒。
plot_en: A rock magazine sends the high-schooler William on the road with a band that is not famous yet. The guitarist, Penny, who follows the band, and the interviews along the way are all messier than he was ready for.
hook_en: Cameron Crowe’s semi-autobiographical dramedy about a rock ’n’ roll-obsessed high school journalist who goes on the road with a rising band has become almost totemic, with aphorisms like “You cannot make friends with the rock stars.” Over a soundtrack of Cat Stevens, Yes and Elton John, Crowe brings to life the intoxicating milieu of 1970s rock, featuring an enigmatic guitarist (Billy Crudup) and an alluring don’t-call-her-a-groupie (Kate Hudson). But the movie is also bracingly clear-eyed about the perils of chasing fame.

plot: 艾米莉在蒙马特一家咖啡馆当服务员，喜欢替陌生人安排小小的好事，自己的感情却不敢说。她把一只童年的铁盒还回去，也开始注意一个常来店里的男人。
hook: “做梦的人，日子不好过。”这句台词出自这部意外大热的片子。人们主要记得它把爱情喜剧和魔法效果拌在一起。先把心碎的女人化成一摊水这类场面放到一边。导演让-皮埃尔·热内看人和看爱都很清醒，也很好笑。那句台词，是一个色情商店店员说的。追求者对喜欢的人说“你脸红的时候很美”，她回答：“那是我消化不良。”
plot_en: Amélie waits tables at a café in Montmartre. She likes arranging small good turns for strangers and cannot say what she feels. She returns a tin box from someone’s childhood, and starts to notice a man who keeps coming into the café.
hook_en: “Times are hard for dreamers,” a character says in this surprise smash hit that’s mainly remembered as a mash-up of rom-com and magical effects. But set aside moments like a heartbroken woman dissolving into a puddle. The director Jean-Pierre Jeunet takes a clear-eyed, very funny view of both people and love. That line, for instance, is uttered by a porn emporium clerk. And when a would-be suitor tells the object of his affection, “You’re beautiful when you blush,” she replies, “It’s my dyspepsia.”

plot: 退休的音乐教师乔治和安娜住在巴黎的公寓里。安娜一次中风之后右半边身体失灵，乔治把护工、女儿和医院都挡在外面，自己照顾她。
hook: 迈克尔·哈内克，那个拍过《趣味游戏》的挑衅导演，在这幅关于配偶之间守着彼此的、很痛的肖像里，意外地温柔。他用观众对两位八十多岁明星的记忆：让-路易·特兰蒂尼昂（《随波逐流的人》）和艾曼纽·丽娃（《广岛之恋》），让他们演乔治和安娜，一对结了婚的前音乐教师。安娜的健康往下走，乔治照顾她。他知道没什么可做的，也知道自己在慢慢把自己的生活关上。
plot_en: Georges and Anne, retired music teachers, live in a Paris apartment. After a stroke, the right side of Anne’s body fails. Georges keeps the carers, their daughter, and the hospital outside, and looks after her himself.
hook_en: Michael Haneke, the provocateur director of “Funny Games,” brought a surprisingly tender touch to this wrenching portrait of spousal devotion. Drawing on the audience’s memories of his octogenarian stars, Jean-Louis Trintignant (“The Conformist”) and Emmanuelle Riva (“Hiroshima Mon Amour”), Haneke cast them as Georges and Anne, married former music teachers. Georges tends to Anne as her health deteriorates; he recognizes that there is nothing much to be done, and that he is gradually closing off his own life.

plot: 萨缪尔死在法国山间小屋外的雪地里。妻子桑德拉说事发时自己在外面，视力不好的儿子在屋里。法庭要弄清他是自己跌下去的，还是被推的。
hook: 不完全是各说各话：那个被从窗户扔出去的丈夫，开场几分钟就已经死了。朱斯蒂娜·特里埃把一段乱糟糟的婚姻拆开，既像取证，又刺激地含糊。桑德拉·惠勒演那个也许把另一半推出木屋窗户的妻子，凭这个角色拿到奥斯卡提名。她把压住的怒、愤慨，以及她和特里埃都不会说破的难看真相，演成了一堂课。
plot_en: Samuel is found dead in the snow outside a chalet in the French mountains. His wife Sandra says she was away when it happened. Their son, who does not see well, was inside. The court has to decide whether he fell or was pushed.
hook_en: Not quite a he-said she-said — the defenestrated husband in question is, several minutes in, already dead — Justine Triet’s taut, stylish dissection of a tumultuous marriage is both forensic and thrillingly ambiguous. As the wife who may or may not have pushed her better half out of a chalet window, Sandra Hüller, who earned an Oscar nomination for the role, offers a master class in contained fury, indignation and ugly truths she (and Triet) will never tell.

plot: 圣地亚哥电视台的主播罗恩·勃艮第和他的班子独占着黄金时段。台里派来女记者维罗妮卡，和罗恩争同一个位子。
hook: 没完的俏皮话，荒唐的大场面，威尔·法瑞尔把一个又大又蠢、性别歧视的主播演得疯得正好，可以说是他最好的时候。这部喜剧是对任何不舒服的解药。故事说得通吗？并不。这重要吗？不。你是为了笑话、对头新闻组之间的混战，以及演员拍的时候好像过了他们一生中最好的日子。另外，我们现在都知道，德语里“San Diago”的意思是“鲸鱼的阴道”。
plot_en: Ron Burgundy and his crew have the prime-time desk at a San Diego station to themselves. The station sends in the reporter Veronica, and she and Ron compete for the same job.
hook_en: The endless one-liners, the absurd set pieces, the big dumb sexist lunk of an anchorman played with just the right amount of lunacy by Will Ferrell, at arguably his best — this comedy is the perfect antidote to whatever ails you. Does the story make sense? Not really. Does that matter? No. You’re there for the jokes, the rumble between rival news teams and the sense that cast members had the time of their lives making this movie. Plus now we all know “San Diago” means “a whale’s vagina” in German.

plot: 在《侠盗一号》之前，卡西恩·安多还不是叛军英雄。他被卷进偷窃、监狱和一场需要账本、演讲和牺牲才能运转的革命。
hook: 《星球大战》衍生剧，但几乎不靠绝地武士和原力，讲的是普通人怎样被逼上反抗之路。政治、监狱和谍报线都写得很成熟，不看其他星战作品也能看懂。第一季的监狱篇是全剧高峰，第二季结尾直接接上电影《侠盗一号》。
plot_en: Before Rogue One, Cassian Andor is not yet a rebel hero. He is pulled into a theft, a prison, and a revolution that runs on ledgers, speeches, and sacrifice.
hook_en: A Star Wars series that barely relies on Jedi or the Force. It is about ordinary people being pushed into resistance. The politics, the prison, and the spycraft are written for adults, and you can follow it without the other films. The prison stretch of the first season is the high point. The end of the second season runs straight into Rogue One.

plot: 更早的一档旅行美食节目。波登从厨房走向世界，用食欲、玩笑和逐渐认真起来的提问，记录一个地方怎么吃饭。
hook: 波登更早期的旅行美食节目，风格比《未知之境》更随性、更好玩：吃街边小摊、吐槽、喝酒、和当地人聊天。2006 年拍黎巴嫩时，摄制组遇上战争，被困贝鲁特，那一集很特别。
plot_en: An earlier travel-and-food series. Bourdain moves from the kitchen out into the world and records how a place eats, with appetite, jokes, and questions that get more serious as he goes.
hook_en: Bourdain’s earlier travel-and-food series, looser and more playful than Parts Unknown: street stalls, complaints, drinks, and talk with local people. In 2006 the crew was filming in Lebanon when the war started and they were stuck in Beirut. That episode is a thing apart.

plot: 波登到各个地方吃饭，更多的时间用来坐下来听人讲政治、战争和一天的工作。食物是入场的理由，不是回避当地的办法。
hook: 安东尼·波登去世界各地吃饭，但他更关心食物背后的人、政治和历史。这不是美食打卡节目，常常会拍到战争、贫困和移民。越南那集他在河内和奥巴马一起吃烤肉米线，非常有名。
plot_en: Bourdain goes places to eat, and spends more of the time sitting down to hear about politics, war, and a day’s work. The food is the reason for being let in, not a way of avoiding the place.
hook_en: Anthony Bourdain travels the world to eat, but he is more interested in the people, the politics, and the history behind the food. It is not a checklist of restaurants. It often films war, poverty, and migration. The Vietnam episode, in which he eats bun cha in Hanoi with Obama, is the famous one.

plot: 地产商乔治·布卢斯被捕后，儿子迈克尔试图拉住这个不断内斗的家族。旁白补上他们不肯承认的那半句，笑话常常要到后面几集才收回来。
hook: 富豪老爸被捕后，只有二儿子迈克尔想撑住这个家，其他人都在添乱。这是最需要专心看的喜剧之一，伏笔和梗会隔好几集甚至好几季才回收。前三季是经典；Netflix 复活的第四、五季口碑差一些。
plot_en: After the developer George Bluth is arrested, his son Michael tries to hold together a family that keeps turning on itself. The narrator supplies the half of the sentence they will not admit, and the jokes are often paid off several episodes later.
hook_en: After the rich father is arrested, only the second son, Michael, tries to keep the family standing. Everyone else makes it worse. It is one of the comedies you have to watch closely: setups come back episodes, or seasons, later. The first three seasons are the classic run. The fourth and fifth, revived by Netflix, were received less well.

plot: 十二艘外星飞船停在地球各处，舱里的生物用一圈圈墨水一样的符号交流。语言学家路易斯被军方找去，负责弄懂这些符号。
hook: 丹尼斯·维伦纽夫这部有抒情的外星片，根据特德·姜的短篇，是情感上最重的一类科幻。一艘神秘、压下来的外星飞船落到地球，艾米·亚当斯演的语言学家被找去，试着和那些有触手、被称为七肢桶的生物说话。这是她演得最好的角色之一。与其说是入侵，不如说是沟通。《降临》神秘得让人醉，直到结尾那个把时间翻过来的一击。
plot_en: Twelve alien ships stop over different places on Earth. The beings inside communicate with ink-like rings of symbols. The linguist Louise is brought in by the military to work out what the symbols mean.
hook_en: Denis Villeneuve’s lyrical alien film, based on a short story by Ted Chiang, is sci-fi at its most emotionally devastating. When a mysterious, looming extraterrestrial craft lands on Earth, a linguist played by Amy Adams, in a career-best role, is recruited to try to speak to the tentacled beings known as heptapods. Less a saga about invasion than it is about communication, “Arrival” is intoxicatingly mysterious until it wallops you with its time-turning gut punch of an ending.

plot: 厄恩辍学回到亚特兰大，替表兄、说唱歌手纸男孩管理刚起步的事业。城市、种族和名气在这里都不按常理出牌，有的集干脆走进另一个类型。
hook: 表面讲穷小子给当说唱歌手的表弟做经纪人，实际每一集风格都可能不同：有时是荒诞喜剧，有时像恐怖片。它写美国黑人生活很独特，不说教，却处处刺人。第二季的《泰迪·珀金斯》一集尤其出名。
plot_en: Earn drops out and comes back to Atlanta to manage the early career of his cousin, the rapper Paper Boi. The city, race, and fame do not behave as expected here, and some episodes simply walk into another genre.
hook_en: On the surface, a broke young man manages his cousin, a rapper. In practice each episode can be a different kind of show: sometimes an absurd comedy, sometimes something like a horror film. It writes Black life in America in its own way, without lectures, and it keeps pricking. The second-season episode “Teddy Perkins” is the one people single out.

plot: 酒吧里的喜剧演员唐尼对一名女顾客释放了善意，对方开始长期跟踪他。剧情随后转向唐尼自己隐瞒多年的受侵害经历，以及他为何没有立刻切断这段关系。
hook: 根据理查德·加德的真实经历改编：一个失意的喜剧演员被一个女人长期跟踪骚扰。前半段像惊悚剧，后半段揭开他过去遭受性侵的创伤，非常沉重。表演极真实，杰西卡·甘宁演的跟踪者让人难忘。
plot_en: Donny, a comedian working in a bar, offers a kindness to a woman at the bar, and she begins stalking him for a long time. The story then turns to the abuse Donny has hidden for years, and to why he did not cut the relationship off at once.
hook_en: Based on Richard Gadd’s own experience: a struggling comedian is stalked by a woman. The first half plays like a thriller. The second half uncovers the sexual abuse in his past, and it is very heavy. The performances feel real. Jessica Gunning’s stalker stays with you.

plot: 根据斯蒂芬·安布罗斯的记述，跟随美军第 101 空降师 E 连，从佐治亚的训练营走到诺曼底、阿登森林和德军的鹰巢。一连人在减员里重新认识彼此。
hook: 汉克斯和斯皮尔伯格监制，跟着二战美军 101 空降师 E 连从训练一直走到战争结束。每集开头有真实老兵的采访，战争场面真实、残酷。第六集《巴斯托涅》和第九集《我们为何而战》尤其让人难忘。
plot_en: Following Stephen Ambrose’s account, it stays with Easy Company of the 101st Airborne, from training camp in Georgia to Normandy, the Ardennes, and Hitler’s Eagle’s Nest. The company gets to know itself again as the numbers drop.
hook_en: Produced by Hanks and Spielberg, it follows Easy Company of the 101st Airborne from training through the end of the Second World War. Each episode opens with interviews with the real veterans. The fighting is plain and brutal. “Bastogne” and “Why We Fight” are the episodes people remember.

plot: 职业杀手巴里·伯克曼到洛杉矶执行任务，误入一堂表演课，决定自己也许可以成为演员。杀人的手艺和想被看见的欲望开始抢同一个日程。
hook: 一名杀手来洛杉矶接活，误打误撞进了表演班，想转行当演员。开头是黑色喜剧，越往后越黑暗，接近犯罪悲剧。比尔·哈德尔既主演也执导，第二季的《罗尼/莉莉》一集非常出名。
plot_en: The hit man Barry Berkman comes to Los Angeles for a job, wanders into an acting class, and decides he might become an actor. The work of killing and the wish to be seen start competing for the same calendar.
hook_en: A hit man comes to Los Angeles for a job, stumbles into an acting class, and tries to switch careers. It starts as a black comedy and gets darker, closer to a crime tragedy. Bill Hader stars and directs. The second-season episode “ronny/lily” is the famous one.

plot: 机器人赛昂人几乎灭绝人类，残余的舰队在指挥官阿达玛和总统罗斯林带领下寻找传说中的地球。敌人长得和人一样，也可以爱、可以信仰。
hook: 机器人赛昂人几乎灭绝人类，幸存者跟着一艘战舰逃亡。表面是太空科幻，实际讨论战争、宗教、民主和恐怖主义，很多情节明显影射 9·11 之后的美国。前两季最强。
plot_en: The Cylon robots nearly wipe out humanity. What is left of the fleet, under Commander Adama and President Roslin, searches for a legendary Earth. The enemy looks human, and can love, and can believe.
hook_en: The Cylons nearly destroy humanity, and the survivors flee with a warship. It looks like space science fiction and is really about war, religion, democracy, and terrorism. A lot of it clearly shadows the United States after September 11. The first two seasons are the strongest.

plot: 承包商丹尼和店主艾米在停车场互相按了喇叭，一场路怒升级成彼此生活的全面破坏。两个人都在勉强维持一个看起来还行的自己。
hook: 两个陌生人在停车场起了路怒冲突，之后报复不断升级。黑色幽默很强，底下是亚裔家庭、阶层焦虑和孤独。史蒂文·元和黄阿丽演得很好，十集节奏紧凑，共拿下 8 项艾美奖。
plot_en: The contractor Danny and the shop owner Amy honk at each other in a parking lot, and a bout of road rage turns into the wrecking of each other’s lives. Both of them are barely holding up a self that still looks all right.
hook_en: Two strangers get into a road-rage fight in a parking lot, and the revenge keeps escalating. The black humor is strong. Under it are Asian families, class anxiety, and loneliness. Steven Yeun and Ali Wong are very good in it. Ten episodes, tightly paced, and eight Emmys.

plot: 杰西在巴黎的书店为上一本书签售，席琳出现了。距离他飞回美国只剩几个小时，两个人沿着塞纳河走路、说话。
hook: 爱情故事本来不该有续集。理查德·林克莱特 1995 年的《爱在黎明破晓前》已经很难再好：二十出头的杰西和席琳（伊桑·霍克和朱莉·德尔佩）在从布达佩斯开来的火车上相爱。时间过去，却添上了分量。《爱在日落黄昏时》让这两个错过的人在三十多岁重逢，中间攒下的情感包袱，让第二次试着相爱更抓人。
plot_en: Jesse is signing his last book in a Paris bookshop when Céline appears. He has a few hours before his flight back to the United States. The two of them walk along the Seine and talk.
hook_en: You’re not supposed to make a sequel to a love story. Certainly, it’s hard to imagine improving on “Before Sunrise,” Richard Linklater’s 1995 gem about 20-somethings Jesse and Celine (Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy), who fall for each other on a train from Budapest. But the passage of time adds poignancy, and when “Before Sunset” reunites those star-crossed lovers in their 30s, the emotional baggage they’ve accrued in the meantime makes their second stab at love even more involving.

plot: 几组差别很大的人带着自己的狗，从各地赶到费城参加全国犬展。镜头轮流跟着他们上路、入住，直到比赛当天牵狗入场。
hook: 这部片子上映时，克里斯托弗·盖斯特已经用《等待古夫曼》把伪纪录片做熟了。他在精英犬展这个荒唐的世界里找到了最合适的题材。他那组靠即兴的演员，把对狗着迷的人做成忘不掉的角色：帕克·波西演的雅皮士戴着牙套、爱目录，养着一只魏玛犬；尤金·列维演的梗犬主人会唱歌，而且真的有两只左脚。尽管一切都疯，对这些笨蛋和他们的狗，片子是温柔的。
plot_en: Several very different people bring their dogs from around the country to Philadelphia for a national dog show. The camera follows them on the road and into their hotels, up to the moment they walk the dogs into the ring.
hook_en: By the time this was released, Christopher Guest had already mastered the mockumentary with “Waiting for Guffman.” But he found the perfect subject matter in the wacky world of elite dog shows. His trusty group of improvisers created indelible characters out of canine obsessives, like Parker Posey’s catalog-loving yuppie with braces and a Weimaraner, and Eugene Levy’s singing terrier-owner who quite literally has two left feet. For as mad as it all is, there’s a sweetness directed at these goofballs and their pooches.

plot: 吉米·麦吉尔是个滑头律师，哥哥查克看不起他，女友金姆比他更清楚界线在哪。为了成为索尔·古德曼，他把自己一点点改名、改行、改掉。
hook: 《绝命毒师》的前传，讲吉米怎样变成索尔·古德曼。节奏比原作慢，人物更细腻，瑞亚·西霍恩演的金是全剧最好的角色之一。没看过《绝命毒师》也能看，看过会更痛。
plot_en: Jimmy McGill is a slippery lawyer. His brother Chuck looks down on him, and his girlfriend Kim knows where the line is better than he does. To become Saul Goodman he renames himself, changes his trade, and changes himself, a piece at a time.
hook_en: A prequel to Breaking Bad, about how Jimmy becomes Saul Goodman. It is slower than the original, and the people are drawn more finely. Rhea Seehorn’s Kim is one of the best roles in the show. You can watch it without Breaking Bad. If you have seen Breaking Bad, it hurts more.

plot: 洛杉矶女演员山姆独自拉扯三个女儿，接戏、照顾母亲，也在一个不太把她当主角的行业里保持自己的日子。情节很散，一天就是一天。
hook: 单亲妈妈山姆是个演员，在洛杉矶养三个女儿，还要照顾住在对面的母亲。剧情很生活化，常常只是一些争吵、做饭、开车的片段，却非常真实。适合喜欢女性视角和家庭题材的观众。
plot_en: Sam, an actress in Los Angeles, raises three daughters on her own, takes jobs, looks after her mother, and keeps her own days going in an industry that does not treat her as the lead. The plot is loose. A day is a day.
hook_en: Sam, a single mother and an actress, is raising three daughters in Los Angeles and looking after her mother across the street. The episodes are ordinary life: arguments, cooking, driving, and they feel true. It suits people who want a woman’s point of view and stories about family.

plot: 每一集都是一个邻近的未来：记忆可以重播，社交可以打分，意识可以拷进另一具身体。技术很少是唯一的反派，使用它的欲望才是。
hook: 单元剧，每集一个近未来科技故事：社交评分、记忆回放、意识上传，技术总在放大人性的弱点。不用按顺序看，可以先挑《圣朱尼佩洛》《白熊》《急转直下》这些口碑集。前三季整体最稳。
plot_en: Each episode is a near future: memory can be replayed, social life can be scored, a mind can be copied into another body. The technology is rarely the only villain. The desire to use it is.
hook_en: An anthology. Each episode is a near-future technology story: social scores, memory playback, uploading a mind. The technology magnifies a weakness in people. You do not have to watch in order. Start with the well-liked ones: “San Junipero,” “White Bear,” and “Nosedive.” The first three seasons are the steadiest.

plot: 特查拉回到瓦坎达即位。流亡在外的埃里克带着父亲留下的委屈回来争夺王位，也要把这个国家藏起来的技术交到外面的人手里。
hook: 可爱的东西太多了。这是一场超级英雄奇观，而且真的有重要的话要说：身份、历史和责任怎样交在一起。瓦坎达，故事发生的那个非洲未来世界，是视觉上的奇观。女人（安吉拉·贝塞特、达娜·古瑞拉、露皮塔·尼永奥和莱蒂希娅·赖特，都很好）不只是配角或爱情对象。迈克尔·B·乔丹演悲剧性的反派基尔蒙格，从来没有这么让人倾倒。当然，查德维克·博斯曼在片名角色里发光。悲伤的是，这是他因癌症去世之前最后的角色之一。
plot_en: T’Challa returns to Wakanda to take the throne. Erik, in exile, comes back with his father’s grievance to contest the crown, and to put the technology the country has been hiding into other people’s hands.
hook_en: There’s so much to love. It’s a superhero spectacle that actually has something important to say, about how identity, history and responsibility intersect. Wakanda, the Afrofuturistic world where the story takes place, is a visual wonder. The women (played by Angela Bassett, Danai Gurira, Lupita Nyong’o and Letitia Wright — all excellent) aren’t just sidekicks or love interests. Michael B. Jordan, as the tragically villainous Killmonger, has never been more swoon worthy. And, of course, Chadwick Boseman shines in the title role, sadly one of his last before dying of cancer.

plot: 芭蕾舞者妮娜争取《天鹅湖》里白天鹅和黑天鹅两个角色。导演逼她放出自己控制不住的那一面，她开始在排练厅和家里看见另一个自己。
hook: 追求完美的动力，和不健康的执念，界线在哪里？娜塔莉·波特曼凭妮娜这个角色拿到奥斯卡最佳女主角。她是芭蕾舞者，和对手（米拉·库尼斯）争《天鹅湖》的主角，被推进疯狂。导演达伦·阿伦诺夫斯基把这部心理惊悚片的紧张和失去方向感拧紧，直到我们的头和舞者一起转。妮娜幻觉的那些场面，把身体恐怖做成一种忘不掉的暗的华丽。
plot_en: The ballet dancer Nina is competing for both the White Swan and the Black Swan in Swan Lake. The director pushes her to let out the side of herself she cannot control, and she starts seeing another self in the rehearsal room and at home.
hook_en: Where is the line between the drive for perfection and unhealthy obsession? Natalie Portman took home the best actress Oscar for her role as Nina, a ballerina whose competition with a rival (Mila Kunis) for the lead role in “Swan Lake” pushes her into madness. The director Darren Aronofsky ratchets up the tension and disorientation in this psychological thriller until our heads are spinning along with the dancers. The scenes depicting Nina’s hallucinations infuse body horror with an unforgettable dark grandeur.

plot: 过气马明星波杰克住在好莱坞，靠酒、自怜和一部旧情景喜剧的重播过日子。动物和人混居的城市很好笑，直到他造成的伤害不再能用笑话盖住。
hook: 看起来是一部荒诞的动物动画，实际在讨论抑郁、成瘾、童年创伤和名人的自我毁灭。前半季常常在搞笑，后半季会突然变得很重。第三季几乎无对白的海底一集，以及第五季的葬礼独白一集，都很经典。
plot_en: BoJack, a washed-up horse star, lives in Hollywood on alcohol, self-pity, and the reruns of an old sitcom. The city where animals and people live together is funny, until the damage he causes can no longer be covered by a joke.
hook_en: It looks like an absurd cartoon about animals. It is about depression, addiction, childhood damage, and a celebrity destroying himself. The first half of a season is often the jokes. The second half can turn heavy without warning. The almost wordless underwater episode in season three, and the eulogy episode in season five, are the ones people come back to.

plot: 哈萨克记者博拉特奉命到美国拍一部了解当地文化的纪录片。他带着制片人走访各地，用采访把遇到的人推进他自己准备好的剧本。
hook: 萨莎·拜伦·科恩把博拉特·萨格季耶夫带到电影院时，给了美国一次彻底的、大笑的恶作剧。这个哈萨克电视记者，他以前在《阿里 G 秀》里演过。博拉特周游全国，想去见帕梅拉·安德森，让陌生人卸下伪装却出奇地容易。在一场牛仔竞技上，观众对他把哈萨克斯坦所谓的国歌唱出来，比对他说乔治·W·布什该“喝干伊拉克每一个男人、女人和孩子的血”，似乎更不舒服。
plot_en: Borat, a Kazakh journalist, is sent to the United States to film a documentary about the local culture. He and his producer travel the country, using interviews to push the people they meet into the script he has already prepared.
hook_en: Sacha Baron Cohen gave the United States a thorough, uproarious pranking when he brought Borat Sagdiyev, the Kazakh TV reporter he had played on “Da Ali G Show,” to movie screens. As Borat travels the country hoping to meet Pamela Anderson, he has alarmingly little trouble getting strangers to slip their masks: At a rodeo, spectators seem less disturbed about Borat’s call for George W. Bush to “drink the blood of every single man, woman and child of Iraq” than about his singing of Kazakhstan’s supposed national anthem.

plot: 父母离婚后，梅森跟着母亲在德州一次次搬家。继父进来又离开，父亲偶尔出现，他自己慢慢有了女朋友，直到离开家去上大学。
hook: 一个很大胆的做法：断断续续拍了十多年。理查德·林克莱特把它用得很低的调子完成。他拍德州小镇的孩子梅森（埃拉尔·科尔特兰）怎样走过父母离婚、初恋，以及青春期里别的难处和顺处。出来的是一部少见的成长片，又扎人，又甜。
plot_en: After his parents divorce, Mason moves around Texas with his mother. Stepfathers arrive and leave, his father shows up now and then, and he slowly gets a girlfriend, until he leaves home for college.
hook_en: An audacious concept — the movie was shot, in start-and-stop fashion, over more than a decade — meets a winningly low-key execution in Richard Linklater’s acute, unhurried portrait of a small-town Texas kid (Ellar Coltrane) navigating his parents’ divorce, first crushes and other travails and triumphs of adolescence. The result is a coming-of-age drama of uncommon loveliness, both piercing and sweet.

plot: 高中化学老师沃尔特·怀特确诊肺癌，为了给家人留下钱，与前学生杰西合伙制造冰毒。一条房车里的生计，慢慢变成一座他不肯交出的帝国。
hook: 看一个普通人怎样一步步变成毒枭，每次转变都有前因，不是突然黑化。克兰斯顿凭这个角色拿了四座艾美剧情类男主角。前两季稍慢，越往后越紧；第五季的《奥兹曼迪亚斯》常被评为美剧史上最好的单集之一。
plot_en: Walter White, a high-school chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with lung cancer. To leave money for his family he partners with his former student Jesse and starts making meth. A living made in a trailer slowly becomes an empire he will not hand over.
hook_en: You watch an ordinary man become a drug lord, and each turn has a cause. He does not simply go bad. Cranston won four Emmys for best actor in a drama for the role. The first two seasons are a little slow, and it tightens after that. “Ozymandias,” in the fifth season, is often called one of the best single episodes in American television.

plot: 安妮的蛋糕店倒了，手头的恋情也一塌糊涂。闺蜜莉莲要结婚，请她当伴娘，另一位有钱的伴娘处处跟她比。
hook: 2011 年，倒霉的安妮（克丽丝滕·威格）、刚订婚的闺蜜莉莲（玛娅·鲁道夫），以及莉莲那个有钱的朋友（罗丝·拜恩），引出了关于女人、低俗喜剧和票房的讨论。今天再看，威格和安妮·穆莫洛的剧本仍然能让人笑出声，配角也够复杂：梅丽莎·麦卡西演的那位离谱的未来嫂子，吉尔·克莱伯勒演的糊涂妈妈。保罗·费格这部片子让人意外的是它有感情：安妮又难过又嫉妒，自己挡自己的路。我们都有过，虽然未必伴随着爆炸性的腹泻。
plot_en: Annie’s cake shop has failed, and so has the relationship she is in. Her friend Lillian is getting married and asks her to be a bridesmaid. Another, wealthy bridesmaid competes with her at every turn.
hook_en: In 2011, the story of down-on-her-luck Annie (Kristen Wiig), her newly engaged bestie, Lillian (Maya Rudolph), and Lillian’s wealthy pal (Rose Byrne) inspired discussions of women, gross-out comedy and box-office power. Today, the script by Wiig and Annie Mumolo remains laugh-out-loud funny, with impressively complex side characters (Melissa McCarthy’s bananas future sister-in-law; Jill Clayburgh’s daffy mom). What surprises is how deeply felt this Paul Feig film is: Annie is sad and jealous, unable to get out of her own way. We’ve all been there, though perhaps not with explosive diarrhea.

plot: 艾比和伊拉娜在纽约打工、迷路、帮忙，也不断把对方拖进更糟的主意。友情不是背景，是每一集要完成的正事。
hook: 两个纽约女孩没钱也没事业，每天在城里乱逛、闯祸、互相夸奖。它是少见的以女性友谊为中心的喜剧，不靠恋爱推进。由网络短剧发展而来，风格松散，很适合下饭。
plot_en: Abbi and Ilana work, get lost, and help each other in New York, and keep pulling each other into worse ideas. The friendship is not the background. It is the thing each episode has to get done.
hook_en: Two women in New York have no money and no career. They wander the city, get into trouble, and compliment each other. It is one of the few comedies built on a friendship between women, and it does not move forward on a romance. It grew out of web shorts. The style is loose, and it is easy to watch while you eat.

plot: 1963 年，恩尼斯和杰克被雇去山上放羊，夏天结束之后各回各家。后来很多年，他们以钓鱼为名见面，两边都有了妻子和孩子。
hook: “那部同性恋牛仔片”做的不止是让办公室有话说，也不止是拿了好几座奥斯卡。它把最佳影片输给《撞车》，至今仍是奥斯卡历史上出了名的一桩。李安这部节制、节奏很慢的西部片，把怀俄明两个牧场工人（希斯·莱杰和杰克·吉伦哈尔）的秘密恋情，拍成电影里少有的悲剧爱情。好看，也伤人。
plot_en: In 1963 Ennis and Jack are hired to herd sheep in the mountains. When the summer ends they go back to their own lives. For years afterward they meet on the excuse of fishing. Both have wives and children.
hook_en: “The gay cowboy movie” did more than start water-cooler conversations and win several Oscars (its best picture loss to “Crash” remains a notorious bugaboo of Oscar lore). Ang Lee’s austere, gently paced western turned a clandestine romance between two Wyoming ranch hands (Heath Ledger and Jake Gyllenhaal) into one of cinema’s great tragic love stories, as aesthetically beautiful as it was emotionally shattering.

plot: 1983 年夏天，埃利奥在意大利的家里认识了来协助父亲做研究的美国研究生奥利弗。几周里两个人从试探走到一起。夏天结束，奥利弗要回美国。
hook: 最好的爱情故事，真的是关于心碎吗？在卢卡·瓜达尼诺这部杰作里，埃利奥（蒂莫西·查拉梅因此走红）和奥利弗（艾米·汉莫）在意大利北部过了一个温柔、互相逗弄的夏天。给片子深度的是这段关系结束之后：埃利奥哭着给母亲打电话，父亲温和的判断，以及最后那场戏，埃利奥在我们眼前长大。爱情即使很短，也能把人改成后来一直那样。
plot_en: In the summer of 1983, at his family’s house in Italy, Elio meets Oliver, an American graduate student who has come to help Elio’s father with his research. Over a few weeks the two of them move from testing each other to being together. When the summer ends, Oliver goes back to the United States.
hook_en: Are the best love stories really about heartbreak? In Luca Guadagnino’s masterpiece, Elio (Timothée Chalamet in his breakout role) and Oliver (Armie Hammer) share a tender, teasing summer romance in northern Italy. But it’s the aftermath of their affair that gives the film its depth — Elio’s tearful call to his mother, his father’s gentle wisdom and the unforgettable final scene in which Elio matures before our eyes. Even when love is fleeting, it can transform us in ways that last forever.

plot: 1950 年代，百货公司店员特芮丝在柜台边遇见来给女儿买礼物的卡罗尔。卡罗尔正在打一场对她不利的离婚官司，两个人还是一起出了门。
hook: 可以把它叫做女同性恋版的《断背山》：一段动人的同性爱情，大明星（凯特·布兰切特、鲁妮·玛拉），除了它存在这件事，并不政治。时间设在 1950 年代，那时同性恋靠把自己关起来活下去。注意《卡罗尔》里汽车旅馆的百叶窗，投下的影子像监狱的铁条。它的结尾却稍稍更快乐。布兰切特演的上流社会母亲必须放弃心爱的女儿的监护权，但她至少不再害怕自己的性向。玛拉演的年轻摄影师在结尾说出口：“我不怕。”
plot_en: In the 1950s the department-store clerk Therese meets Carol at the counter, where Carol has come to buy a gift for her daughter. Carol is in the middle of a divorce that is going against her. The two of them leave together anyway.
hook_en: You could call it the lesbian “Brokeback Mountain” — a moving same-sex love story with big stars (Cate Blanchett, Rooney Mara), unpolitical except that it exists, set in a time (in this case, the 1950s) when gay people survived through self-imprisonment (notice how the motel blinds in “Carol” cast prison-bar shadows). “Carol,” however, ends on a slightly happier note. Blanchett’s high-society mother must relinquish custody of her beloved daughter, but she’s at least no longer fearful of her sexuality. Mara’s young photographer says it aloud at the end: “I’m not afraid.”

plot: 爱尔兰女人莎朗和美国男人罗布在伦敦有了一段短暂的关系，然后是一次计划外的怀孕。他们决定留下孩子，并试着把陌生人的礼貌变成婚姻。
hook: 美国男人和爱尔兰女人在伦敦一夜情后意外怀孕，决定在一起。这是一部很成人化的爱情喜剧，对白粗俗、坦诚又好笑。每集约 25 分钟，写婚姻和育儿很真实。
plot_en: Sharon, from Ireland, and Rob, from the United States, have a short relationship in London, and then an unplanned pregnancy. They decide to keep the child and try to turn the politeness of strangers into a marriage.
hook_en: An American man and an Irish woman have a one-night stand in London, she gets pregnant, and they decide to stay together. It is a very adult romantic comedy: the dialogue is crude, honest, and funny. Episodes run about 25 minutes. The marriage and the child-rearing feel real.

plot: 查普尔用短剧和现场观众谈话，把种族、名人和电视本身的假正经拆开。许多段子后来被反复引用，也变成他和节目关系破裂的一部分。
hook: 戴夫·查普尔的小品秀，大胆处理种族、名人和流行文化，「瑞克·詹姆斯」等段子至今仍被引用。节目巅峰期，查普尔突然离开，引发大量讨论，最后只完整播出了两季。
plot_en: Chappelle uses sketches and talk with the studio audience to take apart race, celebrity, and the false propriety of television. Many of the bits were quoted for years afterward, and became part of the break between him and the show.
hook_en: Dave Chappelle’s sketch show, which handles race, celebrity, and pop culture directly. Bits such as “Rick James” are still quoted. At the height of the show, Chappelle walked away, and that departure was argued over at length. Only two seasons were completed.

plot: 1986 年，切尔诺贝利核电站爆炸。科学家列加索夫、官员谢尔比纳和核物理学家霍缪克要在谎言已经发出去之后，把还没做完的灾难拦住。
hook: 五集迷你剧还原 1986 年核事故，从爆炸当夜一直讲到事后审判。最可怕的不是辐射画面，而是官僚系统怎样掩盖真相。氛围压抑，细节考究，豆瓣评分在 9 分以上。
plot_en: In 1986 the Chernobyl nuclear plant explodes. The scientist Legasov, the official Shcherbina, and the nuclear physicist Khomyuk have to stop a disaster that is not finished, after the lie has already gone out.
hook_en: A five-episode miniseries of the 1986 nuclear accident, from the night of the explosion through the hearings afterward. What is most frightening is not the images of radiation. It is how the bureaucracy covered up what had happened. The atmosphere is oppressive, the detail is careful, and the Douban score sits above 9.

plot: 世界上已经十八年没有婴儿出生。前活动分子西奥被旧识找来，护送一个忽然怀孕的年轻难民，穿过英国的检查站。
hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部科幻片里，近未来很暗，几乎每一场戏却都漂亮。女人不再能怀孕，人类差不多没了希望。在一个敌视难民、处处设卡的英国，公务员西奥（克里夫·欧文）得去保护一个新来的人（克莱尔-霍普·阿什蒂），她是世界上唯一怀孕的女人。表演像在生活里，故事像提前看见了后来的事，埃曼努尔·卢贝兹基的摄影很耀眼。一场从行驶的车里拍下来的一镜到底伏击，会让人看呆。
plot_en: No baby has been born in the world for eighteen years. Theo, a former activist, is asked by an old acquaintance to escort a young refugee who has suddenly become pregnant through the checkpoints of Britain.
hook_en: While the near future is bleak in Alfonso Cuarón’s sci-fi drama, almost every scene is a stunner. Women have become infertile, and hope for the human race is all but gone, but in a locked-down Britain hostile to refugees, a bureaucrat (Clive Owen) finds himself in a position to protect a newcomer (Clare-Hope Ashitey), the only pregnant woman in the world. The performances are lived-in, the narrative is prescient and Emmanuel Lubezki’s camerawork dazzles. A one-shot ambush sequence filmed from inside a moving vehicle will leave you agape.

plot: 火箭想当摄影师，不想加入贩毒。和他一起长大的里欧则在里约的贫民窟里把地盘和枪都抓到自己手里。故事从几支枪的转手讲起。
hook: 一个少年逼一个更小的少年去杀一个更小的孩子。被害的孩子缩在像游戏围栏一样的院子里。旁边另一个大约五岁的孩子在哭，脚被打穿了，为了传话，也为了好玩。一部电影里有这样的场面，却还能让人感到恶心以外的东西，靠的是叙事的复杂、耀眼的视觉和有魅力的演员。它是对里约热内卢上帝之城贫民窟里如何活下去的思索，很痛，也有诗意。
plot_en: Rocket wants to be a photographer, not a drug dealer. Li’l Zé, who grew up with him, takes the territory and the guns in a Rio slum into his own hands. The story starts with a few guns changing owners.
hook_en: A teenager forces a younger teenager to kill an even younger child. The victim cowers inside a fenced patio that resembles a playpen. Nearby sobs another child, who looks about 5; he’s been shot in the foot — to send a message, but also for fun. That a film can contain this scene and somehow make you feel anything but sick is a testament to its narrative complexity, dazzling visual style and charismatic cast. It’s a harrowing yet poetic meditation on survival in Rio de Janeiro’s Cidade de Deus slum.

plot: 被取消律师资格的杰夫·温格进入一所社区大学，凑出了一个什么课都一起上的学习小组。剧经常整集改成另一种类型：动作片、纪录片、八比特游戏。
hook: 一群背景各异的人在社区大学组成学习小组。它常常整集戏仿各种类型片，比如彩弹枪大战、黑帮片和纪录片。第二、三季最强；后期主创被解雇又回归，质量起伏较大。
plot_en: Jeff Winger, disbarred, enrolls at a community college and assembles a study group that takes every class together. The show will spend a whole episode as another genre: an action movie, a documentary, an 8-bit game.
hook_en: A group of people with nothing in common form a study group at a community college. Whole episodes parody a genre: paintball, a gangster film, a documentary. Seasons two and three are the strongest. The creator was later fired and then brought back, and the quality swings.

plot: 李慕白托俞秀莲把青冥剑送给贝勒爷，剑在路上被玉娇龙抢走。秀莲追剑，罗小虎在沙漠里等娇龙做选择，李慕白把很多话留在嘴里。
hook: 李安这部武侠片由杨紫琼、周润发和章子怡主演。上映时东西方观众都买账，这在当时很少见，票房纪录也被它打破。动作戏把轻功和压住的爱情、不被允许的前途放在一起。忘不掉的是杨紫琼的剑客和章子怡演的贼用一堆兵器对打，以及周润发和章子怡在竹林里那场像芭蕾一样的剑斗。
plot_en: Li Mu Bai asks Yu Shu Lien to take the Green Destiny sword to Sir Te. Jade Fox’s pupil Jen steals it on the way. Shu Lien goes after the sword, Lo waits in the desert for Jen to choose, and Li Mu Bai leaves a great deal unsaid.
hook_en: When Ang Lee debuted this wuxia masterpiece starring Michelle Yeoh, Chow Yun-fat and Zhang Ziyi, the film appealed to Western and Eastern audiences alike, a rarity at the time, and demolished box-office records. This action drama marries acrobatic, aerodynamic martial arts with repressed love and forbidden futures. Seared in memory: the showdown between Yeoh’s swordswoman and the thief played by Zhang using a multitude of weapons, and the balletic sword fight between Chow’s warrior and Zhang in a bamboo forest.

plot: 拉里·戴维扮演一个和自己同名的电视编剧，在洛杉矶把每一件小事——小费、葬礼、一句招呼——发展成社交灾难。大纲是定的，对白常常是即兴。
hook: 《宋飞正传》主创拉里·戴维本色出演自己，专门把生活小事闹成灾难，比如该不该给小费、能不能多拿一份试吃。没有完整剧本，只有剧情大纲，对白多靠演员现场即兴，所以尴尬感特别真。单集基本独立，从哪集开始都行。
plot_en: Larry David plays a television writer with his own name, and in Los Angeles turns every small thing — a tip, a funeral, a hello — into a social disaster. The outline is set. The dialogue is often improvised.
hook_en: Larry David, the creator of Seinfeld, plays a version of himself and specializes in turning small questions into disasters: whether to tip, whether you can take another sample. There is no full script, only an outline, and a lot of the dialogue is improvised, so the embarrassment feels real. Episodes mostly stand alone. You can start anywhere.

plot: 1870 年代，达科他领地的死木镇还没有正式的法，金矿、酒馆和妓院先到了。警长塞思·布洛克和酒馆老板艾尔·斯韦尔恩根商量这座镇子归谁管。
hook: 1870 年代南达科他的淘金小镇还没有法律，秩序靠酒馆老板和警长一点点建立。台词半古典、半粗口，像莎士比亚写的西部片。伊恩·麦柯肖恩演的艾尔是全剧灵魂。只拍了三季就被砍，2019 年出了一部电影收尾。
plot_en: In the 1870s the town of Deadwood, in the Dakota Territory, has no formal law yet. The gold, the saloons, and the brothels arrive first. Sheriff Seth Bullock and the saloon owner Al Swearengen negotiate who runs the town.
hook_en: A gold-rush town in 1870s South Dakota has no law. Order is built, a piece at a time, by a saloon owner and a sheriff. The dialogue is half classical and half obscenity, like a western written by Shakespeare. Ian McShane’s Al is the soul of the show. It was cancelled after three seasons. A film in 2019 closed it.

plot: 迈阿密警队的血迹分析师德克斯特遵守养父留下的准则，只杀死漏网的杀人犯。白天他学着做普通人，夜里把另一套生活收进冷藏袋。
hook: 迈阿密警局的血迹分析师德克斯特，私下是只杀坏人的连环杀手。前四季最好，第四季的「三位一体杀手」是全剧高峰。后几季明显下滑，原版结局评价很差。
plot_en: Dexter, a blood-spatter analyst for the Miami police, follows a code his adoptive father left him and kills only murderers who got away. By day he learns how to be an ordinary person. At night he packs the other life into freezer bags.
hook_en: Dexter, a blood-spatter analyst for the Miami police, is privately a serial killer who only kills people he judges guilty. The first four seasons are the best. The Trinity Killer, in season four, is the peak. The later seasons drop off, and the original ending was badly received.

plot: 1912 年之后的约克郡庄园，克劳利一家和楼下的仆人被同一座房子绑在一起。继承、战争和新兴的中产，慢慢改掉楼上楼下的规矩。
hook: 20 世纪初的英国贵族庄园，楼上是格兰瑟姆伯爵一家，楼下是仆人。剧情像高级家庭肥皂剧，服装、礼仪和时代变迁都拍得很好看。玛吉·史密斯演的老夫人几乎每句台词都是金句。
plot_en: After 1912, on an estate in Yorkshire, the Crawley family and the servants downstairs are tied to the same house. Inheritance, war, and a rising middle class slowly change the rules above and below stairs.
hook_en: An English aristocratic house at the start of the twentieth century. Upstairs is the Earl of Grantham’s family. Downstairs are the servants. It plays like a high-end family soap. The clothes, the manners, and the change of the era are all good to look at. Maggie Smith’s dowager has a line worth keeping almost every time she speaks.

plot: 过气棒球投手肯尼·鲍尔斯回到家乡，在中学当体育老师，同时确信自己仍是明星。粗话、毒品和一场并不存在的复出，构成他的生活安排。
hook: 过气棒球明星肯尼·鲍尔斯回乡当体育老师，自大、粗鲁、满嘴脏话。笑点很低俗，但也是对美式男子气概的讽刺。丹尼·麦克布莱德演得非常放得开。
plot_en: Kenny Powers, a baseball pitcher past his prime, comes home and teaches phys ed at the middle school, while remaining sure he is still a star. Obscenity, drugs, and a comeback that does not exist are how he arranges his life.
hook_en: Kenny Powers, a washed-up baseball star, comes home to teach phys ed. He is vain, rude, and foul-mouthed. The jokes are low, and they are also a satire of an American idea of manhood. Danny McBride plays him without holding back.

plot: 艾米·杰利科在公司崩溃后去静修，回来决心成为更好的人，并向曾经伤害她的企业发起举报。她的善意经常是真的，方法经常是灾难。
hook: 劳拉·邓恩演一个情绪崩溃后去疗养中心「开悟」的女人。回到公司后，她想做好人、揭发公司，却总把场面弄得很难堪。主创迈克·怀特后来做了《白莲花度假村》。只有两季，评价高，知道的人却不多。
plot_en: After Amy Jellicoe breaks down at her company, she goes on a retreat and comes back determined to be a better person, and to blow the whistle on the company that hurt her. Her goodwill is often real. Her methods are often a disaster.
hook_en: Laura Dern plays a woman who has a breakdown and comes back from a retreat “enlightened.” At the company she tries to be good and to expose it, and keeps making the room unbearable. The creator, Mike White, later made The White Lotus. Two seasons, highly regarded, and not widely known.

plot: 乔尔发现前女友克莱门汀已经把自己从记忆里删掉，于是也去做同样的手术。删除进行的时候，他在脑子里拼命想把她留下来。
hook: 有时一部电影新得、怪得让人怀疑自己是不是在做梦。米歇尔·冈瑞导演，查理·考夫曼编剧，这个梦远远超出了爱情喜剧的中心。凯特·温斯莱特和金·凯瑞演一对已经分手的人，决定把这段关系从记忆里抹掉。片子一半顽皮，一半往心里捅，强调的是：这些记忆，哪怕是很糟的记忆，怎样把我们塑成现在这样。
plot_en: Joel discovers that his ex-girlfriend Clementine has had him erased from her memory, and goes to have the same procedure. While the deletion is underway, he tries, inside his own mind, to keep her.
hook_en: Sometimes a movie comes along that is so wildly inventive and wonderfully strange, you wonder if you dreamed it. Directed by Michel Gondry from a screenplay by Charlie Kaufman, this dream ventures far beyond its rom-com center. Kate Winslet and Jim Carrey play a broken-up couple who opt to get memories of their relationship erased. The movie — equal parts playful and gutting — emphasizes how strongly such memories, even terrible ones, shape us.

plot: 伊芙琳在洗衣店楼上准备接待税务员，父亲从中国来访，女儿也不肯好好说话。另一个宇宙里的丈夫告诉她，她是唯一能跳进自己所有人生的人。
hook: 手指是热狗的时候，你怎么打字？关家永和丹尼尔·施纳特这部野心得离谱的电影，会让你问这个，以及许多你从没想过要问的问题。主意一桶一桶地倒下来，它本不该这么管用。这两位脚步很稳的电影作者，把多元宇宙、跨类型的叙事，收成关于爱和家庭的实话。原来那些热狗手指，拥抱起来很容易。
plot_en: Evelyn is upstairs from the laundromat, preparing to meet a tax auditor. Her father is visiting from China, and her daughter will not talk to her properly. A husband from another universe tells her she is the only one who can jump into all of her lives.
hook_en: How do you type when you have hot dogs for fingers? Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert’s wildly inventive movie might have you asking this, and so many other questions you never thought you would contemplate. Raining down ideas by the bucketful, this movie should not work as well as it does, but the sure-footed filmmakers distill their multiverse-themed, genre-hopping narrative into truths about love and family. Turns out those hot dog fingers can hug easily.

plot: 十五岁的米娅住在埃塞克斯的公屋里，和母亲、妹妹互相看不顺眼，自己关起门来跳舞。母亲的新男友康纳搬进来，对她跳舞的事表现出兴趣。
hook: 讲青春期女孩的电影，很少这么生、这么敢。安德里亚·阿诺德的故事里，女孩（凯蒂·贾维斯）拼命想当嘻哈舞者，母亲的新男友（迈克尔·法斯宾德）鼓励这件事。片子真正讲的是她正在醒来的热情，性的、家庭的，以及其他的，也讲这个看起来很硬的女孩有多容易受伤。它无畏，带电，是阿诺德最好的作品之一。
plot_en: Fifteen-year-old Mia lives on an Essex estate, cannot stand her mother or her sister, and dances behind a closed door. Her mother’s new boyfriend, Connor, moves in and takes an interest in the dancing.
hook_en: Few movies about adolescent girls are quite this raw or daring. Andrea Arnold’s story concerns a girl (Katie Jarvis) who desperately wants to be a hip-hop dancer, a pursuit her mother’s new boyfriend (Michael Fassbender) encourages. But really the film is about her awakening passions, sexual and familial and more, and the ways in which this seemingly tough girl is achingly vulnerable. It’s fearless and electric, one of Arnold’s finest.

plot: 一个在伦敦经营咖啡馆的女人，用对镜头说话来躲开家人、顾客和自己的悲伤。第二季里，她遇到一位同样不该越界的神父。
hook: 女主不停对着镜头吐槽，你先被逗笑，后来才发现她在用玩笑躲开悲伤。两季共 12 集，一个下午就能看完。第二季加入安德鲁·斯科特饰演的神父，拿下 2019 年艾美喜剧类最佳剧集、女主角、编剧和导演。
plot_en: A woman running a café in London talks to the camera to get away from her family, her customers, and her own grief. In the second season she meets a priest who is not supposed to cross the line either.
hook_en: The heroine keeps complaining to the camera. You laugh first, and later realize she is using the jokes to stay away from grief. Two seasons, twelve episodes, an afternoon. The second season adds Andrew Scott’s priest. It won the 2019 Emmys for comedy series, lead actress, writing, and directing.

plot: 弗兰西丝在纽约学舞蹈，和最好的朋友索菲合租。索菲决定搬走之后，她开始在别人家里短住，工作也没有着落。
hook: 格蕾塔·葛韦格自己出去拍《伯德小姐》之前，她上升的第一个迹象是《弗兰西丝·哈》。剧本是她和导演诺亚·鲍姆巴赫一起写的。葛韦格也出演弗兰西丝，一个二十多岁末尾的女人，抓着自己的青春，方式既压不住地快乐，又很不成熟。黑白画面带着怀旧。《弗兰西丝·哈》是一次人物研究，抓住的是成年抓住人的那个时刻。
plot_en: Frances is studying dance in New York and shares an apartment with her best friend Sophie. After Sophie decides to move out, Frances starts staying short stretches in other people’s homes, and the work dries up.
hook_en: Before Greta Gerwig struck out on her own to make “Lady Bird,” the first sign of her ascension was “Frances Ha,” which she co-wrote with the director Noah Baumbach. Gerwig also stars as Frances, a woman in her late 20s who is holding onto her youth in a way that is both irrepressibly joyful and deeply immature. Shot in nostalgic black and white, “Frances Ha” is a character study that captures the moment adulthood takes hold.

plot: 得州迪隆镇用周五的高中橄榄球衡量几乎一切。教练埃里克·泰勒和妻子塔米要在胜负、孩子的前途和自己的婚姻之间做每周的决定。
hook: 背景是得州小镇的高中橄榄球队，但不懂橄榄球也完全能看，重点是小镇里的人。教练和妻子的婚姻常被称为美剧里最真实的夫妻关系之一。大量手持摄影和即兴表演，让人物显得格外自然。
plot_en: The town of Dillon, Texas, measures almost everything by Friday-night high-school football. The coach Eric Taylor and his wife Tami make the week’s decisions between winning, the children’s futures, and their own marriage.
hook_en: The setting is a high-school football team in a Texas town, and you can watch it without knowing the sport. The point is the people in the town. The coach’s marriage is often called one of the most believable marriages on American television. A lot of handheld camera and improvisation makes the people feel unusually natural.

plot: 维斯特洛的几个家族争夺铁王座，北境的长城外面还有一场被大多数人当成传说的冬天。改编自乔治·R·R·马丁的小说，贵族的联姻和战场用的是同一套规则。
hook: 奇幻外壳下是一部权谋剧。主角随时可能死掉，谁都不安全，这是前几季最抓人的地方。制作规模接近电影，《黑水之战》《私生子之战》都是剧集战争场面的标杆。最后一季口碑大跌，前六季仍然值得看。
plot_en: Several houses in Westeros contest the Iron Throne. Beyond the Wall in the north, a winter that most people treat as legend is also coming. Adapted from the novels of George R. R. Martin, the nobles’ marriages and the battles run on the same set of rules.
hook_en: Under the fantasy is a show about power. Lead characters can die at any time, and no one is safe. That is what made the early seasons grip. The scale of the production is close to a film. “Blackwater” and “The Battle of the Bastards” set a standard for war on television. The last season’s reputation collapsed. The first six are still worth watching.

plot: 克里斯跟着白人女友回她家的乡下过周末。父母热情得过分，园丁和女佣的反应却很怪，夜里他还被拉进一场听不懂的聚会。
hook: 克里斯（丹尼尔·卡卢亚）跟着白人女友回她父母家，乔丹·皮尔这部惊恐片里，一看就知道有什么不对。母亲盯得古怪，父亲殷勤得让人尴尬。克里斯很快发现，这家人以及他们的朋友是当代的奴隶主，把白人的脑子移植进黑人的身体。皮尔的导演处女作时机准、控制好，带一点冷幽默，把类型片的规矩拿来用：它既是一部关于白人至上的惊悚片，也是对“后种族美国”毫不留情的嘲弄。
plot_en: Chris goes with his white girlfriend to her family’s place in the country for the weekend. The parents are excessively warm. The gardener and the housekeeper react strangely. At night he is pulled into a gathering he cannot follow.
hook_en: When Chris (Daniel Kaluuya), the hero of Jordan Peele’s freakout, visits his white girlfriend’s parents, it’s obvious that something is off. Her mother is weirdly watchful, her father embarrassingly obsequious. Chris soon discovers that the family and their friends are modern-day slavers transplanting white brains into Black bodies. With mordant wit, great timing and superb control, Peele — making a terrific directorial debut — marshals genre conventions for a movie that’s at once an electrifying thriller about the horrors of white supremacy and an unsparing sendup of a post-racial America.

plot: 洛蕾莱在十六岁生下罗里，两人在星谷镇像朋友一样一起长大。快嘴、咖啡和常春藤的申请，不断把她们拉回哈特福德那个更有钱也更严的娘家。
hook: 单亲妈妈洛蕾莱和女儿罗里在康涅狄格的小镇生活，母女像闺蜜一样。台词语速极快，流行文化梗很密，小镇居民个个可爱，看起来非常治愈。
plot_en: Lorelai had Rory at sixteen, and the two of them grew up in Stars Hollow more like friends. Fast talk, coffee, and an application to the Ivy League keep pulling them back to the richer, stricter family in Hartford.
hook_en: Lorelai, a single mother, and her daughter Rory live in a small town in Connecticut, more like friends than like mother and daughter. The dialogue is extremely fast, the pop-culture references are dense, and the townspeople are each a pleasure. It is very easy to feel better while watching it.

plot: 汉娜·霍瓦思在布鲁克林想当作家，靠父母的钱、不稳定的工作和三位朋友撑过二十多岁。亲密关系在这里经常是尴尬的，也不打算被写成励志。
hook: 四个二十多岁的女孩在纽约混日子，找工作、谈恋爱、互相嫌弃。它没把年轻女性拍得光鲜可爱，女主自私又尴尬，所以真实。很多观众是在这部剧里第一次认识亚当·德赖弗。
plot_en: Hannah Horvath wants to be a writer in Brooklyn, and gets through her twenties on her parents’ money, unsteady work, and three friends. Intimacy here is often embarrassing, and it is not going to be written as inspiration.
hook_en: Four women in their twenties get by in New York: jobs, relationships, and irritation with each other. It does not make young women look glossy. The heroine is selfish and embarrassing, which is why it feels true. A lot of viewers met Adam Driver here for the first time.

plot: 罗马将军马克西姆斯打完仗，被新皇帝康茂德下令处死，家人也遭了毒手。他活下来，被卖成角斗士，一路打回罗马的竞技场。
hook: 刀剑凉鞋史诗早就过时了，雷德利·斯科特闯进来，带着这部满是阴谋和动作的、让人兴奋的戏。他有罗素·克劳，演那个要复仇的正直士兵，当时正在技艺的高点；也有一个新鲜、不做作的华金·菲尼克斯，演那个渴望被爱的皇帝。片子带起了这个类型的一次小复苏，模仿者却都不懂：奇观得有对等的心。这就是《角斗士》抓人的原因。
plot_en: The Roman general Maximus finishes a war and is ordered killed by the new emperor, Commodus. His family is killed too. He survives, is sold as a gladiator, and fights his way back to the arena in Rome.
hook_en: Sword-and-sandal epics were long out of fashion when Ridley Scott charged in with this exciting drama full of intrigue and action. It helped that he had Russell Crowe, as the honorable soldier out for vengeance, working at the height of his artistry and a fresh, unaffected Joaquin Phoenix as the emperor longing to be beloved. The film set off a mini-resurgence in the genre, but none of the imitators understood that spectacle needs heart to match. That’s what made “Gladiator” so gripping.

plot: 结婚五周年这天，艾米在家里失踪，现场留下挣扎的痕迹。警方和媒体很快把怀疑转向她的丈夫尼克，尼克自己的说法也越来越站不住。
hook: 不可靠叙述的一个标准例子。《消失的爱人》把“他说、她说”推到新的高度。编剧吉莉安·弗琳就是原著畅销小说的作者。电影给出都市的艾米和中西部的尼克这段婚姻互相矛盾的版本，罗莎蒙德·派克和本·阿弗莱克演得很准，让我们一直猜谁是英雄、谁是恶棍。到最后，在有毒的家庭生活这块地上，还有赢家吗？
plot_en: On their fifth anniversary Amy disappears from the house, and the scene shows signs of a struggle. The police and the press quickly turn their suspicion on her husband Nick, and Nick’s own account becomes harder and harder to stand on.
hook_en: A perfect example of the unreliable narrator, “Gone Girl” takes the he said/she said tale to new heights. Written by Gillian Flynn, author of the best-selling novel on which it’s based, the movie gives contradictory accounts of the marriage between urbane Amy and Midwestern Nick, played with pitch-perfect precision by Rosamund Pike and Ben Affleck, and keeps us guessing over who is the hero and who is the villain. In the end, are there any winners in the land of toxic domesticity?

plot: 医学工程师斯通在第一次太空行走时碰上卫星碎片的连锁碰撞，飞船毁了。她和资深宇航员马特被留在轨道上，得自己找到下一艘还能用的船。
hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部动作片是 21 世纪最了不起的惊险旅程之一。它按实时讲一个求生故事：被留下的宇航员（桑德拉·布洛克）必须找到回地球的路，同时面对她压了很久的创伤。开创性的特效盖过了大多数近年的片子。卡隆做出一个让人悬着的故事，它说的是：在太空里迷路，真正可怕的不是必死，而是单独和自己的念头待在一起。
plot_en: On her first spacewalk, the medical engineer Stone is caught in a chain collision of satellite debris, and the craft is destroyed. She and the veteran astronaut Matt are left in orbit and have to find the next ship that still works.
hook_en: Alfonso Cuarón’s action film is one of the 21st century’s greatest thrill rides, a real-time survival story about an abandoned astronaut (Sandra Bullock) who must find her way back to Earth while confronting the trauma she has long suppressed. With groundbreaking special effects that outshine most recent releases, Cuarón crafts a suspenseful story that suggests the true terror of being lost in space isn’t the prospect of certain death — it’s being alone with your thoughts.

plot: 蒂莫西·崔德威尔每年夏天独自住到阿拉斯加的灰熊中间，用摄像机记下自己和熊。2003 年，他和女友死于熊的袭击。电影用他留下的素材回看这些夏天。
hook: 很容易以为，维尔纳·赫尔佐格这部关于蒂莫西·崔德威尔的纪录片会偏教育。崔德威尔许多个夏天和阿拉斯加的棕熊住在一起。但他不是传统意义上的专家，片子更多是在讲一个人和自己在世界上的位置较劲。崔德威尔留下很多小时自己拍的录像。2003 年他和女友被熊咬死时，摄像机的麦克风开着。我们看着赫尔佐格听那些时刻。那是你永远不会听见的、最缠人的声音。
plot_en: Every summer Timothy Treadwell lived alone among the grizzlies in Alaska and filmed himself with the bears. In 2003 he and his girlfriend were killed in a bear attack. The film looks back at those summers through the footage he left.
hook_en: It would be easy to assume that this Werner Herzog documentary about Timothy Treadwell, who spent many summers cohabitating with Alaska’s brown bears, would skew educational. But Treadwell wasn’t an expert in the traditional sense, and this film is more about a man grappling with his place in the world. Treadwell left behind hours of self-recorded videos, and his camera’s microphone was on when he and his girlfriend were mauled to death in 2003. We watch Herzog listen to those moments, making it the most haunting audio you’ll never hear.

plot: 拉斯维加斯老牌笑匠黛博拉·万斯事业下滑，被迫和被行业赶走的年轻写手艾娃合作。两个人互相看不起，又都需要对方的句子。
hook: 拉斯维加斯的老牌女笑星，和一个被行业封杀的年轻写手合作写段子。两人一开始互相看不上，后来成了最懂彼此的人。珍·斯玛特凭此多次拿下艾美喜剧类女主角，第三季还获得最佳喜剧剧集。
plot_en: Deborah Vance, a long-running comic in Las Vegas, is slipping, and is forced to work with Ava, a young writer the industry has pushed out. They look down on each other, and each of them needs the other’s sentences.
hook_en: An established woman comic in Las Vegas writes material with a young writer the industry has blacklisted. They cannot stand each other at first, and later become the people who understand each other best. Jean Smart has won the Emmy for lead actress in a comedy more than once for it, and the third season also won best comedy series.

plot: 1980 年代，一个销售天才、一个工程师和两个后来居上的女人，从克隆个人电脑做到早期网络。公司会散，人还会因为同一个想法再坐到一张桌子前。
hook: 讲 1980 到 1990 年代美国个人电脑和互联网产业的兴起。第一季像职场剧，后来逐渐变成四个人之间关于梦想、合作和失败的故事。后两季口碑特别高，常被称为最被低估的美剧之一。
plot_en: In the 1980s a salesman, an engineer, and two women who come up from behind go from cloning a personal computer to the early internet. The companies come apart. The people sit down at the same table again because of the same idea.
hook_en: The rise of the personal computer and the internet in the United States from the 1980s into the 1990s. The first season is like a workplace show. Later it becomes a story about four people, their ambitions, working together, and failing. The last two seasons are especially well regarded. It is often called one of the most underrated American series.

plot: 约克郡警官凯瑟琳·考伍德管着一片并不幸福的谷地。害死女儿的汤米·李·罗伊斯出狱在即，而她正在抚养的外孙，是那段暴力留下的孩子。
hook: 约克郡女警凯瑟琳查一宗绑架案时，发现嫌疑人正是当年侵犯她女儿、导致女儿自杀的那个男人。犯罪线很紧，人物关系也很痛。莎拉·兰开夏演的中年女警强硬、疲惫又有幽默感。三季共 18 集。
plot_en: Catherine Cawood, a police officer in Yorkshire, is responsible for a valley that is not happy. Tommy Lee Royce, who caused her daughter’s death, is about to get out of prison. The grandson she is raising is the child that violence left behind.
hook_en: While investigating a kidnapping, the Yorkshire officer Catherine finds that the suspect is the man who assaulted her daughter and led to her daughter’s suicide. The crime plot is tight, and the relationships hurt. Sarah Lancashire’s middle-aged officer is hard, tired, and funny. Three seasons, eighteen episodes.

plot: 靠代人写信为生的西奥多刚结束一段婚姻，买回家一个会说话的操作系统。系统给自己取名萨曼莎，两个人越聊越近。
hook: 斯派克·琼斯这部数字时代的爱情片，不用大多数科幻片那种硬而发亮的表面，换成更歪、更苦甜的东西。近未来的洛杉矶，孤独、留着胡子的内向男人（华金·菲尼克斯）爱上一个会适应人的操作系统，声音是斯嘉丽·约翰逊。这是真的和机器恋爱，还是一个成年男人在病理性地躲开亲密？《她》不给简单答案。它提出的许多问题，放在今天，可惜已经不像 2013 年那么像假设了。
plot_en: Theodore writes letters for other people for a living and has just ended a marriage. He brings home an operating system that can talk. The system names itself Samantha, and the two of them grow closer the more they talk.
hook_en: Eschewing the hard, gleaming surfaces of most speculative sci-fi for something more off-kilter and bittersweet, Spike Jonze’s digital romance follows a lonely, mustachioed introvert (Joaquin Phoenix) in near-future Los Angeles as he falls head-over-code for an adaptive operating system voiced by Scarlett Johansson. Is it real machine love or just a grown man’s pathological avoidance of intimacy? “Her” refuses easy answers, though the many questions it raises, alas, feel a lot less theoretical today than they did in 2013.

plot: 中情局军官嘉莉·马蒂森认定，被救回来的海军陆战队员布罗迪已经倒向敌人。她的判断力极强，也受躁郁症左右，局里没有人愿意完全相信她。
hook: 一名被俘多年的美军士兵归国，中情局女特工嘉莉怀疑他已被策反。第一季把「他到底是不是」的悬念吊得非常好。克莱尔·丹妮丝演的嘉莉既有天才般的判断力，也受双相障碍困扰，是全剧的核心。
plot_en: The CIA officer Carrie Mathison becomes convinced that Brody, a Marine who has been brought home, has turned. Her judgment is extremely sharp, and it is also steered by bipolar disorder. No one at the agency is willing to believe her completely.
hook_en: A Marine comes home after years in captivity, and the CIA officer Carrie suspects he has been turned. The first season holds the question “is he or isn’t he” very well. Claire Danes’s Carrie has a near-genius judgment and is also living with bipolar disorder. She is the center of the show.

plot: 格里高利·豪斯是诊断科的负责人，专接别的医生放弃的病例。他确信病人在撒谎，自己则靠止疼药维持一条受伤的腿和更重的脾气。
hook: 天才医生豪斯脾气古怪、嘴毒、对止痛药上瘾，专门诊断别人解决不了的病例，每集都像一个医学版侦探故事。休·劳瑞是英国人，却把美式口音演得毫无破绽。
plot_en: Gregory House runs a department of diagnostics and takes the cases other doctors have given up. He is sure the patient is lying. He himself stays upright on painkillers, for an injured leg and a worse temper.
hook_en: House is a brilliant doctor, rude, mean, and addicted to painkillers. He diagnoses the cases no one else can solve, and each episode is a detective story in a hospital. Hugh Laurie is British, and the American accent has no cracks in it.

plot: 国会党鞭弗兰克·安德伍德没能得到许诺的职位，于是开始逐个清除挡路的人。他不时转头对观众说明下一步。妻子克莱尔经营的是另一套更冷的政治。
hook: 国会议员弗兰克·安德伍德没当上国务卿，开始一路设局往上爬，还常常对着镜头直接跟观众说话。它是 Netflix 第一部真正有影响力的原创大剧。前两季最紧凑；主演凯文·斯派西因丑闻被解约，最后一季没有他。
plot_en: Frank Underwood, the party whip in Congress, does not get the job he was promised, and starts removing the people in his way, one by one. Now and then he turns to the audience and explains the next step. His wife Claire runs a colder kind of politics.
hook_en: The congressman Frank Underwood is passed over for secretary of state and starts scheming his way up. He often speaks straight to the camera. It was Netflix’s first original series that really mattered. The first two seasons are the tightest. Kevin Spacey was dropped after the scandal, and the last season is without him.

plot: 每一集从一个生活题目开始，比如如何小幅交谈或如何扔掉电池。威尔逊拿着摄像机在纽约街头走，旁白很快就偏离教程，碰到真正的人。
hook: 每集看起来是一份生活教程，比如怎样闲聊、怎样找车位，结果约翰·威尔逊拍下的纽约街景越跑越偏。自言自语的旁白，配上随手拍下的街头片段，常常好笑又意外地感人。不靠写好的笑话，靠观察和剪辑。
plot_en: Each episode starts from a subject in ordinary life, such as how to make small talk or how to throw out batteries. Wilson walks the streets of New York with a camera, and the voice-over soon leaves the tutorial and meets actual people.
hook_en: Each episode looks like a how-to: how to make small talk, how to find a parking space. What John Wilson films of the New York street then runs off in another direction. A muttered narration over footage grabbed in the street is often funny and, unexpectedly, moving. It does not rely on written jokes. It relies on looking and on the edit.

plot: 作家阿拉贝拉在一个晚上被下药、侵害，之后她要靠碎片把那晚重新拼起来。朋友、约会和创作都不再能用原来的说法解释。
hook: 米凯拉·科尔根据自己被性侵的经历创作，她编剧、主演，也参与导演。题材沉重，但剧本不按受害者模板写：有幽默，有复杂的友情，也有模糊的道德问题。共 12 集，后劲很大，科尔凭此拿下艾美编剧奖。
plot_en: The writer Arabella is drugged and assaulted one night, and afterward has to put that night back together from fragments. Friends, dates, and the work can no longer be explained in the old way.
hook_en: Michaela Coel made it from her own sexual assault. She wrote it, stars in it, and directed some of it. The subject is heavy, and the script does not follow a victim template: there is humor, a complicated friendship, and moral questions that stay unclear. Twelve episodes. It stays with you. Coel won the Emmy for writing.

plot: 每一则短剧都从一件普通的事开始：一场会议、一顶帽子、一次聚餐。然后有人拒绝停下，社交场面按照他的逻辑滑出正常世界。
hook: 蒂姆·罗宾逊的小品秀。每段都从普通的社交场合开始，然后有人死不认错，越闹越离谱。笑点非常怪，对上频道的人会笑疯。每集不到 20 分钟，节奏极快。
plot_en: Each sketch starts from an ordinary thing: a meeting, a hat, a dinner. Then someone refuses to stop, and the social situation slides out of the normal world according to his logic.
hook_en: Tim Robinson’s sketch show. Each bit starts in an ordinary social situation, and then someone will not admit they are wrong, and it gets further out of hand. The jokes are very strange. If you are on its wavelength, you will lose it. Episodes run under 20 minutes, and the pace is fast.

plot: 周慕云和苏丽珍先后搬进相邻的公寓，发现各自的配偶有了外遇。两个人开始频繁见面，把话停在越界之前。
hook: 1962 年，记者周慕云（梁朝伟）和秘书苏丽珍（张曼玉）都已结婚，却先后搬进香港同一栋拥挤的楼。他们以慢动作擦肩而过。火花没有爆开，只是闷着烧。这团火在王家卫华丽而哀伤的爱情片里一直烧着，欲望写在每一次对视和没说出口的话里。女人背部的曲线成了渴望的标记，男人烟头上散开的烟，说出的是生活过不去的疼。
plot_en: Chow Mo-wan and Su Li-zhen move, one after the other, into neighboring apartments and discover that their spouses are having an affair. The two of them start meeting often, and stop the conversation before it crosses the line.
hook_en: Soon after a journalist (Tony Leung) and a secretary (Maggie Cheung), both married to other people, move into the same crowded Hong Kong building in 1962, they brush past each other in mesmerizing slow motion. Sparks don’t fly; they smolder. They keep on burning in Wong Kar-wai’s rapturously beautiful, elegiac romance, in which he inscribes desire in every glance and unspoken word. Here, the sensuous curve of a woman’s back becomes an emblem of longing while the tendrils of smoke from a man’s cigarette express the ache of life’s impermanence.

plot: 柯布靠进入别人的梦境盗取秘密为生。这一次的任务反过来，是要把一个想法种进一位继承人的脑子。他带着一支队伍往更深层的梦里走。
hook: 《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》的成功，给了克里斯托弗·诺兰自由，去推他的想象，也去推商业电影的边界。莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥带领一支潜入梦境的队伍，任务是把一个想法种进一位企业继承人（基里安·墨菲，也就是诺兰后来的奥本海默）的潜意识深处。这位编导不停玩叙事结构、视觉设计和电影操纵时间的能力。结尾对陀螺做的事，相当于《银翼杀手》对折纸独角兽做的事。
plot_en: Cobb makes his living by entering other people’s dreams and stealing secrets. This time the job is the reverse: to plant an idea in an heir’s mind. He takes a team down into deeper layers of the dream.
hook_en: The success of “The Dark Knight” bought Christopher Nolan the freedom to push the limits of his imagination and the boundaries of commercial moviemaking. Leonardo DiCaprio plays the head of a team of dream invaders charged with planting an idea deep in the subconscious of a business scion (Cillian Murphy, Nolan’s future J. Robert Oppenheimer). The writer-director continually toys with narrative structure, visual design and cinema’s capacity to manipulate time. The finale does for spinning tops what “Blade Runner” did for origami unicorns.

plot: 1944 年，阿尔多中尉带着一队犹太美军在被占领的法国猎杀纳粹。同一时间，犹太女子肖莎娜经营着一家即将为纳粹高层放映电影的电影院。
hook: 昆汀·塔伦蒂诺这个二战复仇故事又大又近：生死可以取决于一个手势、一块甜点上的浇头、一口糟糕的口音。不是布拉德·皮特那口田纳西口音，那一口很好笑。克里斯托夫·瓦尔兹在一群好演员里最突出，拿了奥斯卡最佳男配角。改写过的历史把片子烧成一片之后，最后一句话留给皮特，听着也很像塔伦蒂诺自己在说：“我觉得这可能就是我的代表作。”
plot_en: In 1944 Lieutenant Aldo leads a unit of Jewish American soldiers hunting Nazis in occupied France. At the same time, the Jewish woman Shosanna is running a cinema that is about to screen a film for the Nazi high command.
hook_en: Quentin Tarantino’s World War II revenge tale is epic but intimate: Life and death turn on a hand gesture, a dessert topping, a bad accent (not whatever Tennessee accent Brad Pitt is using — that one’s hilarious). Christoph Waltz stands out in a stacked ensemble cast, and won the best supporting actor Oscar. But after a conflagration of revisionist history has burned this movie to the ground, Pitt gets the last word, and it’s hard not to hear it in Tarantino’s voice: “I think this just might be my masterpiece.”

plot: 伊萨在洛杉矶的非营利机构上班，和最好的朋友莫莉一起应付恋爱、工作和一句说出来就会后悔的话。南洛杉矶不是背景板，是她们来回开的那条路。
hook: 伊萨·雷讲洛杉矶黑人女性的恋爱、工作和友谊。最好看的不是爱情线，而是伊萨和莫莉之间互相依赖又常闹矛盾的闺蜜关系。配乐很出色，五季完结。
plot_en: Issa works at a nonprofit in Los Angeles and, with her best friend Molly, deals with dating, work, and the sentence that will be regretted the moment it is said. South Los Angeles is not a backdrop. It is the road they drive back and forth.
hook_en: Issa Rae on the dating, the work, and the friendships of Black women in Los Angeles. What is best in it is not the romance. It is the friendship between Issa and Molly, who depend on each other and fight often. The music is excellent. Five seasons, and it ends.

plot: 民谣歌手卢埃林在纽约过冬，搭档刚刚自杀，经纪人也不肯再推他的唱片。他睡在朋友的沙发上，跑一场又一场赚不到钱的演出。
hook: 科恩兄弟挖进 1960 年代的民谣圈子，盯住其中一个失败者。奥斯卡·伊萨克因此突破。标题里的人是个倒霉蛋，为死去的音乐搭档哀悼，也是个混蛋，会占那些所谓朋友的便宜。卢埃林的音乐是好的，但没有鲍勃·迪伦那么好。这让片子成为关于艺术家、关于站在伟大外面的那种艺术的代表作。片子本身是好的，这种讽刺，正是卢埃林该得的因果。
plot_en: The folk singer Llewyn is getting through a New York winter. His partner has just killed himself, and his manager will not push his record anymore. He sleeps on friends’ couches and plays one unpaid gig after another.
hook_en: The Coen brothers dug into the 1960s folk scene by focusing on one of its losers. The title character, played by a breakout Oscar Isaac, is a sad sack, mourning the loss of his musical partner, and a jerk, prone to taking advantage of supposed friends. Llewyn’s music is good, but not Bob Dylan good. This makes the movie one of the quintessential works of art about being an artist on the outside of greatness. The irony that the film itself is great is just the kind of karma Llewyn deserves.

plot: 地球上的粮食正在枯萎。前工程师库珀被招募去飞离太阳系，为人类找下一处能落脚的地方。他出发的时候，女儿墨菲还是个孩子。
hook: 克里斯托弗·诺兰这部耀眼、野心很大的太空史诗，情节是一个到今天仍然把脑子拧弯的谜，正好对应我们有多不明白自己在宇宙的哪里、为什么存在。中心是马修·麦康纳演的一个鳏夫。他留下孩子、岳父，和一颗被气候变化毁掉的地球，加入一支 NASA 队伍，去找一颗新的行星。尽管远方的地平线都在，片子最好的地方，是在探家这个不稳、却诱人的概念。
plot_en: The crops on Earth are dying. Cooper, a former engineer, is recruited to leave the solar system and find the next place humanity can land. When he sets out, his daughter Murph is still a child.
hook_en: The plot of Christopher Nolan’s dazzling, ambitious space epic is a puzzle that even today remains mind-bending, mirroring how little we understand about where we are in the universe and why we exist. At its center is Matthew McConaughey as a widower who leaves behind his children, father-in-law and an Earth ravaged by climate change to join a NASA team trying to find a new planet. For all the far-off horizons, the movie is at its best exploring the precarious yet seductive concept of home.

plot: 五个经营费城酒吧的人自私、短视，并且真心相信自己是房间里最受委屈的那个。每一集的计划都会因为他们的性格失败。
hook: 五个自私又愚蠢的人经营一家费城爱尔兰酒吧，每集都在想坏主意，然后彻底失败。他们几乎从不成长，这正是笑点所在。已经播了十六季以上，是美国播出时间最长的真人情景喜剧。
plot_en: Five people running a bar in Philadelphia are selfish, shortsighted, and sincerely believe they are the most put-upon person in the room. Every episode’s plan fails because of who they are.
hook_en: Five selfish, stupid people run an Irish bar in Philadelphia. Each episode they think up a bad idea and then fail completely. They almost never grow up, which is the joke. It has run more than sixteen seasons, the longest-running live-action sitcom on American television.

plot: 联邦法警雷兰·吉文斯因开枪过快被调回肯塔基老家。他要对付的不只是当地罪犯，还有跟他一起长大、现在布道又贩毒的博伊德·克劳德。
hook: 改编自埃尔莫尔·伦纳德的小说，联邦法警雷兰回到肯塔基老家执法。主角冷静、幽默，拔枪极快；对手博伊德能说会道。南方犯罪氛围浓，对白很有味道，最后一季的结局很经典。
plot_en: The federal marshal Raylan Givens is sent back to his home in Kentucky for shooting too quickly. He has to deal not only with the local criminals but with Boyd Crowder, who grew up with him and now preaches and sells drugs.
hook_en: Adapted from Elmore Leonard. The federal marshal Raylan comes home to Kentucky to enforce the law. He is calm, funny, and very fast with a gun. His opposite, Boyd, can talk. The Southern crime atmosphere is thick, the dialogue has a flavor, and the last season’s ending is a classic.

plot: 凯和皮尔用短剧处理种族、流行文化和那些一开口就错位的社交场面。两个人轮流扮演权力的两边，笑话建立在身份被看错的瞬间。
hook: 两位喜剧演员的小品秀，每段几分钟，适合碎片时间看。很多段子讨论种族和身份，比如奥巴马和他的「愤怒翻译」路德。乔丹·皮尔后来执导了电影《逃出绝命镇》。
plot_en: Key and Peele use sketches to handle race, pop culture, and the social moments that go wrong as soon as someone speaks. The two of them take turns playing both sides of a power relationship. The joke sits in the instant an identity is misread.
hook_en: A sketch show by two comedians. Each bit is a few minutes, easy to watch in pieces. A lot of the sketches are about race and identity, such as Obama and Luther, his “anger translator.” Jordan Peele later directed Get Out.

plot: 新娘在婚礼彩排上被前任比尔带领的刺杀小队枪击，昏迷了四年。醒来之后她写下名单，从冲绳的制刀师傅和东京的一栋豪宅开始，一个一个找回去。
hook: 开枪、刀刺、殴打、斩首、开膛、截肢、致残、挖眼、切开、剁碎和咬，从来没有这么有戏仿的好玩。乌玛·瑟曼演的新娘从昏迷中醒来，发誓向那些用代号的袭击者复仇。其中有穿和服、使刀的棉嘴蛇（刘玉玲），也有看起来普通的铜头蛇（薇薇卡·A·福克斯），枪藏在女儿的麦片盒里。昆汀·塔伦蒂诺满心喜欢地用 B 级片的样式讲这个暗的故事：意大利西部片、功夫、动画、磨坊电影。
plot_en: The Bride is shot at her wedding rehearsal by her former lover Bill and his assassination squad, and spends four years in a coma. When she wakes she writes a list and starts working back through it, beginning with a sword maker in Okinawa and a house in Tokyo.
hook_en: Never before have shootings, stabbings, beatings, beheadings, disembowelings, amputations, mutilations, gougings, slicings, choppings and bitings been so much campy fun. Uma Thurman’s character, the Bride, awakens from a coma and vows revenge on her code-named assailants; they include the kimono-wearing, katana-wielding Cottonmouth (Lucy Liu) and the seemingly ordinary Copperhead (Vivica A. Fox), who keeps a gun in her daughter’s cereal box. Quentin Tarantino lovingly uses B-movie styles — spaghetti western, kung fu, anime, grindhouse — to tell his dark story.

plot: 克里斯汀给自己改名伯德小姐，一心要离开萨克拉门托去东海岸上大学。母亲认为家里没有这笔钱，两个人把申请、打工和一场舞会都吵成了架。
hook: “你不觉得这两件事也许是同一件吗，爱，和注意？”这句话是对高中生克里斯汀·“伯德小姐”·麦克弗森说的，也是格蕾塔·葛韦格这部成名导演作的中心。伯德小姐（西尔莎·罗南）习惯清点让她烦的东西：管得太多的母亲（劳里·梅特卡夫），萨克拉门托这座家乡城里种种不上台面的委屈。她几乎没注意到，自己的注意和感情是连着的。十几岁的伯德把防备穿成盔甲，葛韦格找到的是盔甲下面还在跳的那颗心。
plot_en: Christine renames herself Lady Bird and is determined to leave Sacramento for college on the East Coast. Her mother says the family does not have the money. Applications, a job, and a dance all turn into fights.
hook_en: “Don’t you think maybe they are the same thing — love and attention?” This question, posed to the high schooler Christine “Lady Bird” McPherson, is the central tenet of Greta Gerwig’s breakthrough directorial effort. Lady Bird (Saoirse Ronan) is so used to cataloging the things that frustrate her — from her overbearing mother (Laurie Metcalf) to the provincial indignities of her Sacramento hometown — that she hardly notices her attention and affection are interlinked. As a teenager, Lady Bird wears her defensiveness like a suit of armor, but Gerwig finds the vulnerable heart beating underneath.

plot: 十二岁的奥斯卡住在斯德哥尔摩的公寓楼里，在学校被人欺负。新搬来的伊莱只在夜里出现，不觉得冷，向他提议做朋友。同一片社区开始有人失踪。
hook: 这部是给局外人的。托马斯·阿尔弗雷德森的戏大部分时候冷冷地平静，讲一个疏离的男孩奥斯卡（卡雷·赫德布兰特）和他古怪的邻居伊莱（莉娜·林德森）的友谊。伊莱也许是吸血鬼。片子有节制，该见血的时候见血，但对主角的难处有同情，也大方地写他们的联系。它把吸血鬼电影推向了新的方向。
plot_en: Twelve-year-old Oskar lives in an apartment block in Stockholm and is bullied at school. The new neighbor, Eli, appears only at night, does not feel the cold, and offers to be his friend. People in the same neighborhood start to disappear.
hook_en: This one is for the outcasts. Unfolding for the most part with a chilly sense of calm, Tomas Alfredson’s drama follows a friendship between a detached boy, Oskar (Kare Hedebrant), and his offbeat neighbor, Eli (Lina Leandersson), who just might be a vampire. The film is tempered, bloody when it needs to be, but sympathetic to the challenges of its lead characters and generous in how it portrays their connection as it pushes the vampire movie in fresh directions.

plot: 胡佛家收到通知，小女儿奥利芙进了加州儿童选美的决赛。祖父、父母、舅舅和几乎不说话的哥哥挤上一辆爱抛锚的面包车，赶在比赛前上路。
hook: 要是每个功能失调的家庭都能这样支持彼此的梦就好了。这也许是《阳光小美女》想留下的。它的中心是倒霉、各色的胡佛一家：想自杀的舅舅、吸海洛因的祖父，和一个总在找下一桩快钱的父亲。他们挤上一辆大众面包车，好让 7 岁的奥利芙（阿比盖尔·布雷斯林）去赢一场儿童选美。一半是喜剧公路片，一半是对当代美国的评论。它好看，因为有心，也因为表演。
plot_en: The Hoover family gets word that their younger daughter Olive has reached the finals of a children’s beauty pageant in California. Grandfather, parents, uncle, and a brother who barely speaks pile into a van that keeps breaking down, and set off to make the contest.
hook_en: If only every dysfunctional family could be this supportive of one another’s dreams. Perhaps that’s the takeaway from “Little Miss Sunshine,” which centers on the downtrodden, eclectic Hoovers, including a suicidal uncle, a heroin-ingesting grandpa and a father always looking for the next get-rich-quick scheme. They all pile into a VW bus to give 7-year-old Olive (Abigail Breslin) the chance to win a child beauty pageant. Part comedic road trip, part commentary on contemporary America, “Little Miss Sunshine” delights for both its heart and stunning performances.

plot: 一架客机坠毁在热带岛屿，幸存者很快发现这里不是普通的荒岛。每一集用倒叙打开一个人的过去，岛上的谜则越开越多。
hook: 飞机坠毁在神秘海岛，幸存者遇到越来越多怪事。每集穿插一个人的过去，人物塑造很扎实，也带起了悬疑美剧层层埋坑的风潮。前几季极其上头，结局争议很大。
plot_en: A passenger plane crashes on a tropical island, and the survivors soon find it is not an ordinary deserted island. Each episode opens someone’s past in flashback. The mysteries on the island keep multiplying.
hook_en: A plane crashes on a mysterious island, and the survivors meet stranger and stranger things. Each episode cuts in someone’s past. The people are solidly built, and the show started the fashion for mystery series that keep burying clues. The early seasons are extremely addictive. The ending was heavily argued over.

plot: 过气影星鲍勃到东京拍威士忌广告，整夜睡不着。同住一家酒店的夏洛特随丈夫出差，丈夫却忙着别的事。两个人开始一起在城里耗时间。
hook: 索菲亚·科波拉的第二部长片像一个电影奇迹：轻松地有新意，被反复引用，没法复制。它在东京柏悦酒店拍摄，科波拉自己在第一段婚姻要结束时住过那里。鲍勃和夏洛特（比尔·默里和斯嘉丽·约翰逊）一个是过气影星，一个是读哲学却不知道往哪走的人，他们相交的时间，刚好够认出一个同类。《迷失东京》让科波拉拿到奥斯卡，也把她定成美国电影里一个不能没有的新声音。
plot_en: Bob, a movie star past his peak, is in Tokyo to shoot a whiskey commercial and cannot sleep. Charlotte is staying in the same hotel with her husband, who is busy with other things. The two of them start spending time in the city together.
hook_en: Sofia Coppola’s sophomore feature is a cinematic miracle — effortlessly inventive, endlessly quoted, impossible to replicate. Shot at the Park Hyatt Tokyo (where Coppola had stayed while contemplating the end of her first marriage), it follows the enigmatic duo of Bob and Charlotte (Bill Murray and Scarlett Johansson), a fading movie star and a floundering philosophy grad whose paths intersect for just as long as it takes to recognize a soul mate. “Lost in Translation” won Coppola an Oscar and cemented her status as an essential new voice in American film.

plot: 脱口秀演员路易在纽约带两个女儿，每一集像一段单独的短片：一场失败的约会、一次上台，或一件突然变得可怕的小事。
hook: 路易·C·K 自编自导自演，每集像一部短片：有时搞笑，有时伤感，有时很荒诞，影响了后来很多作者型喜剧。主创后来因性骚扰丑闻停工，有观众会因此不看。
plot_en: The stand-up comic Louie is raising two daughters in New York. Each episode is like a short film on its own: a failed date, a set, or a small thing that suddenly becomes frightening.
hook_en: Louis C.K. writes, directs, and stars. Each episode is like a short: sometimes funny, sometimes sad, sometimes absurd. It influenced a lot of later author-driven comedy. He later stopped working after sexual-harassment allegations, and some viewers will not watch it for that reason.

plot: 不死老乔把荒漠里的水和油握在自己手里。弗瑞奥萨劫走他的妻妾，麦克斯被绑在车头上，一整队战车追着这辆油罐车跑。
hook: 乔治·米勒这部末日系列的第四部里，世界仍在找水。麦克斯（汤姆·哈迪）坐在副驾，旁边是独臂、开卡车的革命者弗瑞奥萨（查理兹·塞隆）。画面里全是身体：人的、机器的、死白的、镀铬发亮的。米勒这场狂乱的幻觉让人合不拢嘴，因为画面离谱，也因为里面有感情。你可以冲着那个被绑在行驶的卡车上、弹着喷火吉他的人来，留下来，是为了一曲给这个世界的挽歌：它看起来可怕地像我们自己的世界。
plot_en: Immortan Joe holds the water and the gasoline in the wasteland. Furiosa steals his wives. Max is strapped to the front of a car, and a whole convoy of war machines chases the tanker.
hook_en: The fourth installment in George Miller’s postapocalyptic series finds the world still thirsting for water and Max (Tom Hardy) riding shotgun with Furiosa (Charlize Theron), a one-armed, truck-driving revolutionary. Churning with bodies — human, machined, deathly pale, shinily chromed — Miller’s kinetic, lunatic hallucination leaves you slack-jawed because of both its outrageous visuals and depth of feeling. Come for the guy playing a flame-throwing guitar while tied to a moving semi, stay for the requiem for a world that looks eerily, devastatingly like our own.

plot: 1960 年代的麦迪逊大道，创意总监唐·德雷珀替客户发明欲望，自己则靠一个偷来的名字过活。办公室里的性别、酒和晋升，比广告本身更忙。
hook: 1960 年代的纽约广告业，西装、烟酒和办公室政治都拍得极讲究。主线是唐·德雷珀的身份之谜，佩吉从秘书升为文案的那条线同样好看，十年的社会变化都藏在背景里。节奏慢，适合细看；连续四年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
plot_en: On Madison Avenue in the 1960s, the creative director Don Draper invents desires for clients and lives under a name he stole. Gender, drink, and promotion in the office are busier than the advertising.
hook_en: New York advertising in the 1960s. The suits, the cigarettes, the drinks, and the office politics are all made with great care. The main line is the mystery of Don Draper’s identity. Peggy’s rise from secretary to copywriter is just as good to watch, and a decade of social change sits in the background. It is slow, and it rewards attention. It won the Emmy for best drama four years running.

plot: 宾夕法尼亚小镇警探梅尔·希恩调查一名年轻母亲的死，同时应付离婚、丧子和孙子的监护权。她认识每一个嫌疑人，因为他们都是邻居。
hook: 小镇女警探调查一位年轻母亲被杀的案子，同时还要面对离婚、儿子自杀和孙子的监护权问题。悬疑线扎实，家庭戏更动人。凯特·温斯莱特凭此拿下艾美限定剧女主角。七集，结局反转很多。
plot_en: Mare Sheehan, a detective in a small Pennsylvania town, investigates the death of a young mother while dealing with a divorce, the loss of her son, and custody of her grandson. She knows every suspect, because they are neighbors.
