hook_en: A small-town detective investigates the murder of a young mother, and at the same time faces a divorce, her son’s suicide, and custody of her grandson. The mystery is solid. The family scenes are more moving. Kate Winslet won the Emmy for lead actress in a limited series. Seven episodes, and a lot of turns at the end.

plot: 贾斯汀在自己的婚礼上崩溃，谁也拉不住她。婚后她搬去姐姐克莱尔家，天空里一颗叫「忧郁」的行星正在靠近，姐姐开始害怕，她反而不再怕。
hook: 拉斯·冯·提尔的《忧郁症》来把你压低，方式既惊人，也适合坐下来想。克斯汀·邓斯特演一个正在散掉的新娘，好去配上这个世界的状态：它也许就要和一颗失控的行星相撞。又暗又狠，冯·提尔做得最好。这位丹麦作者却不知怎么把彻底的毁灭做成了一件美的东西。
plot_en: Justine falls apart at her own wedding, and no one can pull her back. Afterward she moves in with her sister Claire. A planet called Melancholia is approaching in the sky. Claire starts to be afraid. Justine stops being afraid.
hook_en: Lars von Trier’s “Melancholia” is here to bum you out in ways both breathtaking and contemplative. Kirsten Dunst stars as a bride who is falling apart, all the better to match the state of the world, which just might be about to collide with a rogue planet. When it comes to bleak and brutal, von Trier does it best, yet the Danish auteur somehow manages to make total annihilation a thing of beauty in the process.

plot: 莱尼的短时记忆只维持得了几分钟。妻子被害之后，他用拍立得、便签和纹在身上的字继续追查，因为他记不住上一刻发生了什么。
hook: 克里斯托弗·诺兰这部惊悚片的结构很聪明：从故事的结尾开始，一场一场往回倒。断开的叙事让我们尝到莱尼（盖·皮尔斯）的生活。他存不住短期记忆，把关于妻子被害的线索纹在身上。这是一个聪明的谜。让《记忆碎片》忘不掉的，是它关于身份、关于我们讲给自己听的那些自己的故事，一直说到结尾那个把地毯抽走的反转。或者说，开头。
plot_en: Lenny’s short-term memory lasts only a few minutes. After his wife is murdered, he keeps investigating with Polaroids, notes, and words tattooed on his body, because he cannot remember what happened a moment ago.
hook_en: This Christopher Nolan thriller stands out for its ingenious structure: starting at the story’s end and backtracking scene by scene. The disjointed narrative gives us a taste of what life is like for Leonard (Guy Pearce), who can’t store short-term memories and who tattoos his body with clues about his wife’s murder. It’s a clever puzzle, but what makes “Memento” unforgettable is what it says about identity and the stories we tell ourselves about ourselves, right up to its rug-pull of an ending — er, beginning.

plot: 1986 年，韩国一座小城里连续发生强奸杀人案。本地警察朴斗万靠拳头和直觉办案，从首尔调来的徐泰允坚持要证据。嫌疑人被一个个抓来，又一个个对不上。
hook: 这部韩国警察片不受好莱坞类型规矩束缚，第一条线索在开场就来了：侦探（宋康昊）被叫去一座乡下地方查一具尸体，他是搭一辆慢慢开的拖拉机到的。别的笨拙的调查员简直是跌进犯罪现场，阴沉的笑还在继续。导演奉俊昊对男人面对无法理解的恶有多有限，有很强的想法。他用自己标志性的、没想到的幽默和看得很准的戏剧去探这些想法。
plot_en: In 1986 a series of rape-murders hits a small city in Korea. The local detective Park Doo-man works by instinct and his fists. Seo Tae-yoon, sent from Seoul, insists on evidence. Suspects are brought in one after another, and none of them fit.
hook_en: The first clue that this Korean police procedural isn’t bound by Hollywood genre conventions comes in the opening moments: A detective (played by Song Kang Ho) summoned to investigate a dead body in a rural outpost arrives by hitching a ride on a plodding tractor. The grim laughs continue when other hapless investigators fall quite literally into the crime scene. The director Bong Joon Ho has strong ideas about the limits of men facing unfathomable evil, and he explores them with his hallmark mix of unexpected humor and sharply observed drama.

plot: 律师迈克尔专门替事务所收拾麻烦。同事阿瑟在经手一家大公司的集体诉讼时精神崩溃，当众指责客户，迈克尔被派去让他停下来。
hook: “我不是奇迹工人，我是清洁工。”迈克尔·克莱顿对事务所一个不满的客户说。乔治·克鲁尼演得最好的一次，把这句话说成看透了一切的苦，也说成智力。他名义上是律师，其实是个收拾残局的人。同事（汤姆·威尔金森，也是他最好的时候）停了药，找到了自己的道德方向，克莱顿得去把造成的损害解开。这件事对克莱顿的良心做了什么，是编导托尼·吉尔罗伊这部抓人的惊悚片的核心。
plot_en: The lawyer Michael is the person his firm sends to clean up trouble. His colleague Arthur, handling a class action against a large company, has a breakdown and denounces the client in public. Michael is sent to make him stop.
hook_en: “I’m not a miracle worker, I’m a janitor,” Michael Clayton tells a disgruntled client of the law firm he works for. George Clooney, in his finest performance, delivers the line with a mixture of seen-it-all bitterness and intelligence. His character is nominally an attorney, but really he’s a fixer trying to undo the damage after a colleague (Tom Wilkinson, at his absolute best) goes off his meds and finds his moral compass. What that does to Clayton’s conscience is the crux of the writer-director Tony Gilroy’s gripping thriller.

plot: 华盛顿用三个能预见谋杀的人，在罪行发生之前把凶手抓走。预犯罪组的队长约翰有一天在系统里看见了自己的名字。
hook: 萨曼莎·莫顿几乎剃光了头，喊出“跑！”这个画面只是一个原因，说明史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格改编菲利普·K·迪克的这部片子仍然让人难忘。在这个反乌托邦里，犯罪在发生之前就被拦住，靠的是像莫顿这样的人类“预知者”的预见。汤姆·克鲁斯演一个被冤枉的警察，紧张得正好。他越靠近一个大阴谋的中心，动作里就越有深的悲伤。一种啃着人的痛苦推动着斯皮尔伯格的黑色片，世界的颜色几乎被抽干了。
plot_en: Washington uses three people who can see murders before they happen, and arrests the killers before the crime. One day John, the chief of Precrime, sees his own name in the system.
hook_en: The image of a nearly bald Samantha Morton shouting “Run!” is just one reason Steven Spielberg’s Philip K. Dick adaptation is still haunting. In this dystopia, crime is stopped before it happens thanks to the foresight of human “precogs” like Morton’s character. Tom Cruise is appropriately on edge as a falsely accused police officer, infusing a deep sadness into his actions as he draws closer to the center of a huge conspiracy. A gnawing agony powers Spielberg’s noir in which color has almost been drained from the world.

plot: 普里切特一家三支，以假纪录片的方式过同一座城市里的日子：再婚、同志伴侣和传统郊区家庭，麻烦都出在晚饭之前。
hook: 伪纪录片形式拍三个有亲戚关系的家庭：老夫少妻、同性伴侣和普通的三口之家。每集半小时，笑点稳定，很适合全家一起看。连续五年拿下艾美最佳喜剧剧集。
plot_en: Three branches of the Pritchett family get through their days in the same city, shot as a fake documentary: a second marriage, a same-sex couple, and a conventional suburban family. The trouble all arrives before dinner.
hook_en: A mockumentary of three related households: an older man with a younger wife, a same-sex couple, and an ordinary family of three. Half an hour an episode, the jokes are steady, and it is easy to watch together. It won the Emmy for best comedy five years in a row.

plot: 奥克兰运动家队没有钱和豪门抢球星，还是得组出下一季的阵容。总经理比利·比恩不再按球探的眼缘买人，改看上垒率这些被市场看低的数字。
hook: 《点球成金》不只是在讲 2002 年奥克兰运动家队这个弱队的真实成功。它在讲一种赢的办法，生意里和棒球里都用得上。根据迈克尔·刘易斯的书，本内特·米勒这部戏由布拉德·皮特演总经理比利·比恩。他和一个助手（乔纳·希尔）用数据组出一支被低估的队伍。菲利普·塞穆尔·霍夫曼把持怀疑态度的运动家队主教练完全住进了角色。片子抓住了棒球的冷酷和浪漫，那时候，不受欢迎的想法真的改变了比赛。
plot_en: The Oakland Athletics do not have the money to bid against rich clubs for stars, and still have to build next season’s roster. The general manager Billy Beane stops buying players on a scout’s hunch and starts looking at numbers the market undervalues, such as on-base percentage.
hook_en: “Moneyball” doesn’t just depict the real-life success of the underdog Oakland Athletics in 2002. It describes a strategy to win — in business and baseball. Based on Michael Lewis’s book, this Bennett Miller drama stars Brad Pitt as Billy Beane, the G.M. who, together with an aide (Jonah Hill), uses data to assemble a team of undervalued players. With Philip Seymour Hoffman fully inhabiting his role as the skeptical A’s manager, “Moneyball” captures the ruthlessness and romance of baseball at a time when unpopular ideas proved to be literally game-changing.

plot: 迈阿密一个瘦小的男孩跟着毒贩长大，少年时爱上来往的同学。成年后他换了名字和身材，在餐厅里等这个人出现。
hook: 这部轻的戏，分量要到结尾才压下来，而结尾一旦到来，就很重。巴里·詹金斯把一个黑人同性恋男人的一生带过去，童年、少年和成年分别由亚历克斯·希伯特、阿什顿·桑德斯和特雷万特·罗兹出演。《月光男孩》讲的是一个人怎样被造成现在这样：路上遇到的美和爱，你接住的和你没接住的。最后它讲的是觉得自己在外面，然后耐心、安静地找回家。
plot_en: A thin boy in Miami grows up around a drug dealer, and as a teenager falls in love with a classmate. As an adult he has a different name and a different body, and waits in a restaurant for that person to appear.
hook_en: The weight of this delicate drama doesn’t hit until the end, but when the finale arrives, it is staggering. Barry Jenkins expertly takes us through the life of one Black gay man, played at different ages by Alex Hibbert, Ashton Sanders and Trevante Rhodes. “Moonlight” is about everything it takes to make you who you are. It’s about the beauty and love that come your way, what you embrace and what you don’t. And ultimately it’s about feeling like an outcast, but patiently, quietly finding your way home.

plot: 贝蒂来到好莱坞想当演员，在住处发现一个因车祸失忆的女人。两个人给她取名丽塔，一起追查她是谁。
hook: 大卫·林奇这个扭曲的童话，跟着年轻女演员贝蒂往下坠落。她由娜奥米·沃茨出演，是一次改写职业生涯的表演。贝蒂刚到洛杉矶，就撞进一桩危险、像迷宫一样的谜。片子里到处是分身，是林奇最阴暗、最可怕的电影之一，也是情感上最沉重的之一。它还是讲好莱坞的杰作：那是一面黑镜子，梦会变成噩梦。也因此，它是林奇最带自传色彩的作品之一。
plot_en: Betty comes to Hollywood to be an actress and finds, in the place where she is staying, a woman who has lost her memory in a car crash. The two of them name her Rita and try to find out who she is.
hook_en: David Lynch’s perverse fairy tale tracks the downward spiral of a bright-eyed young actress, Betty — a revelatory Naomi Watts in a career-defining performance — who stumbles into a dangerous, labyrinthine mystery shortly after arriving in Los Angeles. Filled with doubles, this is one of Lynch’s bleakest and most terrifying films, and among his most emotionally devastating. It’s also one of the great movies about Hollywood, a dark mirror world where dreams turn into nightmares, which means that it’s one of Lynch’s most autobiographical works, too.

plot: 菲尔德以商业顾问的身份走进真实的小店，提出过分到似乎可行的方案：假折扣、假情人和一整套让顾客困惑的手续。老板常常照做。
hook: 内森·菲尔德假扮商业顾问，给真实的小店老板出各种荒唐主意，比如开一家「笨蛋星巴克」。老板们居然认真照做，笑点来自尴尬和人们的礼貌。节目越往后越像一场关于现实与表演的实验，最后一集《寻找弗朗西丝》很特别。
plot_en: Fielder walks into real small businesses as a consultant and proposes schemes that are excessive and seem as if they might work: fake discounts, a fake romance, a whole procedure designed to confuse the customer. The owners often go along.
hook_en: Nathan Fielder poses as a business consultant and gives real small-business owners absurd ideas, such as a “Dumb Starbucks.” The owners actually try them. The jokes come from the embarrassment and from people’s politeness. As it goes on it becomes more like an experiment about reality and performance. The last episode, “Finding Frances,” is a thing apart.

plot: 退伍兵在沙漠里发现一笔毒贩没来得及带走的钱，决定带走。一个拿着汽枪的杀手沿途追上来，镇上的老警长看着这件事往下走。
hook: “你赌硬币，最多输过多少？”杀手安东·奇古尔（哈维尔·巴登）问加油站老板。对方没想到，自己那天是在拿命赌。奇古尔近乎超人，在这部新西部犯罪片里一路追下去。科恩兄弟把它从科马克·麦卡锡那本写暴力和命运的小说改过来。很长的段落没有音乐，也没有对白，只是男人在拼命不死。可就像片中一个人说的：“来的东西，你挡不住。”
plot_en: A veteran finds, in the desert, a sum of money that drug dealers did not have time to take, and decides to take it. A killer with a cattle gun follows the trail. The old sheriff in town watches it go on.
hook_en: “What’s the most you ever lost on a coin toss?” the menacing hit man Anton Chigurh (Javier Bardem) asks a gas station owner, who didn’t realize he was going to gamble with death that day. Chigurh verges on superhuman as he stalks through this neo-western crime thriller that the Coen brothers adapted from Cormac McCarthy’s blood-soaked novel about violence and fate. Long stretches have no music or dialogue — it’s just men working hard not to die. But as one character puts it, “You can’t stop what’s comin’.”

plot: 斯莱戈的中学里，康奈尔和玛丽安秘密在一起；到了都柏林的三一学院，阶级和说话的方式对调了。他们一再分开，又在对方最熟悉的沉默里相遇。
hook: 改编自萨莉·鲁尼的小说，讲两个爱尔兰年轻人从高中到大学的分分合合。剧情不靠大事件，靠误会、沉默和阶层差异让人揪心。保罗·麦斯卡因此走红，亲密戏拍得自然而克制。
plot_en: In a school in Sligo, Connell and Marianne are together in secret. At Trinity College in Dublin, class and the way of speaking trade places. They keep separating, and meeting again in the silence the other person knows best.
hook_en: Adapted from Sally Rooney’s novel. Two young people in Ireland come together and apart from secondary school through university. It does not run on big events. It runs on misunderstandings, silence, and class, and that is what makes it hurt. Paul Mescal became known for it. The sex is filmed plainly and with restraint.

plot: 1930 年代的密西西比，埃弗雷特带着两个同伴逃出苦役营，去找他声称埋下的宝藏。路上他们灌了唱片、卷进州长竞选，警察也一直跟在后面。
hook: 科恩兄弟这部染了棕褐色的冒险片，自称改编自荷马的《奥德赛》。这条线最多是松的，它端上来的却是一大锅民间故事、吹牛和幻想。尘土飞扬的大萧条时期的密西西比，三个不太聪明的逃犯出发去寻宝。接下来是一趟任性、热闹的路。把这次追寻抬成关于自由、宽恕、希望，以及我们天生有多少缺陷的寓言的，是他们用的美国音乐：福音、三角洲布鲁斯和蓝草。
plot_en: In Mississippi in the 1930s, Everett escapes a prison farm with two companions to find a treasure he says he buried. Along the way they cut a record and get pulled into a governor’s race, and the police stay behind them.
hook_en: This sepia-toned Coen brothers adventure is presented as an adaptation of Homer’s “Odyssey,” and while that thread is loose at best, it delivers a hearty stew of folklore, tall tales and even fantasy. In dusty Depression-era Mississippi, three dimwitted escaped convicts take off on a treasure hunt. A whimsical, rollicking ride ensues, but it’s the filmmakers’ use of Americana music including gospel, Delta blues and bluegrass that elevates this quest into an allegory about freedom, forgiveness, hope and the many ways we are inherently flawed.

plot: 丹尼·奥申刑满出狱，目标是三家赌场共用的一个金库。他找来老搭档鲁斯蒂，再凑齐另外九个人，每人负责一道他自己过不去的关。
hook: 明星的光很少比史蒂文·索德伯格这次重拍更亮。原作是 1960 年鼠帮那部抢劫片。这一版把最潇洒的乔治·克鲁尼和一个头发刺起来、带点顽皮的布拉德·皮特配在一起。紧张一直在，样子却始终光滑、有型。丹尼·奥申队伍里的每一个人都让人高兴，包括戴着过大眼镜的艾略特·古尔德，和一口英国口音的唐·钱德尔。索德伯格给拉斯维加斯的那层梦，和银幕上的名人是配得上的。
plot_en: Danny Ocean gets out of prison and sets his sights on a vault shared by three casinos. He finds his old partner Rusty and makes up the other nine, each of them responsible for a step Danny cannot get past himself.
hook_en: Star power has never been more glittery than in Steven Soderbergh’s remake of the 1960 Rat Pack heist picture. This version pairs George Clooney at his most suave with an impish, spiky-haired Brad Pitt for a romp that keeps tension high while remaining impeccably sleek and stylish. Each member of Danny Ocean’s team is an utter delight, including Elliott Gould in oversize glasses and Don Cheadle with a British accent. And Soderbergh gives Las Vegas a dreamy aura that matches the celebrities onscreen.

plot: 吴大修在一个看不出位置的房间里被关了十五年，电视是他唯一的窗口。放出来的那天，对方给他五天，去查出是谁关的他、为什么。
hook: 韩国导演朴赞郁“复仇三部曲”的中间一部，打下来像一锤子，打在头上、腿上、胳膊上，以及主角能打到的任何地方。他要从一条满是打手的走廊里打出去。那场出名的动作戏，代表了这部又绕又扭曲的惊悚片在暴力上的歌剧尺度。情绪也被拧到头。《老男孩》挑衅，让人不安，直到最后那一格令人不安的含糊。
plot_en: Oh Dae-su is locked for fifteen years in a room whose location he cannot tell. Television is his only window. The day he is let out, the other side gives him five days to find out who locked him up, and why.
hook_en: The middle entry in the South Korean director Park Chan-wook’s Vengeance Trilogy hits like a hammer — to the head, leg, arm and anywhere else its protagonist can strike as he fights his way out of a hallway full of thugs. That celebrated action sequence is emblematic of this twisty (and twisted) thriller’s operatic levels of violence, but its emotions are dialed to extremes, too: “Oldboy” provokes and unsettles, right up to its disturbingly ambiguous final frame.

plot: 1969 年，过气演员里克·道尔顿和替身演员克利夫在好莱坞找下一份工作。他们的邻居是罗曼·波兰斯基，同一条街上有一群年轻人正打那栋房子的主意。
hook: 像斯科塞斯的纽约、费里尼的罗马，昆汀·塔伦蒂诺的洛杉矶也值得看。这封写给 1969 年家乡的热烈情书，是一场最大限度的梦：过气的虚构电视明星（莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥），他话不多的替身搭档（布拉德·皮特），一群曼森家族的怪人，以及真实存在的明星莎朗·塔特（玛格特·罗比把她演成纯粹的金发阳光）。然后剧本离开了既定的历史，走向电影史上最漂亮、也最离谱的结局之一。
plot_en: In 1969 the fading actor Rick Dalton and his stunt double Cliff are looking for the next job in Hollywood. Their neighbor is Roman Polanski. On the same street, a group of young people is taking an interest in that house.
hook_en: Like Martin Scorsese’s New York or Federico Fellini’s Rome, Quentin Tarantino’s Los Angeles is a thing to behold: The director’s fevered love letter to his hometown circa 1969 is a gonzo-maximalist dream, encompassing a fictional fading TV star (Leonardo DiCaprio), his laconic stuntman-sidekick (Brad Pitt), a passel of Manson family freaks and the very real starlet Sharon Tate (played as pure blond sunshine by Margot Robbie). From there, the script breaks with established history, building to one of the most bravura and far-out finales in film history.

plot: 物理学家奥本海默受邀领导洛斯阿拉莫斯的原子弹研制。炸弹做成之后，电影转到多年后的一场听证：他的忠诚、他的婚姻，以及他是否还能接触国家机密。
hook: 原子弹之父，也就是我们这个末日时代的父亲，给了导演克里斯托弗·诺兰一个适合做代表作的题材。诺兰着迷于科学和人文撞在一起。他把片子明确搭在权力被制造出来的方式上：裂变和聚变，每一种都可能产生，也可能毁灭。他做成了一部歌剧式的史诗，同时是历史、惊悚和警告。
plot_en: The physicist Oppenheimer is asked to lead the building of the atomic bomb at Los Alamos. After the bomb is made, the film moves to a hearing years later: his loyalty, his marriage, and whether he can still be trusted with state secrets.
hook_en: The father of the atomic bomb, and thus of our apocalyptic age, provides the director Christopher Nolan an ideal subject for his magnum opus. Nolan is obsessed with the collision of science and humanism; in structuring the film explicitly around the ways power is created — fission and fusion, each potentially generative and destructive — he has made an operatic epic that is history, thriller and warning, all in one.

plot: 财务顾问马蒂·伯德为墨西哥卡特尔洗钱失败，带着家人躲到欧扎克湖区，用当地生意把脏钱洗干净。妻子温迪很快不再满足于只做掩护。
hook: 理财顾问一家被迫逃到密苏里的湖区，替墨西哥贩毒集团洗钱。比《绝命毒师》更冷，更像一部家庭求生剧。朱莉娅·加纳演的当地女孩露丝是全剧亮点，凭此拿了三座艾美奖。
plot_en: The financial adviser Marty Byrde fails at laundering money for a Mexican cartel and takes his family to the Lake of the Ozarks, using local businesses to clean the money. His wife Wendy soon wants to be more than the cover.
hook_en: A financial adviser’s family is forced to flee to a lake district in Missouri and launder money for a Mexican cartel. It is colder than Breaking Bad, and more like a family trying to survive. Julia Garner’s local girl Ruth is the highlight, and she won three Emmys for it.

plot: 1944 年西班牙，奥菲莉亚跟着母亲嫁给一个残暴的军官。她在迷宫里遇到羊首神，对方交给她三件事，说她本是地下王国的公主。
hook: 一个放在佛朗哥时代西班牙的黑暗童话。它把吉尔莫·德尔·托罗从恐怖片和漫画改编推进了所谓的正经电影，他标志性的人道、魔幻现实和出色的生物设计都还在。年幼的奥菲莉亚躲开灰暗的处境，尤其是新来的法西斯继父，走进一个想象的空间。神秘的羊首神给她任务，让她证明自己的价值。这则视觉耀眼的寓言，把德尔·托罗确定为我们这个时代最好的电影作者之一。
plot_en: In Spain in 1944, Ofelia follows her mother into a marriage with a brutal officer. In a labyrinth she meets a faun, who gives her three tasks and tells her she is the princess of an underground kingdom.
hook_en: A dark fairy tale set in Franco-era Spain, this was the film that propelled Guillermo del Toro from horror movies and comic-book adaptations into the world of prestige filmmaking, albeit with his signature humanism, magical realism and superb creature creations intact. Young Ofelia escapes her bleak circumstances — particularly life under her fascist new stepfather — by entering an imaginary space where a mystical faun sets her on a quest to prove her worth. The visually dazzling allegory affirmed del Toro as one of our finest filmmakers today.

plot: 金家四口住在半地下室，靠折叠披萨盒过活。儿子伪造学历，进了朴社长家当家教，父母和妹妹也跟着一个个混进去。
hook: 一个关于有产者和无产者的故事，也是对新自由主义造成的破坏的激烈反击。奉俊昊这部又好看好不安的电影，跟着一户赤贫的人家，看他们一点点挤进一户富人家里。奉俊昊不受类型规矩束缚，全片在闹剧和尖刻的社会讽刺之间滑来滑去，最后用一场既惊人又像注定会发生的悲剧暴力，把一切点着。影片在美国上映时，他只是艺术院线里受欢迎的导演；下映时，他拿了一把奥斯卡，包括最佳影片，也成了全世界的新明星。
plot_en: The four Kims live in a semi-basement and get by folding pizza boxes. The son forges his credentials and enters the Park household as a tutor. His parents and his sister follow him in, one by one.
hook_en: A tale of haves and have-nots, and a ferocious rebuke to the devastations of neoliberalism, Bong Joon Ho’s pleasurably kinked and unsettling shocker follows a destitute family as it insinuates itself into a wealthy household. Bong, a master of genre unbound by convention, fluidly shifts between broad comedy and blistering social satire throughout, then lights it all on fire with a paroxysm of tragic violence that’s as stunning as it is inevitable. When the movie opened in the United States, Bong was a favorite on the art-house circuit; by the time it closed, he had a fistful of Oscars, including best picture, and the world had a new superstar.

plot: 莱斯利·诺普在印第安纳州波尼镇的公园部门工作，相信会议、表格和一份更厚的早餐能改善公共生活。同事们大多不信，但还是跟着她做。
hook: 小镇公园部门的莱斯莉真心想为社区做点事，身边的同事一个比一个奇葩。第一季比较像《办公室》的翻版，从第二季开始变得温暖又好笑。尼克·奥弗曼演的罗恩·斯旺森是经典角色。
plot_en: Leslie Knope works for the parks department in Pawnee, Indiana, and believes that meetings, forms, and a larger breakfast can improve public life. Her colleagues mostly do not believe it, and follow her anyway.
hook_en: Leslie, in a small-town parks department, genuinely wants to do something for the community. The colleagues around her are each stranger than the last. The first season is fairly close to a copy of The Office. From the second season it becomes warm and funny. Nick Offerman’s Ron Swanson is a classic role.

plot: 娜英小时候随家人从首尔移民，和男同学海成断了联系。二十多年后她在纽约当编剧、已经结婚，海成飞来见她。
hook: 席琳·宋这部处女作的开场就把人勾住：深夜，纽约一家酒吧，一个女人（格蕾塔·李）坐在两个男人（刘太旿和约翰·马加罗）中间，看不清他们彼此是什么关系。结尾还是这三个人，在人行道上一个镜头拍完，很可能会把心打碎。中间，故事在纽约和首尔展开，满是关于时间、爱、命运和重新把自己做成另一个人的细想。
plot_en: Nora leaves Seoul with her family as a child and loses touch with her classmate Hae Sung. More than twenty years later she is a writer in New York and already married, and Hae Sung flies in to see her.
hook_en: The opening scene of Celine Song’s debut feature beguiles you: Late at night in a New York bar, a woman (played by Greta Lee) is seated between two men (Teo Yoo and John Magaro) and it’s unclear who they are to one another. The closing scene with the same three people, filmed in one take on a sidewalk, may well shatter your heart. In between, Song’s story unfolds in New York City and Seoul and is filled with exquisite reflections on time, love, fate and reinvention.

plot: 一战结束后，汤米·谢尔比带着伯明翰的家族帮派从赛马和街头生意往上走，一路碰到爱尔兰共和军、政客和法西斯。剃刀帮要变成一门正当的权力。
hook: 一战后的伯明翰，谢尔比家族从街头帮派一路打进政坛。慢镜头、摇滚配乐和大衣加报童帽的造型都非常有型。基里安·墨菲演的汤米冷静、带着战争创伤，前三季最好看。
plot_en: After the First World War, Tommy Shelby takes his family gang in Birmingham up from horse races and street business, and along the way meets the IRA, politicians, and fascists. The razor gang is trying to become a legitimate power.
hook_en: Birmingham after the First World War. The Shelby family fights its way from a street gang into politics. The slow motion, the rock score, and the overcoats and flat caps are all very styled. Cillian Murphy’s Tommy is calm and carrying the war. The first three seasons are the best.

plot: 马克和杰里米合住在伦敦南边。镜头钻进他们的眼睛，旁白说出他们真正在想的话：一个是焦虑的贷款经理，一个是不肯找工作的音乐人。
hook: 英国情景喜剧，大量第一视角镜头配上两位男主的内心独白，你能同时听到他们说出口的话和心里的真实想法。一个焦虑古板，一个懒散不靠谱，互相嫌弃又离不开。编剧之一杰西·阿姆斯特朗后来创作了《继承之战》。
plot_en: Mark and Jeremy share a flat in south London. The camera goes in through their eyes, and the narration says what they are actually thinking: one is an anxious loan manager, the other a musician who will not get a job.
hook_en: A British sitcom. A lot of it is shot from a first-person view, with the two men’s interior monologue, so you hear what they say and what they actually think. One is anxious and prim. The other is lazy and unreliable. They cannot stand each other and cannot leave. One of the writers, Jesse Armstrong, later created Succession.

plot: 两位成年女演员扮演 2000 年的自己，回到初中：即时通讯、不合身的衣服，以及一份认真到可笑的友谊。周围的同学由真正的少年扮演。
hook: 两位 30 多岁的女演员扮演 13 岁的自己，同学则由真正的 13 岁孩子出演。拍的是 2000 年前后初中生活里的尴尬、暗恋、友谊和种种第一次，很搞笑，也很诚实。
plot_en: Two adult actresses play themselves in the year 2000 and go back to middle school: instant messaging, clothes that do not fit, and a friendship taken seriously to the point of being ridiculous. The classmates around them are played by actual adolescents.
hook_en: Two actresses in their thirties play themselves at 13. The classmates are played by actual 13-year-olds. It is middle school around 2000: the embarrassment, the crushes, the friendship, and the various first times. Very funny, and honest.

plot: 裁缝雷诺兹·伍德科克在伦敦给名流做裙子，生活由姐姐和固定的作息管着。女服务员阿尔玛进了工作室，当他的模特，也要在这栋房子里有自己的位置。
hook: 可别把保罗·托马斯·安德森这部 1950 年代的时装戏叫成“时髦”。裁缝雷诺兹·伍德科克由丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯出演，他会要你的脑袋。片子华丽，也在拆台，讲苛刻的雷诺兹和他不听话的缪斯阿尔玛（维姬·克里普斯）的爱情。他易怒，一点就烦；她喜欢钻到他皮肤下面。看起来安德森像在查关系里的权力差，其实是一个男人遇见了对等的人。饿着的男孩们，吃吧。
plot_en: The dressmaker Reynolds Woodcock makes gowns for the famous in London. His sister and a fixed routine run the house. The waitress Alma comes into the workroom as his model, and wants a place of her own in that house.
hook_en: Don’t you dare call Paul Thomas Anderson’s delectable 1950s fashion drama “chic.” The couturier Reynolds Woodcock, played by Daniel Day-Lewis, would have your head. This film is sumptuous and subversive, recounting the love story between the exacting Reynolds and his unruly muse, Alma (Vicky Krieps). He is prickly and easily perturbed; she delights in getting under his skin. It may seem that Anderson is investigating power imbalances in relationships; instead it’s the tale of a man meeting his match. Eat up, you hungry boys.

plot: BBC 的十一集自然系列，从极地、洞穴、平原到深海，记录当时的摄影还很难靠近的动物行为。爱登堡的旁白把景观说成一座还在运转的系统。
hook: BBC 自然纪录片，耗时五年拍摄，用高清镜头拍下雪豹、深海生物和动物大迁徙等罕见画面。大卫·爱登堡的解说沉稳动听。它定下了现代自然纪录片的视觉标准，最好用大屏幕看。
plot_en: The BBC’s eleven-part nature series, from the poles, caves, and plains to the deep ocean, records animal behavior that the cameras of the time could barely get near. Attenborough’s narration treats the landscape as a system that is still running.
hook_en: A BBC nature documentary, filmed over five years, using high-definition cameras on snow leopards, deep-sea life, and the great migrations, images that were rarely seen. David Attenborough’s narration is steady and good to listen to. It set the visual standard for modern nature documentaries. It is best on a large screen.

plot: 画家玛丽安受雇给即将出嫁的小姐埃洛伊兹画一幅肖像，条件是不能让她知道自己在被画。每天陪她散步之后，这件差事保不住了。
hook: 塞利娜·席安玛这部安静却扎人的历史片里，18 世纪的两个女人，贵族埃洛伊兹（阿黛尔·艾奈尔）和画家玛丽安（诺埃米·梅兰特），在法国海边秘密地、烈地相爱。这不是典型的禁忌欲望故事，她们也不抱幻觉，但期限像绳子一样吊在头顶，她们确实在受苦：埃洛伊兹已经被许给米兰的贵族。分开很久之后的最后一场，把服从社会和放弃自己之后留下的震荡，演得让人挪不开，也像被掏空。
plot_en: The painter Marianne is hired to paint a portrait of Héloïse, who is about to be married, on the condition that Héloïse not know she is being painted. After the daily walks, the arrangement cannot hold.
hook_en: In Céline Sciamma’s quietly piercing historical drama, two 18th-century women, the aristocrat Héloïse (Adèle Haenel) and the artist Marianne (Noémie Merlant), fall secretly and blisteringly in love along the coast of France. But this isn’t a typical saga of forbidden desire, and these women suffer no illusions, though with a deadline hanging over them like a noose, they certainly do suffer: Héloïse is promised to a Milanese nobleman. And the closing scene, long after they’ve parted, is an unshakable, eviscerating display of the aftershocks of social subordination and self-abandonment.

plot: 巴里卖特制活塞，不会跟人聊天，七个姐姐不停打电话来羞辱他。他先被一通诈骗电话搅进去，然后认识了同样笨拙的莉娜。
hook: 保罗·托马斯·安德森这部片子，一边是神经喜剧的疯，一边是爱情片的认真，压住它的是亚当·桑德勒演得最好的一次。他演一个不会社交的推销员，爱上一个胆怯的女人（艾米莉·沃森），一层一层揭开没想到的东西。两个人是怪癖天堂里的一对。片子在庆祝我们每个人身上那个不合群的部分。
plot_en: Barry sells novelty plungers, cannot talk to people, and has seven sisters who call to humiliate him. He is first dragged in by a phone scam, and then meets Lena, who is awkward in the same way.
hook_en: This Paul Thomas Anderson film incorporates the zaniness of a screwball comedy and the earnestness of a romantic drama, anchored by a career-best performance from Adam Sandler. He reveals layer after surprising layer as a socially awkward salesman who falls for a timid woman (Emily Watson). The two are a match made in quirk heaven in a film that celebrates the eccentric in all of us.

plot: 味觉敏锐的老鼠雷米不愿意再吃垃圾。他跑到巴黎一家曾经辉煌的餐厅，钻进学徒林贵尼的帽子，靠拉头发指挥这个不会做菜的人。
hook: 一只卡通老鼠、巴黎的背景、一个弱者（好吧，弱鼠）的故事：很多动画都是这个开头。把老一套再煮一遍，和把一道经典菜做高，是不一样的，就像片名这道菜本身的路径。雷米是乡下的老鼠，味觉精，也相信自己。他进城去实现做菜的梦，由此开始一场迷人、机智、让人动心的冒险。关于重新点燃热情，哪怕热情早就变成苦差，它留下的东西在宴席结束之后还在。
plot_en: Remy, a rat with a sharp palate, will not eat garbage anymore. He runs to a once-great restaurant in Paris, climbs into the toque of the apprentice Linguini, and directs this person who cannot cook by pulling his hair.
hook_en: A cartoon rodent, a Paris backdrop, an underdog (OK, under-rat) story: It’s the setup for many animated tales. But there’s a difference between rehashing the same-old and elevating a classic, much like the trajectory of this movie’s titular dish. Remy, a country rat with a sophisticated palate and a belief in himself, heads to the city to make his culinary dreams come true — setting off an enchanting, witty and touching adventure. Its lessons about reigniting our passions, even when they have long turned to drudgery, linger well after the feast.

plot: 俄克拉何马保留地上的四个原住民少年打算离开这里，去加州。一个朋友的死让出走变成未完成的心愿，社区里的长辈则不断把他们拉回具体的生活。
hook: 四个原住民少年在俄克拉何马的保留地偷东西攒钱，想去加州完成死去朋友的心愿。编剧、导演和主要演员几乎都是原住民，幽默里带着一点魔幻。三季完结，越往后越动人。
plot_en: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma plan to leave for California. A friend’s death turns the leaving into an unfinished wish, and the elders in the community keep pulling them back into the specifics of a life.
hook_en: Four Indigenous teenagers on a reservation in Oklahoma steal to save money. They want to go to California and finish a dead friend’s wish. The writers, directors, and principal cast are almost all Indigenous. The humor has a little of the supernatural in it. Three seasons, and it ends. It gets more moving as it goes.

plot: 女佣克利奥在墨西哥城一户中产人家里干活，女主人的丈夫长期不回家。克利奥自己有了身孕，孩子的父亲却不见了。
hook: 这是阿方索·卡隆拍给自己的电影。四十多岁到五十岁出头，他大多在拍大预算的幻想片，然后转回这部黑白的、华丽地平常的记忆。雅利扎·阿帕里西奥演克利奥，1970 年代墨西哥城一户中产人家的女佣。问题来了，有的普通，有的不普通。她安静的无私把他们带过去。卡隆凭导演和摄影拿了奥斯卡。
plot_en: The maid Cleo works for a middle-class family in Mexico City. The lady of the house has a husband who stays away. Cleo herself becomes pregnant, and the father of the child disappears.
hook_en: This is Alfonso Cuarón’s film for himself. After spending his 40s and early 50s mostly on big-budget fantasies, the Mexican virtuoso turned to this dazzlingly mundane black-and-white memory piece. Yalitza Aparicio plays Cleo, a maid for a middle-class family in Mexico City in the 1970s. Problems arise, ordinary and otherwise. Her quiet selflessness gets them through. Cuarón won Oscars for his direction and cinematography.

plot: 变装皇后比赛服装、表演和口播，输的人在对嘴演唱里争取留下。后台的友谊、竞争和一句评语，构成每一季的剧情。
hook: 变装皇后竞赛真人秀，比服装、表演、喜剧和对嘴唱。它把变装文化带进主流，也带火了很多选手和流行语。毒舌点评和后台八卦都很好看。
plot_en: Drag queens compete in costume, performance, and talking to camera. The loser lip-syncs for the chance to stay. Friendships, competition, and a single remark backstage make the plot of each season.
hook_en: A reality competition for drag queens: costume, performance, comedy, and lip-sync. It brought drag into the mainstream, and made a lot of contestants and catchphrases. The sharp judging and the backstage gossip are both good to watch.

plot: 奥利维亚·波普在华盛顿替权贵处理不能见报的危机，自己却与总统维持着一段足以掀翻白宫的关系。她的团队叫角斗士，工作是在截稿时间之前改写事实。
hook: 华盛顿的危机公关奥利维亚·波普替权贵摆平丑闻，自己却和总统有婚外情。剧情反转极快，几乎每集都有惊人情节，是一部节奏很爽的政治狗血剧。凯丽·华盛顿是近 40 年来第一位在美国电视网剧集担任主角的非裔女演员。
plot_en: Olivia Pope handles crises in Washington that cannot appear in the papers, and is herself in a relationship with the president that could bring down the White House. Her team is called the gladiators. The job is to rewrite the facts before the deadline.
hook_en: Olivia Pope, a crisis manager in Washington, cleans up scandals for the powerful, and is having an affair with the president. The plot turns extremely fast. Almost every episode has something astonishing. It is a political soap with a very satisfying pace. Kerry Washington was the first Black woman in nearly forty years to lead an American network series.

plot: 罗斯一家把财产输光，只好搬进他们曾经当作玩笑买下的小镇。汽车旅馆的两个房间里，原来的做派一点一点碰上来自小镇的善意。
hook: 富豪一家破产，只能搬进他们当玩笑买下的小镇。第一季看着像普通的富人落难喜剧，后面越来越温暖，每个人都有成长。最后一季包揽了艾美喜剧类全部七个主要奖项。
plot_en: The Rose family loses its fortune and has to move to the small town they once bought as a joke. In two rooms at the motel, the old manner collides, a little at a time, with the town’s goodwill.
hook_en: A rich family goes broke and has to move to a town they bought as a joke. The first season looks like an ordinary comedy about the rich brought low. Later it gets warmer, and each person changes. The last season swept all seven major comedy Emmys.

plot: 卢蒙公司的员工接受手术，把工作记忆和生活记忆切开。电梯下行之后，另一个自己开始上班，并且不想永远留在楼里。
hook: 公司员工通过手术把工作记忆和生活记忆分开，上班的自己不知道下班的自己是谁。设定新奇，复古冷色的办公室美术辨识度极高。悬念层层推进，第一季结尾非常抓人。本·斯蒂勒执导了第一季的大部分剧集。
plot_en: Employees of Lumon accept a procedure that splits work memory from life memory. After the elevator goes down, another self starts the shift, and does not want to stay in the building forever.
hook_en: A company’s employees undergo a procedure that separates the memory of work from the memory of life. The self at work does not know who the self at home is. The premise is new, and the retro, cold-colored office design is immediately recognizable. The mysteries stack up. The end of the first season grabs you. Ben Stiller directed most of the first season.

plot: 1600 年的日本，英国水手布莱克索恩的船漂到岸上，正赶上大名之间决定谁来统治的前夜。翻译真理夫人把两套语言、两套忠诚都扛在身上。
hook: 1600 年的日本，战国末期，一名英国领航员漂流上岸，卷入大名之间的权力斗争。台词大部分是日语，服装、礼仪和政治博弈都很讲究。真田广之主演兼任制片，第一季拿下创纪录的 18 项艾美奖。
plot_en: In Japan in 1600, the English sailor Blackthorne’s ship drifts ashore on the eve of the lords deciding who will rule. Lady Mariko, the translator, carries both languages and both loyalties.
hook_en: Japan in 1600, at the end of the warring states. An English navigator washes ashore and is pulled into the struggle among the lords. Most of the dialogue is in Japanese. The costume, the etiquette, and the political maneuvering are all careful. Hiroyuki Sanada stars and produces. The first season won a record 18 Emmys.

plot: 费舍尔家在洛杉矶经营殡仪馆。每一集以一次死亡开场，活着的人则继续吵架、相爱和把遗体推进房间。
hook: 一家人经营殡仪馆，每集开头都会死一个人，死亡成了日常话题。它真正讲的是活着的人怎样面对失去、性取向和家庭关系。最后几分钟的蒙太奇，被公认为电视剧史上最好的结局之一。
plot_en: The Fisher family runs a funeral home in Los Angeles. Each episode opens with a death. The living go on arguing, loving, and wheeling the body into the room.
hook_en: A family runs a funeral home. Someone dies at the start of each episode, and death becomes an ordinary subject. What it is really about is how the living face loss, sexuality, and the family. The montage in the last few minutes is widely taken as one of the best endings in the history of television.

plot: 军情五处把犯错的特工发配到斯劳部门，由邋遢的冷战老人杰克逊·兰姆看管。这群被叫做慢马的人，仍会撞上总部不想亲手处理的案子。
hook: 军情五处把犯了错的特工发配到「斯劳屋」，这群失败者却总能卷进真正的大案。加里·奥德曼演的上司杰克逊·兰姆邋遢、毒舌又极其能干，光看他就值回票价。每季六集，节奏快，适合一口气看完。
plot_en: MI5 posts the agents who have made mistakes to Slough House, under Jackson Lamb, a slovenly old man from the Cold War. The people called the slow horses still run into the cases the head office does not want to handle itself.
hook_en: MI5 exiles the agents who have failed to Slough House, and this group of losers keeps getting pulled into real cases. Gary Oldman’s boss, Jackson Lamb, is slovenly, vicious, and extremely capable. He alone is worth it. Six episodes a season, fast, easy to watch in one sitting.

plot: 山姆在姐姐去世后留在堪萨斯老家，觉得自己是这里的外人。一个合唱团和朋友乔尔让她重新开口唱歌，也重新学习怎么待在一个小镇里。
hook: 中年女人山姆在姐姐去世后留在堪萨斯老家，一直找不到归属感，直到加入一群小镇「边缘人」的歌唱聚会。节奏慢，没有大反转，但写友情和孤独非常温柔。布里吉特·埃弗里特开口唱歌的段落很动人。
plot_en: After her sister dies, Sam stays in her hometown in Kansas and feels like an outsider there. A choir and her friend Joel get her singing again, and get her learning how to stay in a small town.
hook_en: Sam, a middle-aged woman, stays in her Kansas hometown after her sister’s death and cannot find a place she belongs, until she joins a singing group of the town’s outsiders. It is slow, with no big reversal, and it is very gentle about friendship and loneliness. The passages where Bridget Everett sings are moving.

plot: 千寻和父母误入神灵的城镇，父母因为贪吃变成了猪。她在汤屋老板娘那里干活，想把父母变回来，也想帮白龙记起自己是谁。
hook: 宫崎骏这部手绘的青春期童话，是我们这个时代的《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。废弃的神奇澡堂里不断冒出忘不掉的角色：锅炉爷爷和他的煤灰精灵、戴面具的无脸、少年龙白龙，以及把这一切走通的勇敢的千寻。她那对糊涂父母被女巫变成了猪。片子把宫崎骏一直在想的事合在一起：人怎样败坏自然、天真怎样失去、吓人的生物其实不是看上去那样。《千与千寻》是一场少有对手的奇幻冒险，在动画里如此，在动画之外也如此。
plot_en: Chihiro and her parents wander into a town of spirits, and her parents are turned into pigs for eating too much. She goes to work for the woman who runs the bathhouse, trying to turn her parents back, and to help Haku remember who he is.
hook_en: Hayao Miyazaki’s hand-drawn fairy tale of adolescence is the “Alice in Wonderland” of our age. Unforgettable characters keep spilling out of an abandoned magical bathhouse — the boilerman and his soot sprites, the masked spirit No-Face, Haku the boy-dragon and, navigating it all, brave Chihiro, whose clueless parents have been turned into pigs by a witch. Beautifully uniting the master animator’s preoccupations — man’s corruption of nature, the loss of innocence, intimidating creatures who aren’t what they seem — “Spirited Away” is a spellbinding adventure with few peers in animation or elsewhere.

plot: 《波士顿环球报》的新主编让调查组看看一条旧线索：天主教神父性侵儿童，教会用调职把事情压下去。小组从一份名单开始，去敲受害人的门。
hook: 一则侦探故事：记者揭开波士顿总教区怎样掩盖一桩巨大的儿童性侵丑闻。《聚焦》是一部收着的程序片，讲一群英雄固执地追真相。这部奥斯卡最佳影片被喜欢，正因为报纸戏里常见的大段演讲和剥削性的闪回，它都没有，它把自己交给一份常常并不光鲜的工作里那些并不光鲜的细节。
plot_en: The new editor of The Boston Globe tells the investigations team to look at an old lead: Catholic priests abused children, and the church buried it by transferring them. The team starts from a list and knocks on the victims’ doors.
hook_en: A detective story about journalists uncovering the Boston archdiocese’s efforts to hide a huge child sexual abuse scandal, “Spotlight” is an understated procedural about heroes in dogged pursuit of the truth. This best picture Oscar winner was beloved precisely because it lacked the big speeches and exploitative flashbacks that often accompany newspaper dramas and instead committed itself to the unglamorous details of an often unglamorous job.

plot: 一群负债的人同意参加一套童年游戏，赢家拿走巨额奖金，输家死在场上。成奇勋以为自己还能用善良理解规则，规则却只认人数。
hook: 456 个负债累累的人参加童年游戏，输了就死，赢家拿走巨额奖金。设定简单，视觉鲜艳，第一季成了 Netflix 史上观看量最高的剧集。真正打动人的，是每个参赛者被生活逼到绝境的处境。
plot_en: A group of people in debt agree to play a set of children’s games. The winner takes a huge prize. The losers die on the field. Seong Gi-hun thinks he can still understand the rules through kindness. The rules only count the numbers.
hook_en: 456 people deep in debt play children’s games. Lose and you die. The winner takes a huge sum. The premise is simple and the images are bright. The first season became the most-watched series in Netflix’s history. What actually moves you is the position each player has been pushed into by ordinary life.

plot: 一场流感之后，巡演的交响乐团在五大湖边的废墟之间走路，用莎士比亚换食宿。一本漫画把疫情之夜的几个陌生人，在二十年后又接起来。
hook: 一场致命流感摧毁文明 20 年后，一支巡回剧团在废墟间演出莎士比亚。剧情在疫情前、疫情中和多年之后来回切换。它不像典型的末日剧那么暴力，更关心艺术、记忆和人与人之间的联系。
plot_en: After a flu, a traveling symphony walks among the ruins around the Great Lakes and trades Shakespeare for food and a bed. A comic book joins several strangers from the night of the outbreak, twenty years later.
hook_en: Twenty years after a lethal flu destroys civilization, a traveling troupe performs Shakespeare among the ruins. The story moves between before the outbreak, during it, and years later. It is less violent than a typical end-of-the-world show. It is more interested in art, memory, and the ties between people.

plot: 1980 年代的印第安纳小镇，一个男孩失踪，朋友们拿着手电筒和一套桌面游戏的术语去找他。实验、另一侧的世界，和一位编号为十一的女孩连在一起。
hook: 80 年代的美国小镇，一个男孩失踪，他的朋友们和一个有超能力的女孩一起去找他。满是《E.T.》、斯蒂芬·金和《龙与地下城》式的复古氛围。第一季最完整，后几季规模更大，适合全家一起追。
plot_en: In an Indiana town in the 1980s, a boy disappears. His friends go looking for him with flashlights and the vocabulary of a tabletop game. An experiment, a world on the other side, and a girl numbered Eleven are connected.
hook_en: A boy disappears in an American town in the 1980s. His friends and a girl with powers go looking for him. It is full of the retro atmosphere of E.T., Stephen King, and Dungeons & Dragons. The first season is the most complete. The later seasons are bigger. It is easy to watch as a family.

plot: 媒体巨头洛根·罗伊中风之后，四个子女开始计算谁能接过公司。他们有钱、有伤害，也有一句永远说不出口的话：父亲并不打算交给任何人。
hook: 媒体帝国的父亲和四个子女争继承权，很像现代版《李尔王》。台词刻薄又好笑，几乎每个人都很糟，但都很好看。四季结构完整、结局干脆，三次拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
plot_en: After the media magnate Logan Roy has a stroke, his four children start calculating who can take the company. They have money and they have injuries, and they have a sentence they can never say: their father does not intend to give it to anyone.
hook_en: A media empire’s father and his four children fight over the succession. It is a lot like a modern King Lear. The dialogue is cruel and funny. Almost everyone is awful, and good to watch. Four seasons, a complete shape, a clean ending. It won the Emmy for best drama three times.

plot: 塞思和埃文快要高中毕业，想在同学的派对上把酒带到喜欢的女孩面前。朋友福格尔弄到一张假警察证件，被两个真警察拉去办差。
hook: 每一代人都有自己的青春喜剧。21 世纪的，是《太坏了》。塞斯·罗根和埃文·戈德堡的剧本，讲两个分别叫塞思（乔纳·希尔）和埃文（迈克尔·塞拉）的朋友，想在高中毕业前发生性关系。又脏得可笑，又偷偷地甜。导演格雷格·莫托拉把这些胡闹抬高了：复古的片头，以及一场涉及阳具卡通的、笑翻的段落。但《太坏了》也是一次选角上的成就，它把希尔、塞拉和艾玛·斯通的才能介绍给了观众。
plot_en: Seth and Evan are about to finish high school and want to bring alcohol to a classmate’s party, in front of the girls they like. Their friend Fogell gets a fake police ID and is pulled into a shift by two real officers.
hook_en: Every generation gets its defining teen comedy. For the 21st century, that’s “Superbad.” The script by Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg — about pals named Seth (Jonah Hill) and Evan (Michael Cera) trying to get laid before they graduate high school — is both hilariously profane and surreptitiously sweet. The director Greg Mottola took the antics and elevated them with retro opening titles and an uproarious sequence involving phallic cartoons. But “Superbad” is also a feat of casting, introducing moviegoers to the talents of Hill, Cera and Emma Stone.

plot: 一群陌生人被放到偏远地带，分组生活、赢得比赛，再在部落会议上把人投票送走。最后留下的人拿走奖金。体力很快就不如联盟重要。
hook: 真人秀的鼻祖之一：一群人被丢到荒岛上，分部落比赛、投票淘汰，最后一人赢走百万美元。真正决定输赢的是结盟和背叛。已经播了四十多季，至今仍在更新。
plot_en: A group of strangers is put in a remote place, lives in teams, wins competitions, and votes people out at tribal council. The last one left takes the money. Physical strength soon matters less than alliances.
hook_en: One of the originals of reality television: a group of people is dropped on a deserted island, competes in tribes, votes each other out, and the last person wins a million dollars. What actually decides it is alliances and betrayal. It has run more than forty seasons and is still on.

plot: 指挥家莉迪亚·塔尔处在事业顶上，正准备在柏林录制马勒。一个昔日学徒的死讯传来，她和年轻人的关系、她在乐团里的权威，一起开始松动。
hook: 托德·菲尔德离开导演岗位 16 年之后回来，拍了也许是“取消文化”时代最有代表性的电影。凯特·布兰切特演莉迪亚·塔尔，一位技艺很高的指挥，衬衫裁得极好，自负既是她最大的本钱，也是她最终的垮台。《塔尔》的把戏在于，菲尔德和布兰切特把莉迪亚做得那么细，有时会忘了她不是真人。它是对权力的一次很重的解剖，也常常很好笑。
plot_en: The conductor Lydia Tár is at the top of her career, preparing to record Mahler in Berlin. News arrives that a former protégée has died. Her relationships with young people, and her authority in the orchestra, start to come loose together.
hook_en: After a 16-year absence, Todd Field returned to directing with what is perhaps the defining movie of the cancel culture era. Cate Blanchett plays Lydia Tár, a virtuosic conductor with perfectly tailored shirts and a hubristic streak that is both her greatest asset and her ultimate downfall. The trick of “Tár” is that Field and Blanchett so meticulously craft Lydia that it’s occasionally hard to remember she’s not a real person. And considering that it makes for a weighty dissection of power, it’s also often hilarious.

plot: 美国橄榄球教练泰德·拉索被雇去执教一支英国足球队，东家原本指望他搞砸。他用饼干和不肯嘲讽人的办法，先改变了更衣室。
hook: 完全不懂足球的美国橄榄球教练，去执教一支英超球队。他乐观到近乎傻，却慢慢感染了身边的人。第一季是最暖的职场喜剧之一，后面几季单集变长，节奏也变散。
plot_en: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, is hired to manage an English soccer team. The owner originally expected him to wreck it. He starts by changing the locker room, with biscuits and a refusal to mock people.
hook_en: An American football coach who knows nothing about soccer is hired to manage a Premier League team. He is optimistic to the point of seeming foolish, and slowly infects the people around him. The first season is one of the warmest workplace comedies. Later seasons make the episodes longer, and the pace looser.

plot: 1965 年印尼屠杀中动过手的人，如今是地方上的头面人物。摄制组请他们挑选一种电影类型，把当年怎么杀人重演出来。
hook: 约书亚·奥本海默这部纪录长片的杰作，对象是 1965 到 1966 年印尼大屠杀的施行者。真正的主题，是人的头脑有多能把对别人的残忍行为隔开、合理化。奥本海默的做法，让电影看起来像心理恐怖，而因为它是非虚构的，就更吓人。
plot_en: Men who took part in the 1965 killings in Indonesia are now local figures of standing. The filmmakers ask them to choose a movie genre and reenact how they killed.
hook_en: Joshua Oppenheimer’s documentary masterpiece concerns the perpetrators of the Indonesian mass killings of 1965-66. Really, though, the subject is the incredible capacity of the human mind to compartmentalize and rationalize monstrous acts of cruelty toward other people. The way Oppenheimer goes about it makes for a movie that plays like psychological horror — all the more petrifying because it is nonfiction.

plot: 菲利普和伊丽莎白是潜入华盛顿郊区的克格勃特工，对外是旅行社夫妻，对内要执行莫斯科的任务。隔壁邻居正好在联邦调查局工作。
hook: 冷战时期，一对苏联间谍伪装成美国郊区夫妻，搬来的邻居偏偏是联邦调查局探员。任务戏很紧张，真正好看的是这段假婚姻怎样变成真感情，以及孩子知道真相后会怎样。结局被认为是近年最好的剧集收尾之一。
plot_en: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB agents planted in the Washington suburbs. In public they are a married couple who run a travel agency. In private they carry out Moscow’s assignments. The neighbor next door happens to work for the FBI.
hook_en: During the Cold War, a pair of Soviet spies pose as a married couple in an American suburb. The neighbor who moves in next door is an FBI agent. The missions are tense. What is really good is how the fake marriage becomes a real feeling, and what happens when the children learn the truth. The ending is taken as one of the best closes of a series in recent years.

plot: 名厨卡米回到芝加哥，接管哥哥自杀后留下的牛肉三明治店。厨房又吵又挤，他想把它做成一家真正的餐厅，家人却还停在丧事里。
hook: 顶级厨师回到芝加哥，接手已故哥哥留下的三明治店。厨房戏非常紧张，镜头和对白像在打仗。第一季第七集一镜到底；第二季的《鱼》是一场全家圣诞晚餐的灾难现场。
plot_en: The chef Carmy comes back to Chicago to take over the beef-sandwich shop his brother left when he killed himself. The kitchen is loud and cramped. He wants to make it a real restaurant. The family is still inside the funeral.
hook_en: A top chef comes back to Chicago to take over the sandwich shop his late brother left. The kitchen scenes are extremely tense. The camera and the dialogue feel like a fight. Episode seven of the first season is a single take. “Fishes,” in the second season, is a family Christmas dinner going to pieces.

plot: 法国外安总局的卧底「马洛特鲁」从大马士革回到巴黎，却没法把用了多年的身份脱下来。办公室用表格管理人，人用谎言管理自己。
hook: 法国对外情报局的卧底剧，没有 007 式的动作场面，重点是潜伏、审讯、伪装身份和心理压力。拍得很写实，常被认为是最接近真实情报工作的间谍剧之一。喜欢《锅匠，裁缝，士兵，间谍》的观众会对胃口。
plot_en: The undercover officer “Malotru,” of the French external service, comes back to Paris from Damascus and cannot take off an identity he has used for years. The office manages people with forms. People manage themselves with lies.
hook_en: An undercover series about France’s external intelligence service. There are no James Bond action scenes. The emphasis is on living undercover, interrogation, a false identity, and the psychological pressure. It is filmed very plainly, and is often taken as one of the spy shows closest to real intelligence work. If you like Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy, it will suit you.

plot: 过气情景喜剧演员瓦莱丽·切里什答应拍一部关于自己复出的真人秀，于是生活被第二次拍摄。她要讨好更年轻的编剧，也要在镜头前维持「还没过时」。
hook: 丽莎·库卓（《老友记》里的菲比）演一个过气女演员，答应让真人秀全程跟拍她的复出。笑点来自她拼命讨好镜头又不断出丑，尴尬也心酸。2005 年只播一季就被砍，多年后又拍了续季。
plot_en: Valerie Cherish, a sitcom actress past her prime, agrees to film a reality show about her comeback, so her life is filmed a second time. She has to please a younger writer, and keep up, in front of the camera, the appearance of not being finished.
hook_en: Lisa Kudrow, Phoebe on Friends, plays an actress past her prime who agrees to let a reality show follow her comeback. The jokes come from her straining to please the camera and constantly humiliating herself. It is embarrassing and sad. It ran one season in 2005 and was cancelled, then came back years later.

plot: 从伊丽莎白二世登基写到世纪之交。王室在这里是一户不能辞职的人家，首相、配偶和子女都要跟职位谈判。三位演员接力扮演女王。
hook: 从伊丽莎白二世登基讲到 21 世纪初，每两季换一批演员，跟着人物一起变老。每集多围绕一个历史事件，比如艾伯凡矿难、戴安娜接受 BBC 采访，适合想了解英国现代史的人。前两季的克莱尔·福伊和马特·史密斯最受好评。
plot_en: It follows Elizabeth II from her accession to the turn of the century. The royal family here is a household that cannot resign. Prime ministers, spouses, and children all have to negotiate with the office. Three actors take turns as the queen.
hook_en: From Elizabeth II’s accession into the early twenty-first century. Every two seasons the cast changes, and the characters age with it. Episodes are often built around one historical event, such as the Aberfan disaster or Diana’s interview with the BBC. It suits someone who wants modern British history. Claire Foy and Matt Smith, in the first two seasons, are the most praised.

plot: 小丑把高谭的黑帮和市民一起拖进他的规矩里，逼蝙蝠侠在公开身份和继续戴面具之间选。检察官哈维·丹特本来是这座城市的另一个希望。
hook: 对超级英雄无所谓，并不是拍好他们的前提。克里斯托弗·诺兰讨厌漫画逻辑，迷的是成人犯罪片，尤其是《盗火线》和《教父》。他把一个还陷在《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》那团雾里的角色重新做活了。这是他“黑暗骑士”三部曲的第二部，也是最高点。它问主角那套道德是不是太天真。片子最大的本钱是希斯·莱杰，他演的小丑把后来的超级反派的标准定死了。
plot_en: The Joker drags Gotham’s gangs and its citizens into his rules, and forces Batman to choose between revealing who he is and keeping the mask. The prosecutor Harvey Dent was the city’s other hope.
hook_en: Indifference to superheroes isn’t a prerequisite for making a great film about them. But Christopher Nolan’s allergy to comic-book logic and his infatuation with the grown-up crime movie canon (especially “Heat” and “The Godfather”) revitalized a character still laboring to emerge from the miasma of “Batman & Robin.” The second entry and high-water mark of Nolan’s “Dark Knight” trilogy poses fruitful questions about the naïveté of its protagonist’s moral code. But the film’s greatest asset is Heath Ledger, whose staggering performance as the Joker set the bar for subsequent supervillains forever.

plot: 黑帮头目科斯特洛在警队里安了眼线，州警也把新人送进他的团伙。两个卧底都在找对方是谁，也都得先保住自己。
hook: 这只猫和老鼠的黑帮片，终于让马丁·斯科塞斯拿到奥斯卡，也是本世纪最好看的电影之一。他把香港片《无间道》搬到波士顿，配上 Dropkick Murphys 的歌。法律一边，是莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥演的毛糙警察，假装成罪犯。另一边，是马特·达蒙演的好学生警察，实际为黑手党工作。中间是杰克·尼科尔森演的爱尔兰黑帮老大，笑得像柴郡猫。游戏开始。
plot_en: The gang boss Costello has an informer inside the police, and the state police send a new man into his crew. The two moles are each looking for the other, and each has to keep himself alive first.
hook_en: The cat-and-rat gangster picture that finally won Martin Scorsese his Oscar happens to be one of the most downright entertaining of the century. Scorsese takes the Hong Kong flick “Infernal Affairs” and plops it in Boston, Dropkick Murphys soundtrack and all. On one side of the law there’s Leonardo DiCaprio’s rough-around-the-edges cop posing as a criminal. On the other there’s Matt Damon’s golden-boy police officer working for the Mafia. In the middle there’s Jack Nicholson’s Irish mob boss, smiling like the Cheshire Cat. Let the games begin.

plot: 职业外交官凯特·怀勒临时出任美国驻英国大使，到任时一场危机已经烧到大使馆门口。丈夫哈尔也是外交官，帮忙和添乱用的是同一套本事。
hook: 美国职业外交官凯特被临时任命为驻英大使，同时还得处理和丈夫的婚姻危机。国际危机节奏快、对白密，像一部职场版政治惊悚剧。凯丽·拉塞尔把这个角色演得又聪明又狼狈。
plot_en: Kate Wyler, a career diplomat, is suddenly made the American ambassador to Britain, and arrives with a crisis already burning at the embassy door. Her husband Hal is a diplomat too. The same skills are used to help and to make trouble.
hook_en: Kate, a career American diplomat, is suddenly appointed ambassador to Britain, and at the same time has to deal with the crisis in her marriage. The international crises move fast and the dialogue is dense. It is like a workplace political thriller. Keri Russell plays the role as both sharp and a mess.

plot: 体弱的安妮女王少问政事，女伴萨拉长期替她拿主意。萨拉的穷亲戚阿比盖尔进宫当了女仆，很快成为另一个能靠近女王的人。
hook: 希腊导演约尔戈斯·兰西莫斯用他自己的鱼眼看英国历史。他把安妮女王拍成一个绝望、生病的统治者，奥利维娅·科尔曼凭这个角色拿了奥斯卡。争她那份说变就变的宠爱的，是霸道的萨拉（蕾切尔·薇兹）和会算计的阿比盖尔（艾玛·斯通），各自都在争权。片子里满是好用的损话，兰西莫斯往刻薄上靠，身体上的，以及其他的。
plot_en: Queen Anne is frail and asks little about affairs of state. Her companion Sarah has long made the decisions for her. Sarah’s poor cousin Abigail enters the palace as a maid and soon becomes another person who can get close to the queen.
hook_en: The Greek auteur Yorgos Lanthimos looks at British history through his own fish-eye lens in this cheekily perverted take on the life of Queen Anne, played here as a desperate, ailing ruler by Olivia Colman in an Oscar-winning performance. The two women competing for Anne’s fickle affections are the domineering Sarah (Rachel Weisz) and the conniving Abigail (Emma Stone), each on her own quest for power. In a movie full of delectable zingers, Lanthimos leans into nastiness, both corporeal and otherwise.

plot: 六岁的莫妮和朋友们住在奥兰多迪士尼旁边的廉价汽车旅馆里，整个夏天在楼道和快餐店之间玩。母亲海莉靠着出租房间和别的办法挣房租。
hook: 一幅让人心碎的肖像：美国的贫困和边缘里，童年的想象和无辜。六岁的莫妮（布鲁克琳·普林斯）在迪士尼世界附近一家俗气的汽车旅馆里撒野。你一会儿想高兴地搂住她，一会儿想让她罚站很久。这就是要点：她是个孩子，而且是那种冒着泡的孩子。片子的力量来自一种不说出口的紧张（这种日子不太可能有好结局），也来自一个被迪士尼制造并拿来卖的魔法世界，就在她够不着的地方。
plot_en: Six-year-old Moonee and her friends live in a cheap motel next to Disney World in Orlando, and spend the summer playing between the corridors and the fast-food shops. Her mother Halley makes the rent by letting rooms and by other means.
hook_en: A heart-rending portrait of childhood imagination and innocence amid poverty and marginalization in America. Moonee, age 6 (Brooklynn Prince), runs riot at a tawdry motel near Disney World. You alternately want to squeeze her with joy and put her in a long timeout, and that’s the point: She’s a kid, effervescently so. The film draws power from an unspoken tension (this existence is unlikely to end well) and the way a magical fantasy world — manufactured and marketed by Disney — sits just out of her reach.

plot: 导演开着车在法国的乡下和城市里找那些捡剩东西的人。有人捡收割机留下的土豆，有人在菜市场打烊后捡菜，也有人把捡来的东西做成作品。
hook: 这个“我”是阿涅斯·瓦尔达，帮助法国新浪潮开始的那位先驱。她用亲密的旁白和手持数码相机走遍法国，看拾穗的人在个人和政治上是谁。拾穗的人，传统上是去收割后的田里捡剩下的粮食的人。结果是一个深的、少见地温柔的、一直在追问的哲学之梦：在这个世界上生活可以是什么意思。只拿你需要的，把你有的都分出去。而这件事本身，就是一次电影上的拾穗，很了不起。
plot_en: The director drives through the countryside and the cities of France looking for people who pick up what is left. Some take the potatoes a harvester missed, some take vegetables after a market closes, and some turn what they find into work of their own.
hook_en: The “I” is Agnès Varda, the pioneering filmmaker who helped kick-start the French new wave. With an intimate voice-over and hand-held digital camera, Varda travels throughout France to consider the personal and political identity of gleaners, people who traditionally collected grain left in fields after harvest. The result is a profound, uncommonly tender and searchingly philosophical dream of what it could mean to live in the world — take only what you need, share everything you have — that is itself a tour de force of cinematic gleaning.

plot: 埃莉诺死后醒来，发现自己进了一套按积分分配的来世，而档案显然搞错了人。邻居、道德哲学课和一位礼貌的建筑师，一起维持这个漂亮的社区。
hook: 女主死后被误送进「善地」，只好偷偷学做好人，以免被发现。它把伦理学和哲学问题讲得轻松好懂。第一季结尾有个大反转，最好别被剧透。
plot_en: Eleanor wakes up dead and finds she has entered an afterlife assigned by points, and the file has clearly got the wrong person. The neighbors, a class in moral philosophy, and a polite architect keep this handsome neighborhood going.
hook_en: The heroine dies and is sent by mistake to the Good Place, so she secretly learns how to be good before anyone notices. It explains ethics and philosophy lightly enough to follow. The end of the first season has a large reversal. Better not to have it spoiled.

plot: 检察官彼得·弗洛里克因性丑闻和贪腐下台，妻子艾丽西娅十三年后回到律师事务所。案件每周进来，公司政治和她自己的名字则慢慢变得更重要。
hook: 丈夫因丑闻入狱后，艾丽西娅重返律所当律师。每集一个案子，但律所政治、竞选和婚姻线才是长期看点。在法律剧里，它少见地关注科技、政治和媒体。
plot_en: The prosecutor Peter Florrick falls over a sex scandal and corruption. Thirteen years later his wife Alicia returns to a law firm. A case comes in every week. The politics of the firm, and her own name, slowly become more important.
hook_en: After her husband goes to prison over a scandal, Alicia goes back to a firm as a lawyer. There is a case each episode, but the long-term interest is the politics of the firm, the campaigns, and the marriage. Among legal shows, it is unusual in paying attention to technology, politics, and the media.

plot: 高山旅馆的礼宾员古斯塔夫被一位老客人写进遗嘱，随即被栽成凶手。门童零跟着他逃，也听他讲这家旅馆以前的样子。
hook: 韦斯·安德森糖果色的画面会骗人。标题里那家华丽的旅馆是一座粉色的点心，里面的赌注却是真的：法西斯正在逼近，在一个虚构的欧洲国家，难民有理由害怕边境上的当局。故事发生在两次大战之间。人人喜爱的礼宾员（拉尔夫·费因斯好极了）把男人和女人都叫“亲爱的”，也和所有朋友上床。到最后，它非常动人。
plot_en: Gustave, the concierge of a mountain hotel, is written into an old guest’s will and is promptly framed for murder. The lobby boy Zero flees with him, and listens to him describe what the hotel used to be.
hook_en: Wes Anderson’s candy-colored visions can be deceptive. The magnificent inn of the title is a glorious pink confection, but there are real stakes at play: Fascism is fast approaching and refugees have good reason to fear the authorities at the borders of a fictional European country. This between-the-wars tale of a beloved concierge (a terrific Ralph Fiennes) who calls men and women alike “darling” and sleeps with all his friends is in the end deeply moving.

plot: 业余烘焙者在帐篷里完成签名菜、技术挑战和创意赛，周末有人回家，留下的人继续和面。竞争是真的，安慰也是赛制的一部分。
hook: 业余烘焙师在帐篷里比做蛋糕、面包和甜点，每周淘汰一人。特别之处在于温和：选手会互相帮忙，评委也不刻意制造冲突。看完很可能想马上去烤点什么。
plot_en: Amateur bakers in a tent make a signature bake, a technical challenge, and a showstopper. Someone goes home on the weekend. The people who stay keep working dough. The competition is real, and so is the comfort, which is part of the format.
hook_en: Amateur bakers compete in a tent at cakes, bread, and desserts, and one person is sent home each week. What is particular about it is the mildness: the contestants help each other, and the judges do not manufacture conflict on purpose. After watching it you will probably want to bake something.

plot: 在生育率崩溃后的基列国，能生育的女性被编为使女，分配给权贵家庭。琼以奥芙弗雷德的名字生活，记住自己原来叫什么成了一种反抗。
hook: 改编自阿特伍德的小说：美国被极权宗教政权取代，有生育能力的女性被分配到高官家里生孩子。第一季压抑而精准，让 Hulu 成为第一个拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集的流媒体平台。后几季越拍越长，评价有所下滑。
plot_en: In Gilead, after fertility collapses, women who can bear children are made Handmaids and assigned to the households of the powerful. June lives under the name Offred. Remembering what she used to be called becomes a form of resistance.
hook_en: Adapted from Atwood’s novel. The United States is replaced by a religious authoritarian regime, and women who can have children are assigned to the houses of senior officials to bear them. The first season is oppressive and exact. It made Hulu the first streaming service to win the Emmy for best drama. The later seasons got longer, and the reception slipped.

plot: 伊拉克战场上，詹姆斯中士接替阵亡的前任，领导一支拆弹小组。他对危险的判断和另外两名组员不一样。轮休回到家里之后，他也不知道自己还能做什么。
hook: “你拆过多少颗炸弹？”一名军官问詹姆斯上士（杰里米·雷纳）。他刚扑灭一辆着火的车，并处理掉后备箱里的炸药。“八百七十三颗，长官。”他回答。凯瑟琳·毕格罗凭这部关于美军在伊拉克拆弹小组的、把神经撕开的电影，成为第一个拿到奥斯卡最佳导演的女人。它拍的是 21 世纪的战争：叛乱者和路边的简易爆炸装置。它也在看一个肾上腺素上瘾的人的心理。他待在防爆服里，比待在超市麦片货架前更自在。
plot_en: On the Iraq war’s bomb squads, Sergeant James replaces a predecessor who was killed and leads a three-man team. His sense of the danger is not the same as the other two men’s. When he rotates home, he does not know what else he can do.
hook_en: “How many bombs have you disarmed?” an officer asks Staff Sgt. James (Jeremy Renner), who has just extinguished a flaming car and neutralized its trunkful of explosives. “Eight hundred seventy-three, sir,” he answers. Kathryn Bigelow became the first woman to win the best director Oscar for this nerve-shredding film about a U.S. ordnance team in Iraq. In capturing the 21st-century warfare of insurgents and roadside I.E.D.s, “The Hurt Locker” also looks at the psyche of an adrenaline junkie more at home in a blast suit than in the cereal aisle.

plot: 全世界百分之二的人忽然消失，没有解释。三年后，小镇上的人用邪教、职务和沉默继续生活，警察加维只想让这一天不要再裂开。
hook: 全球 2% 的人突然消失，剧集不解释原因，只关心留下来的人怎样面对失去。第一季偏压抑；第二季换到新小镇后渐入佳境；第三季结局非常动人。适合能接受慢节奏和开放问题的观众。
plot_en: Two percent of the world’s people vanish at once, with no explanation. Three years later, the people in a small town go on living by means of cults, jobs, and silence. The police officer Garvey only wants the day not to split open again.
hook_en: Two percent of the people on earth disappear at once. The show does not explain why. It only cares how the people who remain face the loss. The first season is on the oppressive side. The second, after a move to a new town, finds its feet. The third season’s ending is very moving. It suits someone who can take a slow pace and questions left open.

plot: 1984 年东柏林，史塔西上尉维斯勒受命监听剧作家德雷曼和他的女友。监听持续了很久，他写进报告的内容开始和耳机里听到的不一样。
hook: 1984 年前后的东柏林，你能信任谁？别人的生活，朋友、邻居、不听话的同事，都可能是任何人的事。弗洛里安·亨克尔·冯·多纳斯马尔克这部绷着的、让人不安的戏，讲一个风光的剧作家、他当舞台演员的情人，以及被派去监听他们是否忠诚的史塔西特工。赌注不能再高，情绪的底线却又闷又重。它在揭露和服从之间走钢丝。
plot_en: In East Berlin in 1984, the Stasi captain Wiesler is ordered to listen in on the playwright Dreyman and his girlfriend. The surveillance goes on for a long time. What he writes in his reports starts to differ from what he hears in the headphones.
hook_en: Whom can you trust in circa-1984 East Berlin? The lives of others — friends, neighbors, wayward co-workers — are anyone’s concern in Florian Henckel von Donnersmarck’s taut, disquieting drama about a dashing playwright, his stage-actress lover and the Stasi agent assigned to monitor their loyalties. The stakes couldn’t be higher, but the movie’s emotional base line is both muted and devastating, a high-wire act of revelation and compliance.

plot: 弗罗多从比尔博手里接过一枚戒指，甘道夫告诉他这枚戒指必须毁掉。他和同伴离开夏尔，在幽谷和其他几路人会合成护戒队，往摩多进发。
hook: 彼得·杰克逊用《指环王》三部曲的第一部，做了几乎不可能的事：他在新西兰的山里把 J·R·R·托尔金的中土做成了真的，老读者买账，对精灵和半兽人那些术语心存警惕的新观众也买账。化妆和特效现在还站得住，大场面让人进去，有时也吓人，给奇幻商业片立了新的标准。霍华德·肖的配乐一响，就很难不被带走。
plot_en: Frodo receives a ring from Bilbo, and Gandalf tells him the ring has to be destroyed. He and his companions leave the Shire, meet the others at Rivendell, and the Fellowship sets out for Mordor.
hook_en: With the first installment of his “Lord of the Rings” trilogy, Peter Jackson did the almost impossible: He brought J.R.R. Tolkien’s Middle-earth to life in the hills of New Zealand, appealing to longtime fans and newcomers who might be wary of the jargon about elves and orcs. The film set a new bar for fantasy blockbusters with makeup and effects that still hold up, and set pieces that are immersive and occasionally terrifying. As soon as Howard Shore’s score kicks in, it’s hard not to feel transported.

plot: 退伍兵弗雷迪靠私酿酒过日子，在船上被兰开斯特·多德看中。多德领导着一个叫「源」的组织，把弗雷迪留在身边，既当实验对象，也当跟班。
hook: 影迷还在拆保罗·托马斯·安德森的第六部、也是最绕的一部。它讲一个漂着的、情感上退回去的二战退伍兵（华金·菲尼克斯），和一个邪教领袖（菲利普·塞穆尔·霍夫曼）。两个人体格和脾气都相反。美术把那个年代做得极真，影像的细节发亮（安德森把几乎不用了的 65 毫米胶片拿回来拍），表演的强度也在，包括艾米·亚当斯演的教主妻子。这些一起让片子耐看，也让它保持成一个谜。
plot_en: The veteran Freddie gets by on liquor he brews himself, and is picked out on a boat by Lancaster Dodd. Dodd leads an organization called the Cause and keeps Freddie beside him, as a subject and as a follower.
hook_en: Fans are still unraveling Paul Thomas Anderson’s sixth and most elliptical feature, about the relationship between a drifting, emotionally regressive World War II veteran (Joaquin Phoenix) and a cult leader (Philip Seymour Hoffman) who is his physical and temperamental opposite. The production design’s extraordinary evocation of the period, the shimmery detail of the imagery (Anderson revived the nearly obsolete 65-millimeter format to shoot it) and the intensity of the performances — including Amy Adams’s turn as the cult leader’s wife — all contribute to the film’s durability and mystery.

plot: 大学生纳西尔深夜借了父亲的出租车，第二天在陌生公寓醒来，身旁是一具尸体。从警局到看守所，案件开始按它自己的程序重写这个人。
hook: 巴基斯坦裔大学生一夜醒来，发现身边的女孩被刺死，自己成了头号嫌疑人。剧集一步步展示警察、律师、监狱和司法程序怎样改变一个人。改编自英剧《司法正义》，八集迷你剧。
plot_en: The college student Nasir borrows his father’s taxi late at night and wakes the next day in a strange apartment, with a body beside him. From the police station to the jail, the case starts rewriting him according to its own procedure.
hook_en: A Pakistani-American college student wakes up and finds the girl beside him stabbed to death. He becomes the prime suspect. The series shows, step by step, how the police, the lawyers, the prison, and the procedure change a person. Adapted from the British series Criminal Justice. Eight episodes.

plot: 失踪多年的草原姑娘回到家，视力恢复了，却拒绝解释她去过哪里。她召集五个人学习一组动作，说那可能是离开这个世界的方法。
hook: 一个失踪七年的盲女回到家乡，不但恢复了视力，还声称自己去过另一个世界。它混合了科幻、宗教和神秘主义，风格很独特。只拍两季就被取消，结局停在一个大悬念上。
plot_en: Prairie comes home after years missing. Her sight has returned, and she refuses to explain where she has been. She gathers five people and teaches them a set of movements, which she says may be a way to leave this world.
hook_en: A blind woman missing for seven years comes home. She has her sight back, and she claims she has been to another world. It mixes science fiction, religion, and mysticism, and the style is its own. It was cancelled after two seasons, with the ending stopped on a large unanswered question.

plot: 斯劳一家纸业公司的区域经理戴维·布伦特接受纪录片拍摄，把管理理解成表演。蒂姆喜欢接待员唐恩，办公室里几乎没有人想被拍到。
hook: 美版的原作，只有两季加两集圣诞特辑，共 14 集。瑞奇·热维斯演的老板大卫·布伦特尴尬到让人想捂脸，伪纪录片喜剧正是从它开始流行起来。比美版更冷、更苦，也更短。
plot_en: David Brent, the regional manager of a paper company in Slough, agrees to be filmed for a documentary and understands management as a performance. Tim likes the receptionist Dawn. Almost no one in the office wants to be filmed.
hook_en: The original of the American version. Two seasons plus two Christmas specials, fourteen episodes. Ricky Gervais’s boss, David Brent, is embarrassing enough that you want to cover your face. The mockumentary comedy became popular from this. It is colder, more bitter, and shorter than the American version.

plot: 宾夕法尼亚一家纸业公司的斯克兰顿分公司，经理迈克尔·斯科特把办公室当成自己的舞台。假纪录片拍下销售、恋爱，以及谁都不想参加的派对。
hook: 伪纪录片形式拍一家纸业公司的日常，老板迈克尔每次想当好人都会搞砸。吉姆和帕姆的感情线是很多人坚持看下去的原因。第一季还在模仿英版，从第二季开始找到自己的风格，前七季最好。
plot_en: At the Scranton branch of a paper company in Pennsylvania, the manager Michael Scott treats the office as his stage. A fake documentary records the sales, the romances, and the parties no one wants to attend.
hook_en: A mockumentary of daily life at a paper company. Every time the boss, Michael, tries to be a good person, he wrecks it. Jim and Pam’s relationship is the reason a lot of people stay. The first season is still imitating the British original. From the second season it finds its own style. The first seven seasons are the best.

plot: 匹兹堡一家医院的急诊室，一集大约是一个小时的班。主治医生罗比带着实习生处理接连进来的病人，私人的事只能插在两副担架之间。
hook: 一集大致对应急诊室里一小时的班，整季就是一个 15 小时的班次。不靠恋爱戏撑场，靠快速而真实的抢救流程，以及医护人员的疲惫和创伤。《急诊室的故事》里的诺亚·怀尔担任主演，2025 年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集和男主角。
plot_en: The emergency room of a hospital in Pittsburgh. An episode is about an hour of a shift. The attending, Robbie, takes the interns through the patients who keep coming in. Private matters can only be fitted between two stretchers.
hook_en: An episode is roughly one hour of a shift in an emergency room, and the season is one fifteen-hour shift. It does not lean on a romance. It leans on a fast, believable sequence of treatment, and on how tired and damaged the staff are. Noah Wyle, from ER, is the lead. In 2025 it won the Emmys for best drama and lead actor.

plot: 孤儿贝丝·哈蒙在收养家庭里靠镇静剂看见棋盘，然后在 1960 年代一路下到国际赛场。天才是真的，依赖、孤独和那套要她好看的世界也是真的。
hook: 孤儿院长大的女孩贝丝靠天赋成为国际象棋高手，同时与药物和酒精成瘾对抗。不懂下棋也能看懂，比赛拍得像体育片一样紧张。60 年代的服装美术很漂亮，七集就看完。
plot_en: Beth Harmon, an orphan, sees the chessboard in the tranquilizers at her adoptive home, and then plays her way to international tournaments in the 1960s. The talent is real. So are the dependence, the loneliness, and a world that wants her to look good.
hook_en: Beth, who grows up in an orphanage, becomes a chess champion on talent, and at the same time fights an addiction to drugs and alcohol. You can follow it without knowing chess. The matches are filmed with the tension of a sports movie. The 1960s clothes and design are beautiful. Seven episodes and it is done.

plot: 菲尔德为真人建造等比例的场景，让他们把一场艰难的谈话先排练一遍。计划越做越完整，最后连他自己的生活也被放进彩排。
hook: 内森·菲尔德帮普通人「彩排」人生中的关键时刻，比如向朋友坦白一个谎言，为此不惜搭出一比一的酒吧场景。节目越往后越失控，连他自己也被卷了进去。好笑、诡异，也会让人不安。
plot_en: Fielder builds full-scale sets for real people so they can rehearse a difficult conversation first. The plan gets more complete, until his own life is put into the rehearsal.
hook_en: Nathan Fielder helps ordinary people “rehearse” a crucial moment, such as confessing a lie to a friend, and will build a one-to-one copy of a bar to do it. As the show goes on it gets out of control, and he himself is pulled in. Funny, eerie, and unsettling.

plot: 坦嫩鲍姆家的三个孩子小时候都是天才，长大后一个比一个停摆。多年不管家的父亲罗耶尔谎称自己快死了，搬回来住。
hook: 在韦斯·安德森的名字变成一种被人模仿的美学之前，他首先是一个会讲故事的人。他写纽约一个古怪的家庭，韦斯式的标记不少：面无表情的台词、像色卡一样的颜色、用得正好的歌。但它也是一幅有感情、常常很好笑的肖像：情感上离得很远的父亲（吉恩·哈克曼），和他那几个一团糟、却又过度优秀的孩子，本·斯蒂勒、卢克·威尔逊和格温妮丝·帕特洛把那种痛苦演得很细。
plot_en: The three Tenenbaum children were prodigies and, as adults, have each stalled. Their father Royal, who has ignored the family for years, claims he is dying and moves back in.
hook_en: Before his name became a byword for a distinctive and much-imitated aesthetic, Wes Anderson was also just a really good storyteller. His exploration of one eccentric New York family contains no shortage of Wes-lian signatures: deadpan line deliveries, dreamy Pantone palettes, first-rate needle drops. But it’s also a deeply felt and often very funny portrait of an emotionally distant patriarch (Gene Hackman) and his messy, overachieving offspring, played with exquisite agony by Ben Stiller, Luke Wilson and Gwyneth Paltrow.

plot: 洛杉矶法明顿区的维克·麦基带领特警小队，用非法的办法换来街头成绩。试播集里的一桩谋杀没有被忘掉，它在后面七年里一直向他收利息。
hook: 洛杉矶警察维克·麦基带着小队以暴制暴、私吞毒资，试播集结尾他就亲手杀了一名同事。整部剧像一根慢慢收紧的绳索，看他能不能逃过报应。结局被很多人认为是电视史上最好的结局之一。
plot_en: Vic Mackey leads a strike team in Los Angeles’s Farmington district and buys results on the street with illegal methods. A murder in the pilot is not forgotten. For the next seven years it keeps collecting interest from him.
hook_en: The Los Angeles cop Vic Mackey and his team answer violence with violence and skim drug money. At the end of the pilot he kills a colleague with his own hands. The whole series is a rope slowly tightening, to see whether he can get out from under what he owes. The ending is widely taken as one of the best endings in television.

plot: 哈佛学生扎克伯格一夜写出给同学打分的网站，随后和室友一起做了后来的 Facebook。公司做大之后，他和联合创始人、早期投资人相继对簿公堂。
hook: 与其说是传记，不如说是解剖。大卫·芬奇这部让人看入迷、常常刻薄到好笑的起源故事，讲马克·扎克伯格（杰西·艾森伯格）和 Facebook 怎么来的。开场是一男一女分手。到结尾，这个男人成了世界上最孤独的亿万富翁，不停刷新自己的 Facebook 页面。上映时，它像是对一个美国成功故事近乎残忍的写法。社交网络后来把世界改成这样，片子现在看起来几乎温和，而且不够残忍。
plot_en: The Harvard student Zuckerberg writes, in one night, a site that rates his classmates, and then builds what becomes Facebook with his roommates. After the company grows, he ends up in court against a co-founder and against an early investor.
hook_en: Less a biography than an evisceration, David Fincher’s hypnotically unflattering, often brutally funny origin story about Mark Zuckerberg (Jesse Eisenberg) and the creation of Facebook opens with a man and woman breaking up. By movie’s end, the man is the world’s loneliest billionaire, compulsively clicking refresh on his Facebook page. When “The Social Network” debuted, it seemed like a borderline cruel take on a classic American success story. Given how social media has radically reshaped the world, the film now seems almost quaint — and not nearly cruel enough.

plot: 英国政府部门的部长们还没想好政策，舆论主管马尔科姆·塔克已经闯进来改稿、骂人和收拾残局。一句话的措辞，可以毁掉一个上午。
hook: 英国政府部门的政治讽刺喜剧，部长们疲于应付媒体和政策灾难。彼得·卡帕尔迪饰演的舆论主管马尔科姆·塔克以花式骂人闻名。主创后来把这套风格带到美国，拍了《副总统》，还拍了电影《灵通人士》。
plot_en: The ministers of a British government department have not decided the policy yet, and the communications chief Malcolm Tucker has already burst in to rewrite the draft, swear, and clean up the mess. The wording of one sentence can ruin a morning.
hook_en: A political satire about a British government department. The ministers are exhausted by the press and by policy disasters. Peter Capaldi’s communications chief, Malcolm Tucker, is famous for the inventiveness of his swearing. The creator later took the style to the United States for Veep, and also made the film In the Loop.

plot: 杰克回忆在德州的童年：严厉的父亲、温柔的母亲，和弟弟的死。这些家里的片段被放到宇宙形成、生命出现的画面之间。
hook: 有野心大的题材，然后还有泰伦斯·马力克这部拿了金棕榈的《生命之树》，它想把整个创造揽进怀里。这是对记忆和失去的冥想。印象式的影像松松地跟着 1950 年代德州郊区的一家，以及几十年后那个苦恼的儿子（肖恩·潘）。在大胆的“宇宙史”段落里，片子通过生命本身暴烈、美丽、神秘的起源，去找一个人的生命是什么意思。
plot_en: Jack remembers a childhood in Texas: a severe father, a gentle mother, and the death of his brother. Those scenes from the house are set between images of the universe forming and of life appearing.
hook_en: There’s ambitious subject matter and then there’s Terrence Malick’s Palme d’Or-winning “The Tree of Life,” which tries to wrap its arms around all of creation. A meditation on memory and loss, this impressionistic film loosely follows a suburban family in 1950s Texas and a troubled son (Sean Penn) decades later. But in its audacious “history of the universe” sequence, the movie searches for the meaning of one human life by examining the violent, beautiful, mysterious origins of life itself.

plot: 每一季换一座白莲花度假酒店，开场先知道这周会死一个人，再回头看客人如何把服务员、本地人和彼此当成假期的一部分。
hook: 每季换一座豪华度假村和一批有钱游客。开头先告诉你有人死了，再倒回去看这一周发生了什么。它讽刺有钱人的傲慢和空虚，也拍服务员的处境。第一季在夏威夷，第二季在西西里，第三季在泰国，各季可以单独看。
plot_en: Each season moves to another White Lotus hotel. The opening tells you someone will die this week, and then goes back to watch how the guests treat the staff, the local people, and each other as part of the holiday.
hook_en: Each season changes the luxury resort and the batch of rich guests. It tells you at the start that someone has died, then goes back over the week. It satirizes the arrogance and the emptiness of the rich, and it also films the position of the staff. The first season is in Hawaii, the second in Sicily, the third in Thailand. The seasons can be watched on their own.

plot: 巴尔的摩的缉毒组盯上毒贩斯特林格·贝尔和奥马尔。五季分别走过街头、码头、市政厅、学校和报社，警察只是这座城市的其中一条线。
hook: 不是一案一结的警匪剧。五季分别拍毒品街头、码头工会、市政选举、公立学校和报社，拼起来是一整座城市怎样失灵。主创西蒙当过巴尔的摩记者，很多细节来自真实案例。开头人物多、俚语多，撑过前三四集就会上瘾。
plot_en: A narcotics unit in Baltimore sets its sights on the dealer Stringer Bell and on Omar. Five seasons pass through the street, the docks, city hall, the schools, and the newspaper. The police are only one line in the city.
hook_en: It is not a cop show that closes a case each week. Five seasons cover the drug corners, the dockworkers’ union, a city election, the public schools, and a newspaper. Put together, they are how a whole city fails. The creator, Simon, was a reporter in Baltimore, and a lot of the detail comes from real cases. There are many people at the start, and a lot of slang. Get through the first three or four episodes and it takes hold.

plot: 股票经纪人乔丹·贝尔福特开了自己的公司，靠劝客户买垃圾股赚钱。钱和药把整个办公室拖着往上走，联邦调查也跟着来了。
hook: 《纽约黑帮》的时代过去一个多世纪，马丁·斯科塞斯又在下曼哈顿找到一群行为不端的男人。莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥演臭名昭著的股票交易员乔丹·贝尔福特，剧本根据他的回忆录。他很少在银幕上这么好笑，不管是朝烦人的联邦探员扔龙虾，还是因为安定剂吃多了腿软。垮台当然会来。如果看起来贝尔福特受的罚太轻，那不也正像华尔街吗？
plot_en: The stockbroker Jordan Belfort opens his own firm and makes money by talking clients into buying junk stocks. Money and drugs pull the whole office upward, and a federal investigation follows.
hook_en: More than a century after the days of “Gangs of New York,” Martin Scorsese finds more Lower Manhattan bros behaving badly. Playing the notorious stock trader Jordan Belfort (whose memoir the movie is based on), Leonardo DiCaprio has rarely been funnier onscreen, whether it’s chucking lobsters at pesky F.B.I. agents or going rubber-legged from one too many quaaludes. There’s inevitably a downfall, but if it seems as if Belfort gets off pretty easy — well, doesn’t that sound like Wall Street?

plot: 朱莉三十岁，医学院读到一半转去学心理学，后来又想去拍照。她离开同居的男友，在酒吧认识了另一个人，然后发现自己还是定不下来。
hook: 一开始，朱莉（雷娜特·赖因斯夫）也许会让你觉得她是个浅的人。她在奥斯陆读大学，换专业像换衣服；二十多岁，她和易怒的阿克塞尔（安德斯·丹尼尔森·李）在一起，同时又幻想和更简单的埃文（赫伯特·诺德鲁姆）过一种生活。约阿希姆·特里尔这部有同情的喜剧从不因为朱莉定不下来而审判她，因为认真活过的人生，一定会有弯路。不四处看，你怎么找到自己？
plot_en: Julie is thirty. She leaves medical school halfway through for psychology, and later wants to take photographs. She leaves the boyfriend she lives with, meets someone else in a bar, and finds she still cannot settle.
hook_en: At first, Julie (Renate Reinsve) may strike you as a dilettante. An Oslo college student, she changes majors like outfits; later, in her 20s, she dates tetchy Aksel (Anders Danielsen Lie) while fantasizing about a life spent with the simpler Eivind (Herbert Nordrum). But this empathetic dramedy from Joachim Trier never judges Julie for her indecision, since a life lived robustly is bound to include some detours. How are you supposed to find yourself without looking everywhere first?

plot: 鲁道夫·霍斯是奥斯维辛集中营的指挥官。电影跟着他的妻子和孩子住在墙外的别墅里：种花、请客、挑选从营地送来的衣服。
hook: 乔纳森·格雷泽这部大屠杀叙事不按常规来。他用马丁·艾米斯同名小说的骨架，把镜头放在奥斯维辛指挥官鲁道夫·霍斯（克里斯蒂安·弗里德尔）和他的妻子海德薇（桑德拉·惠勒）的日常生活上。他们就住在隔壁。他们在大规模谋杀的声音里种花，人体烧成的灰从天上落下来。看的时候会失去方向，它让你看见和暴行住在一起有多容易。米卡·利维那份让人发毛的配乐，会不时把你从皮肤里震出来。
plot_en: Rudolf Höss is the commandant of Auschwitz. The film stays with his wife and children in the villa outside the wall: planting flowers, having guests, choosing clothes sent over from the camp.
hook_en: Jonathan Glazer’s Holocaust narrative defies convention. Using the bones of Martin Amis’s novel of the same name, Glazer focuses on the day-to-day life of the commandant of Auschwitz, Rudolf Höss (Christian Friedel), and his wife, Hedwig (Sandra Hüller), who reside next door. They garden to the soundtrack of mass murder as the ash of human bodies falls from the sky. It’s a disorienting watch that shows just how easy it is to live with monstrosity, every so often jolting you out of your skin with Mica Levi’s unnerving score.

plot: 丹尼尔·普莱恩维尤从一口油井起家，把周围的地都买到自己名下。当地年轻牧师伊莱要分他的钱，也要他当众认罪。
hook: 保罗·托马斯·安德森这部关于血和石油、人和他们的神的杰作，开场在 19 世纪末。美国采油人丹尼尔·普莱恩维尤（丹尼尔·戴-刘易斯，分量很重）独自在深坑里刨土。他继续刨、继续砸，砸的是土地，也是别人，直到变成一个把一切和所有人都榨干的石油大王。安德森的影像会让人倒抽一口气，升起的镜头同时说出主角和导演的野心；缠着这部美国悲剧的环境毁灭和精神毁灭，也会。
plot_en: Daniel Plainview starts from a single oil well and buys up the land around it. Eli, a young local preacher, wants a share of the money, and wants Daniel to confess in public.
hook_en: Paul Thomas Anderson’s masterpiece about blood and oil, men and their gods, opens in the late 19th century with an American prospector, Daniel Plainview (a towering Daniel Day-Lewis), alone in a deep pit hacking at the earth. He continues gouging and pummeling (the earth, other people) to become an oil baron who ravages everything and everyone. Anderson’s filmmaking can make you gasp — the soaring camerawork speaks to the ambitions of protagonist and director alike — and so can the environmental and spiritual devastations that haunt this deeply American tragedy.

plot: 企业顾问伊内丝在罗马尼亚帮客户裁员。父亲觉得她已经不认识自己了，于是戴上假牙，以生活教练的身份出现在她的客户中间。
hook: 在《坠落的审判》和《利益区域》里那些被称赞的表演之前将近十年，德国演员桑德拉·惠勒在这里和别人一起演了一对人物：一个绷得很紧的职业女性，和一个爱恶作剧、上了年纪的父亲（彼得·西蒙尼舍克）。父亲突然跑到布加勒斯特，看望已经有些疏远的女儿。接下来是一场达达式的游行：被迫的卡拉 OK、突然的裸体、借来的保加利亚民间故事。162 分钟又散又超现实，也莫名地有人味，没有一分钟是浪费的。
plot_en: Ines, a corporate consultant, is in Romania helping a client cut staff. Her father decides she no longer knows him, puts in false teeth, and turns up among her clients as a life coach.
hook_en: Nearly a decade before her celebrated turns in “Anatomy of a Fall” and “The Zone of Interest,” the German actress Sandra Hüller co-starred in this dual character study of a tightly wound careerist and her aging prankster father (Peter Simonischek). When Pops makes a sudden unannounced visit to his semi-estranged daughter in Bucharest, what follows is a Dada-esque parade of forced karaoke, spontaneous nudity and borrowed Bulgarian folklore in which not one of the film’s shaggy, surreal and somehow deeply human 162 minutes feels wasted.

plot: 路易斯安那的两名警探哈特与科尔，在 1995 年和 2012 年两个时间里讲述同一桩命案。一个女孩的尸体把他们带进沼泽、教堂和一段不愿封存的旧案。
hook: 只看第一季。两位警探在两条时间线里回忆一起带有邪教色彩的谋杀案，马修·麦康纳那些悲观哲学台词非常出名。第四集结尾约六分钟的长镜头被反复讨论。南方的沼泽、教堂和工厂，拍出了很强的哥特氛围。
plot_en: The Louisiana detectives Hart and Cohle tell the same murder from 1995 and from 2012. A girl’s body takes them into the swamp, a church, and an old case they do not want closed.
hook_en: Watch the first season. Two detectives recall a murder with the color of a cult, on two timelines. Matthew McConaughey’s pessimistic philosophical lines are famous. The long take of about six minutes at the end of episode four has been discussed over and over. The Southern swamp, the churches, and the factories give it a strong gothic atmosphere.

plot: 劳拉·帕尔默的案子过去二十五年，库珀探员要回到双峰，可他并不是完整地回来。十八集里有原子弹、路边的房子，和一段几乎不动的等待。
hook: 大卫·林奇在原版播出 25 年后拍的续作，共 18 集。别期待普通续集，它几乎是一部 18 小时的实验电影。第八集的原子弹试爆段落尤其惊人，喜欢林奇的人会非常着迷。
plot_en: Twenty-five years after the Laura Palmer case, Agent Cooper has to get back to Twin Peaks, and he does not come back whole. Across eighteen episodes there is an atomic bomb, a house by the road, and a stretch of waiting in which almost nothing moves.
hook_en: David Lynch’s continuation, made 25 years after the original. Eighteen episodes. Do not expect an ordinary sequel. It is close to an eighteen-hour experimental film. The atomic-bomb passage in episode eight is especially astonishing. People who like Lynch will be absorbed.

plot: 珠宝商霍华德把一颗黑蛋白石寄在店里，同时欠着高利贷，还把钱押在凯尔特人队的比赛上。每一笔新的都用来补上一笔的洞。
hook: 《原钻》可以说是本世纪到目前最让人焦虑的电影之一。萨夫迪兄弟用它做霍华德·拉特纳（亚当·桑德勒）的人物研究，又黑又好笑。他是犹太钻石区的商人，有赌瘾。片子和他一样磨人。他不停处在自己造成的危机里：要躲开妻子（伊迪娜·门泽尔）的怒气，躲开放高利贷的人的手下，还要对付篮球明星凯文·加内特。加内特迷上了霍华德从埃塞俄比亚弄来的一颗蛋白石。
plot_en: The jeweler Howard keeps a black opal in the shop, owes a loan shark, and has his money on a Celtics game. Each new sum is used to plug the hole left by the last one.
hook_en: Arguably one of the most anxiety-inducing movies of the century so far, “Uncut Gems” is the Safdie brothers’ darkly hilarious character study of Howard Ratner (Adam Sandler), a Jewish diamond district dealer with a gambling problem. The movie is just as abrasive as Howard, who is constantly in a crisis of his own making as he tries to avoid the ire of his wife (Idina Menzel), a loan shark’s lackeys, and the basketball superstar Kevin Garnett, who has become entranced with an opal Howard imported from Ethiopia.
