plot: 一个外形是女人的存在开着货车在苏格兰的公路上行驶，向单身男人问路，再把他们带上车。被带走的人没有再出现。她重复这件事，直到自己开始离开原来的路线。
hook: 乔纳森·格雷泽在这部带电的惊悚片里，给了一次让人难忘的头脑旅行。斯嘉丽·约翰逊演一个外星人，那种“过来”的眼神让男人脱掉衣服，跟着她走进一片液态的虚空。影像催眠，也令人不安。它是一次抒情的慢烧，米卡·利维的配乐把恐惧拧紧。约翰逊那种指挥全场的在场，也许也会让你跟着她走进那片虚空。
plot_en: A being in the shape of a woman drives a van along the roads of Scotland, asks men who are alone for directions, and takes them into the van. The people who are taken do not appear again. She repeats this until she starts to leave the route.
hook_en: What a haunting head trip Jonathan Glazer delivers in this electrifying thriller. Scarlett Johansson plays an alien with a come-hither stare that makes men shed their clothes and follow her into a liquid void. The imagery is hypnotizing and disturbing at once. It’s a lyrical slow burn, with a score by Mica Levi that ratchets up the dread. And Johansson’s commanding presence just might make you follow her into that void as well.

plot: 气球推销员卡尔在妻子艾莉去世后，用成千上万只气球把房子拔起来，按两人年轻时的约定飞往南美。童子军小罗意外留在了门廊上。
hook: 这是皮克斯最敢冒险的时候。一个 78 岁、脾气坏的鳏夫抓着过去，丧妻的悲痛让他没法建立新的关系。前面有些场面是黑白的，有些没有对白。有几段里，导演皮特·多克特更想要一种感觉，而不是顺着讲故事。后半段，房子飘走之后，变得更商业：一个话多的小孩、一条有魔法项圈的狗、一只传说中的鸟，和一个没想到的反派，负责冒险和搞笑。
plot_en: After his wife Ellie dies, the balloon salesman Carl lifts the house with thousands of balloons and flies toward South America, as the two of them agreed when they were young. The scout Russell is left on the porch by accident.
hook_en: Pixar at its risk-taking height. A cranky, 78-year-old widower clings to the past as he struggles to process grief that’s preventing new connections. Some early scenes are in black-and-white; others have no dialogue. In certain sections, the director Pete Docter is interested in a feeling more than linear storytelling. The film’s second half — after the house floats away — becomes more overtly commercial, with a young chatterbox, a dog with a magic collar, a mythical bird and an unexpected antagonist providing adventure and comedic relief.

plot: 塞琳娜·迈耶是美国副总统，日程全是没人想要的访问和随时会塌的联盟。她想当总统，幕僚想活命，每一集的危机都来自上一句随口的话。
hook: 美国副总统和她的幕僚永远在救火，政治在这里只剩甩锅、抢镜头和骂人。脏话写得极有创意，节奏快到要暂停回看。朱莉娅·路易斯-德雷弗斯凭此连拿六座艾美喜剧类女主角。
plot_en: Selina Meyer is the vice president of the United States. The schedule is full of visits no one wants and alliances that can collapse at any moment. She wants to be president. The staff want to survive. Each episode’s crisis comes from the previous offhand sentence.
hook_en: The vice president and her staff are always putting out fires. Politics here is only passing the blame, grabbing the camera, and swearing. The obscenities are extremely inventive, and the pace is fast enough that you will pause and go back. Julia Louis-Dreyfus won six Emmys for lead actress in a comedy for it.

plot: 蕾蒙达回老家探望姑姑，却发现母亲的鬼魂出现在镇上。她带回马德里的不只是这件事，还有妹妹家里一具必须处理掉的尸体。
hook: 死亡、复活、家庭的纽带，以及佩内洛普·克鲁兹一场带电的表演，构成佩德罗·阿莫多瓦这颗戏剧的宝石。几代女人在一个又一个障碍前面拿出决断。它让人觉得有力量，滴着美和热情，阿莫多瓦的许多电影都是这样，还撒了一点魔幻现实，把叙事打开到新的地方。
plot_en: Raimunda goes back to her hometown to see her aunt and finds her mother’s ghost in the town. What she brings back to Madrid is not only that, but a body in her sister’s house that has to be dealt with.
hook_en: Death, resurrection, family bonds and an electrifying performance by Penélope Cruz make up this gem of a drama from Pedro Almodóvar. Multiple generations of women show resolve as they navigate obstacle after obstacle. It’s an empowering work, dripping with beauty and passion (as so many of Almodóvar’s films are), and sprinkled with a dash of magical realism that opens up its narrative to new realms.

plot: 垃圾清理机器人瓦力在废弃的地球上日复一日打包垃圾。探测机器人伊娃落地取样，他跟着她离开地球，上了一艘载着全部人类的飞船。
hook: 皮克斯形式上最新的一部，第一幕基本没有台词。地球上最后一个机器人还在忠实地替已经离开的人类打扫。镜头转到天上之后，《机器人总动员》成了一则关于过度消费和气候的寓言，现在看起来更像真的。结尾表面欢快，底下是一个我们还没听进去的冷警告。
plot_en: The trash robot WALL-E packs garbage day after day on an abandoned Earth. The probe EVE lands to take a sample. He follows her off the planet, onto a ship carrying what is left of humanity.
hook_en: Pixar’s most formally inventive movie is basically wordless for the first act, in which the last robot on earth is faithfully cleaning up after absent humans. Once it pivots to the sky, though, “Wall-E” is a fable about overconsumption and the climate that’s only gotten more real-feeling. The ending, seemingly cheery on the surface, also serves up a bleak warning that we’ve yet to heed.

plot: 它不是漫画的逐格重拍。故事从 1921 年塔尔萨的种族屠杀开场，再落到一个蒙面警察仍在执勤的美国，雷吉娜·金饰演的安吉拉要查清父辈留下的身份。
hook: 不是电影版的翻拍，而是原著漫画的续集，故事放在 2019 年。它把超级英雄故事和美国的种族暴力史连在一起，开场就是 1921 年的塔尔萨种族屠杀。不看原著也能看，看过会更有收获。共获 11 项艾美奖。
plot_en: It is not a panel-by-panel remake of the comic. The story opens with the 1921 massacre in Tulsa and then settles in an America where masked police are still on duty. Angela, played by Regina King, has to find out the identity her father’s generation left her.
hook_en: It is not a remake of the film. It is a sequel to the original comic, set in 2019. It joins a superhero story to the history of racial violence in the United States. It opens with the 1921 Tulsa massacre. You can watch it without the comic. If you have read it, there is more. It won 11 Emmys.

plot: 鼓手安德鲁进了音乐学院，被教师弗莱彻选进核心乐队。弗莱彻用辱骂和淘汰逼他打得更快，安德鲁也开始把别的事情都让开。
hook: 一个来自地狱的音乐老师（J·K·西蒙斯）和他傲慢的学生（迈尔斯·特勒）进行一场让人看入迷的意志较量。导演达米恩·查泽尔说，他从斯坦利·库布里克的《全金属外壳》里取了灵感，想的是：卓越像战斗一样，要求完全的纪律和交出自我。极度紧张的《爆裂鼓手》，最后那段鼓独奏会让你出汗。它拿了三座奥斯卡，包括西蒙斯那座，也把当时只有 29 岁的查泽尔定成他那一代最有希望的电影作者之一。
plot_en: The drummer Andrew gets into a conservatory and is picked by the teacher Fletcher for the core band. Fletcher uses insults and cuts to make him play faster, and Andrew starts moving everything else out of the way.
hook_en: A music teacher from hell (J.K. Simmons) and his arrogant disciple (Miles Teller) engage in a spellbinding battle of wills. The director Damien Chazelle has said that he drew inspiration from Stanley Kubrick’s “Full Metal Jacket” as he explored the idea that excellence, like combat, demands total discipline and surrender of self. The ultra-intense “Whiplash” — the final drum solo will make you work up a sweat — won three Oscars, including one for Simmons, and established Chazelle, then just 29, as one of the most promising filmmakers of his generation.

plot: 特诺奇和胡利奥自称知道一处秘密海滩，说服已婚的路易莎跟他们上路。三个人往海边开，车上的话一次比一次越界。
hook: 阿方索·卡隆这部成长故事想的事情很多：欲望、阶级、男人之间的友谊、死亡，但主要是欲望。高中生特诺奇（迭戈·卢纳）和胡利奥（盖尔·加西亚·贝纳尔）好像只为性活着，和自己的女友，和对方的女友，也和一个吸引他们的姻亲。这个人让他们上路，去一座海滩。卡隆拍性的方式和角色感受它的方式一样：热，占满一切，世界的重量就在镜头外面。像青春本身，看完会眨着眼走出来，分不清方向，在记忆里筛，像沙子里夹着金子。
plot_en: Tenoch and Julio claim to know a secret beach and talk the married Luisa into coming with them. The three of them drive toward the sea, and the talk in the car crosses a line a little further each time.
hook_en: Alfonso Cuarón’s bildungsroman has much on its mind — lust, class, male friendship, mortality, but mainly lust. Sex is all that high schoolers Tenoch (Diego Luna) and Julio (Gael García Bernal) seem to live for — with their girlfriends, with each other’s girlfriends, with an alluring in-law who inspires a road trip to a beach. Cuarón shoots sex the way his characters feel it: hot, all-consuming, the weight of the world just off-camera. Like youth itself, we stumble out of the film blinking, disoriented, sifting through memories like sand strewn with gold.

plot: 简南俊的母亲昏迷不醒，公司正谈着一桩他没有把握的生意，初恋从日本出现。儿子杨杨拿相机拍人的背面，女儿正在谈一场不让家里知道的恋情。
hook: 杨德昌自编自导的这部几代人的家庭史诗，把安静的诗和爆开的戏放在一起。它在台湾和日本拍得很美，跟着简家三个人，从他们的女家长昏迷开始。他们面对生活里那些平的部分，试着用音乐、记忆，尤其是照片，找出意思。八岁的孩子聪明得不像这个年纪，他拍人的后脑勺，好让他们看见自己看不见的东西。杨德昌用这部独一无二的电影，做的就是这件事。
plot_en: Jian’s mother is in a coma. His company is in the middle of a deal he is not sure of, and a first love appears from Japan. His son Yang-Yang photographs the backs of people’s heads. His daughter is in a romance she is keeping from the family.
hook_en: This multigenerational family epic, written and directed by Edward Yang, balances sublime poetry with explosive drama. Beautifully shot in Taiwan and Japan, the film follows three members of the Jian family after their matriarch falls into a coma. As they confront the banalities of their lives, they try to find meaning through music, memories and especially photographs, including the ones a preternaturally wise 8-year-old takes of the backs of people's heads, to show them what they can’t see for themselves — something Yang achieves with this singular film.

plot: 1960 年代末，一个自称十二宫的人向旧金山的报纸寄密码和行凶声明。漫画家罗伯特放下画漫画的工作，用很多年去核对嫌疑人。
hook: 这部票房并不好的戏，看的是执念。标题里的连环杀手执着于造一个自己的形象。被官僚程序绊住的警察（马克·鲁法洛和安东尼·爱德华兹）执着地追线索，报社记者也一样，包括小罗伯特·唐尼演的那个爱喝酒的跑线记者。片尾字幕出来时你会觉得满足，尽管十二宫是谁仍是个谜。这要归给大卫·芬奇对细节和技术同样执着的注意。
plot_en: In the late 1960s a man calling himself the Zodiac sends ciphers and claims of murder to the San Francisco papers. The cartoonist Robert puts the cartoons aside and spends years checking suspects.
hook_en: This drama, which sputtered at the box office, functions as an examination of obsession. The titular serial killer is obsessive in the creation of a persona. The bureaucracy-hindered cops (Mark Ruffalo and Anthony Edwards) obsessively chase leads, while newspaper journalists, including Robert Downey Jr.’s boozy beat reporter, do the same. That you feel satisfied by the time the credits roll — even though the Zodiac’s identity remains a mystery — speaks to David Fincher’s obsessive attention to detail and technique.
